Daniel.english_translation: *Millah khidnah* — such a thing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: or enchanter
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ashaf* — the one who presses upon the constellation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it is a hard thing
Daniel.english_translation: *Yakirah* — heavy, and its burden is heavy.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there is none other that can declare it before the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'acharan lo iti di yechavvinneh* — and another there is none who can tell it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: except the gods
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahen elahin* — but the angels, whose dwelling is not with flesh and blood.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whose dwelling is not with flesh
Daniel.english_translation: *Medarehon* — their dwelling. And the Midrash of Rabbi Tanchuma: “*ve'acharan lo iti*” — “and Aaron is not here”: the priest who wears the Urim and Tummim is not here to tell you. He said to them: such was the power in that House, and you gave me advice to destroy it! Immediately he was angry and commanded to kill them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: For this cause
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — in view of this answer.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king was angry and very furious
Daniel.english_translation: *Malka bi'ens vekhetzaf sagi* — the king was in rage and great anger.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king was angry
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'ens* — in rage, as in (Genesis 40) “and behold, they are angry” (*vehinnam zo'afim*); Targum (ת"א): “and behold, they are *nesisin*.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Genesis 40” is Genesis 40:6 (JPS: “and, behold, they were sad”). The printed abbreviation ת"א is left as printed; the Aramaic is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'amar lehovadah* — and he said to destroy. The *vav* of *ve'amar* — Menachem and Dunash struggled with it. Menachem forced himself to place the *bet* of *be'ens* as a root letter of the word, and did not interpret *be'ens vekhetzaf* as an expression of nouns, but as an expression of a verb: he raged and was very wrathful, “and he said to destroy”; the *vav* in *ve'amar* forced them to interpret thus. And Dunash said: it is impossible for the *bet* of *be'ens* to be a root letter of the word, but it is a noun, and so they interpreted: “in rage and great anger he said to destroy”; and he treated the *vav* as ancillary and superfluous, like the *vav* of *varekhev vasus* (Psalms 76). And I say: the *vav* is not forced to be ancillary and superfluous, for this is its interpretation: “the king, in rage and great anger” — the king became in rage and great anger and said in his rage to destroy them; and it is one of the verses of abbreviated language.
Daniel.translator_note: The names Menachem and Dunash are translated as printed. The printed reference “Psalms 76” is Psalms 76:7 (JPS: “the riders also and the horses”); the point of the comment is the Hebrew letter *vav*, which does not show in the English.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the decree went forth
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedata nefakat* — the king's decree and his edict went out in the province.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain
Daniel.english_translation: *Uve'o Daniel vechavroh'i lehitkattalah* — Daniel and his friends were sought to be killed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then Daniel returned answer
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'edayin* — the Aramaic translation of “then” (*az*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: with counsel and discretion to Arioch
Daniel.english_translation: *Hetiv eta uta'am le'Aryokh* — he returned counsel and reason to Arioch, the name of the man.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the captain of the king’s guard
Daniel.english_translation: *Rav tavachaya* — the chief of the executioners, those obligated to kill.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Wherefore is the decree so peremptory from the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Al mah data mehatzpah* — what is this, that the king's decree is insolent, to kill?

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Arioch made the thing known to Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Adayin millata hoda Aryokh leDaniel* — that the king was angry because no one tells his dream.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Daniel went in
Daniel.english_translation: *Al uva'a* — he entered and asked.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he would give him time
Daniel.english_translation: *Yinnaten leh* — let him give him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: was the secret revealed unto Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Razah gelei* — in secret it was revealed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: changeth the times and the seasons
Daniel.english_translation: *Mehashanna* — He exchanges.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: He removeth kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Mahada* — He removes kings; because he understood from the dream that the kingdom of Nebuchadnezzar ends and another kingdom stands.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: He revealeth the deep and secret things
Daniel.english_translation: *Hu gala amikata* — He reveals depths.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: secret things
Daniel.english_translation: *Umistarata* — because He revealed to him this depth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Thou hast made known unto us the king’s matter
Daniel.english_translation: *Hoda'tanna* — You made known to me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — in view of this, that the secret was revealed to him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Daniel went in unto Arioch
Daniel.english_translation: *Daniel al al Aryokh* — he entered to Arioch.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whom the king had appointed
Daniel.english_translation: *Di minni* — who appointed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Destroy not the wise men of Babylon
Daniel.english_translation: *Al tehovad* — do not destroy.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: bring me in before the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Ha'alanni* — bring me in.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then Arioch brought in Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Adayin* — then.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in haste
Daniel.english_translation: *Behitbehalah* — in haste; that is, quickly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: brought in Daniel before the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Hanal* — he brought Daniel in.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I have found a man
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hashkachat gavar* — whom I found, a man.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the children of the captivity of Judah
Daniel.english_translation: *Galuta di Yehud* — the exile of Judah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Art thou able
Daniel.english_translation: *Haitakh kahil* — are you able.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the dream which I have seen
Daniel.english_translation: *Di chazit* — which I saw.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: astrologers
Daniel.english_translation: *Gazrin* — the name of a kind of master of sorcery.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets
Daniel.english_translation: *Beram iti* etc.; *vehoda lemalka* etc. — He revealed to me this secret, and through him He made known to the king the essence of his dream about the future.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the visions of thy head upon thy bed
Daniel.english_translation: *Chelmakh vechezvei rashakh al mishkavakh* — that which was upon your bed is this.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thy thoughts came
Daniel.english_translation: *Ra'yonakh* — your reflection.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter
Daniel.english_translation: *Al mishkavakh salku* — what you were thinking by day, what would be after you, came up upon your bed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: He that revealeth secrets hath made known to thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Vegala razaya hoda'akh* — and the Holy One, blessed be He, who reveals secrets, made known to you what will be.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for any wisdom that I have more than any living
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'anah lo bechokhmah* — and I, not from the abundance of wisdom that is in me beyond other creatures was this secret revealed to me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahen al divrat di fishra lemalka yehoda'un* — they will make you know from heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that thou mayest know the thoughts of thy heart
Daniel.english_translation: *Vera'yone levavakh tinda* — and the thoughts of your heart that you constantly ponder, to know who will arise after you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou mayest know
Daniel.english_translation: *Tinda* — you will know.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Thou, O king, sawest
Daniel.english_translation: *Chazeh havayt* — you were seeing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and behold a great image
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'ilu* — an expression of “and behold.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: This image, which was mighty
Daniel.english_translation: *Tzalma dekhen rav* — an image that was this great.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: stood before thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Vezivei yatir kaem lekovlakh* — it was standing opposite you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the appearance thereof was terrible
Daniel.english_translation: *Verevei dechil* — and its appearance was awesome.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its head was of fine gold
Daniel.english_translation: *Di dehav tav* — of good gold.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its breast
Daniel.english_translation: *Chadohi* — its chest.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its arms of silver
Daniel.english_translation: *Udera'ohi* — and its arms.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its belly and its thighs of brass
Daniel.english_translation: *Me'ohi veyarkhateih* — its belly and its thighs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its legs of iron
Daniel.english_translation: *Shakohi di farzel* — its legs of iron. *Minhen di farzel* — [part] of them of iron.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: part of iron and part of clay
Daniel.english_translation: *Umin'hen di chasaf* — some of them of iron and some of them of clay.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a stone was cut out without hands
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hitgezerat even* — that was cut and separated: one stone.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: without hands
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo bidayin* — that not by hands but of itself.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which smote the image upon its feet
Daniel.english_translation: *Umechat letzalma* — and struck the image.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and broke them to pieces
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehadekat hamon* — and crushed them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken in pieces together
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'edayin daku kechadah* — then all kinds of metals, and the clay that was in it, were crushed together.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: like the chaff of the summer threshing-floors
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehavo ke'ur min idrei kayit* — and they were like chaff from the threshing-floors of summer.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the wind carried them away
Daniel.english_translation: *Un'sa hamon rucha* — and the wind carried them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: no place was found for them
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhol atar lo hishtekach lehon* — that is, its former place was not known, and it was not recognizable that they had ever been there.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: became a great mountain
Daniel.english_translation: *Havat letur rav* — it became a great mountain.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: This is the dream
Daniel.english_translation: *Denah chelma* — behold, this is the dream that you dreamed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Ufishreih nemar* etc. — and its interpretation we will tell you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: king of kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Melekh malkhaya* — our Sages of blessed memory explained: every “king of kings” in Daniel is a king of flesh and blood, except this one, which corresponds to the Holy One, blessed be He, he said; and so its interpretation: “King of the kings,” who is the God of heaven.
Daniel.translator_note: The word “he said” (אמר) after “blessed be He” is translated as printed; its construction is not resolved here. The abbreviation ב"ו is read as “flesh and blood.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the kingdom, the power, and the strength, and the glory
Daniel.english_translation: *Malkhuta chasena* — a strong and weighty kingdom He gave you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: hath made thee to rule over them all
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehashlitakh bikhlehon* — and He made you rule over all of them, so that even if he decrees about the horse that it not be *tzonef*, and about the bird that it not fly, as it is said, “and the beasts of the field have I given him to serve him” (Jeremiah 27).
Daniel.translator_note: The word *tzonef* is left untranslated; its sense here is not resolved. Printed “Jeremiah 27” is Jeremiah 27:6 (JPS: “and the beasts of the field also have I given him to serve him”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou art the head of gold
Daniel.english_translation: *Ant hu rishah di dehava* — the head of gold of the figure that you saw is you, for your kingdom is strong and stands now, and it is very esteemed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvatrakh takum malkhu acharei: ara minakh* — and after you, another: after the kingdom of Belshazzar your son, a kingdom will arise that will take the rule from your seed, lower and humbler than your kingdom.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: inferior to thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Ara* — lower and lowly, as silver is lower and humbler than gold; and you saw that the chest, which is after the head, is of silver; so will the kingdom of Media and Persia, after the kingdom of Babylon, be lower than the kingdom of Nebuchadnezzar.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: another third kingdom of brass
Daniel.english_translation: *Umalkhu telitaah acharei* — another.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: of brass
Daniel.english_translation: *Di nechasha* — strong as copper; and it is the kingdom of Greece, the kingdom of Alexander Mokdon.
Daniel.translator_note: The name is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron
Daniel.english_translation: *Umalkhu* — the fourth is hard as iron, as you saw the legs, which are the fourth after the head and the chest and the bowels, and they are of iron.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: iron breaketh in pieces and eateth down all things
Daniel.english_translation: *Mehaddek vechashel kola* — it beats thin and crushes all kinds of metals, which are beaten thin with a hammer.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: eateth down all things
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechashel* — and beats thin; and there are many in the Gemara: *chashlei dudei* (Ketubot 77), *bei'ei chashilta* (Chullin 92).
Daniel.translator_note: The Talmudic references are translated as printed and were not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: crusheth all these
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol elin* — all these kinds of metals that you saw in the image.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall it break in pieces and crush
Daniel.english_translation: *Tedik vetera'* — it will crush and shatter.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: part of potters’ clay
Daniel.english_translation: *Chasaf di fachar* — a potter's clay; and there are many in the Gemara: *mani defachra*.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it shall be a divided kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Malkhu pelighah tehevei* — a divided kingdom it will be: two kings will come from it at once, one strong and one weak, as explained below: *min ketzat malkhuta tehevei takifa* (“part of the kingdom shall be strong”).
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted Aramaic is Daniel 2:42 (JPS: “so part of the kingdom shall be strong, and part thereof broken”); no reference is printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there shall be in it of the firmness of the iron
Daniel.english_translation: *Umin nitzvata di farzela lehevei vah* — even the weak one will be strong over others through the strength of his companion, for they will fear him; and this is *min nitzvata di farzela lehevei vah*: from the strength of the standing of the iron, there will be in the weak king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel di chazeitah* — in view of what you saw: iron mixed with clay of mud.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they shall mingle themselves by the seed of men
Daniel.english_translation: *Mit'arvin lehon bezera enasha* etc. — they will intermarry with the rest of the nations, and will not be whole and cleave to them in truth and with a whole heart, and their laws are different from the laws of the other nations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: even as iron doth not mingle with clay
Daniel.english_translation: *Ha kedi farzela lo mit'arav* — is it not so, that iron does not cleave well with clay.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in the days of those kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvyomeihon di malkhaya inun* — in the days of these kings, while the kingdom of the Romans still stands.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Yekim elah shemaya* — the kingdom of the Holy One, blessed be He, whose kingdom shall never be destroyed; and it is the kingdom of the King Messiah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms
Daniel.english_translation: *Tedek vetasef* — it will crush and finish all these kingdoms.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Forasmuch as thou sawest that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel di chazit* — in view of what you saw, that a stone was torn from the mountain that crushed the whole image: this is the interpretation, that the fifth kingdom will finish and shatter them all.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: what shall come to pass hereafter
Daniel.english_translation: *Mah di lehevei acharei denah* — what will be after this, after this kingdom of yours.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the dream is certain
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyatziv chelma* — the dream is true.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odours unto him
Daniel.english_translation: *Amar lenasakhah* — he wanted to make him a god.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Of a truth it is
Daniel.english_translation: *Min kushat* — in truth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the Lord of kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Umara malkin* — master of the masters.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to reveal this secret
Daniel.english_translation: *Raza denah* — this secret.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king made Daniel great
Daniel.english_translation: *LeDaniel rabbei* — he made Daniel great over all the officers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: over the affairs of the province of Babylon
Daniel.english_translation: *Umanni al avidata di medinat Bavel* — and he appointed over all the needs of the kingdoms Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold
Daniel.english_translation: *Avad* etc. — he filled his heart to make an image of gold.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the breadth thereof six cubits
Daniel.english_translation: *Pitiah amin shit akimeih* etc. — if its thickness is only six, how can it stand at a height of sixty cubits? Rav Bibi said: they stand it up and it falls, until they brought all the gold of Jerusalem and poured *dimus* on its feet, to fulfil what is said (Ezekiel 7) “and their gold shall be as an unclean thing.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Ezekiel 7” is Ezekiel 7:19 (JPS: “their gold shall be as an unclean thing”); here the printed wording matches the verse. The word *dimus* is left untranslated.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the plain of Dura
Daniel.english_translation: *Bevik'at Dura* — the name of a place.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the satraps
Daniel.english_translation: *La'achashdarpenaya* — dukes.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the prefects
Daniel.english_translation: *Pachavata* — rulers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs
Daniel.english_translation: *Adargazeraya gedavraya* etc. — all of them are gentile names.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed abbreviation עכו"ם is rendered “gentile”; whether it means “gentile” or “idolatry” here is not resolved.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to the dedication of the image
Daniel.english_translation: *Lachanukat tzalma* — the beginning of its service.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the herald cried aloud
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekharoza kare bechayil* — the herald goes out with great strength.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: To you it is commanded, O peoples, nations, and languages
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekhon amrin amemaya* — to you the peoples and the languages are saying, from the herald, the command of the king, in the king's mission.
Daniel.translator_note: Translated literally; the printed sentence is difficult and its construction is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the sound of the horn, pipe
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'idna ditshema'un kol karna mashrokita* — the sound of the horn that whistles, like (Zechariah 10) “I will hiss for them and gather them.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Zechariah 10” is Zechariah 10:8 (JPS: “I will hiss for them, and gather them”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: harp, trigon, psaltery, bagpipe
Daniel.english_translation: *Katros savkha* etc. — all of them are musical instruments.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: all kinds of music
Daniel.english_translation: *Zenei zemara* — kinds of music, each after its kind; Targum (ת"א): *lezanohi*.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ת"א is left as printed; the Aramaic is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: burning fiery furnace
Daniel.english_translation: *Atun nura* — a pit that is made for burning stones into lime, and it is the *kivshan* everywhere in Scripture.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Therefore at that time
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — in view of this, that they were careful of the king's command on this account.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: at that time
Daniel.english_translation: *Bah zemana* — at that time, when they hear the sound of the music, which is the sign that those who prostrate themselves should come to prostrate, “all the peoples fell,” etc.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Wherefore at that time
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — in view of this, that the enemies of the Jews saw that there was an hour to inform against them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews
Daniel.english_translation: *Keriv gavrin Kasdai'in va'akhalu kartzehon* — they informed against them. “Thou shalt not go as a talebearer” (Leviticus 19) we translate “and you shall not eat *kurtzin*”; and I say that this was the custom of talebearers, to eat a morsel in the place where they inform, and it is a sign that the words stand: that from that hour they are obliged to substantiate their words and verify the evil speech that they said; and that meal is called “eating *kurtzin*,” from the expression “he winks (*koretz*) with his eyes” (Proverbs 6), which is a sign of evil speech.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Leviticus 19” is Leviticus 19:16 (JPS: “Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people”) and “Proverbs 6” is Proverbs 6:13 (JPS: “That winketh with his eyes”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: They spoke and said
Daniel.english_translation: *Ano ve'amrin* — they cried out; every *aniyah* in Scripture is an expression of a loud voice.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: hast made a decree
Daniel.english_translation: *Samt te'em* — a decree of a matter.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: There are certain Jews
Daniel.english_translation: *Iti* — there is.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: certain Jews
Daniel.english_translation: *Yehuda'in* — from the tribe of Judah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: these men
Daniel.english_translation: *Alekh* — these. *Lo samu* — they did not heed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have not regarded thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Alakh malka te'em* — they did not trouble to give counsel for themselves to be concerned about your decrees.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego
Daniel.english_translation: *Amar lehetaya* — he commanded to bring.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then were these men brought before the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Hetayu* — they were brought.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Is it true
Daniel.english_translation: *Hatzda* — perhaps my decrees are *tzedu* and desolation, and an empty thing in your eyes, you, Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego, that you do not serve my god; the *he* of *hatzda* serves as an expression of astonishment.
Daniel.translator_note: The first clause is translated literally; the word *tzedu* is left untranslated and the sentence's construction is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which I have set up
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hakimet* — that I have set up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Now if you be ready
Daniel.english_translation: *Ken hen itaikhon atidin* — now you are destined, against your will, to accept this upon yourselves.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but if you worship not, you shall be cast
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehen lo tisgedun* — and if you do not prostrate yourselves, you will be thrown.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: into the midst of a burning fiery furnace
Daniel.english_translation: *Lego* — into.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: who is the god that shall deliver you out of my hands
Daniel.english_translation: *Umin hu elah* — and who is any god who will save you from my hands?

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: O Nebuchadnezzar
Daniel.english_translation: *Lemalka Nevukhadnetzar* — why was his name mentioned? Rather, thus they said to him: if it is to accept your decree to give *masin*, *arnoniyot* and *gulgaliyot*, you are king over us; if it is to deny the Holy One, blessed be He, Nebuchadnezzar, you are the lowliest of men in our eyes, and despised among peoples.
Daniel.translator_note: The words *masin*, *arnoniyot* and *gulgaliyot* (kinds of taxes) are left untranslated.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: we have no need to answer thee in this matter
Daniel.english_translation: *Lo chashchin anachna* — we do not concern ourselves about this to take counsel what to answer you, for the answer is ready and fluent in our mouths.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: is able to deliver us
Daniel.english_translation: *Yakhil leshezavutana* — is able to save us from every trouble.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and out of thy hand, O king
Daniel.english_translation: *Min atun nura* — “and from your hand, O king,” He will deliver from the furnace, and from your hand He will save.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: But if not
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehen lo* — and if He does not wish to save our bodies, let it be known to you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: filled with fury
Daniel.english_translation: *Hitmeli chema* — he was filled with wrath.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the form of his visage was changed
Daniel.english_translation: *Utzelem anpohi ishtanni* — and the features of his face changed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: heat the furnace
Daniel.english_translation: *Lemezei le'atuna* — to kindle the fiery furnace and to heat it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: seven times more than it was wont to be heated
Daniel.english_translation: *Chad shiv'ah al di chazeh lemezeih* — over one, seven times what they had measured up to its heating, as if they kindled it seven measures like it.
Daniel.translator_note: Translated literally; the printed sentence is difficult and its construction is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: wont to be heated
Daniel.english_translation: *Lemezeih* — to heat it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: mighty men that were in his army
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulegavrin gavrei chayil di bechayleih* — and to men mighty in strength who are in his army.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego
Daniel.english_translation: *Amar likhfatah* — he commanded to bind them, because he saw them strengthening themselves to answer him harshly, and he said: these are mighty; and he commanded the mighty men who were in his army to bind them.
Daniel.translator_note: The Hebrew verb *la'anoto* (“to answer him” or “to afflict”) is translated “to answer him”; the reading is not certain.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then these men were bound
Daniel.english_translation: *Gavraya alekh* — these men.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: bound in their cloaks
Daniel.english_translation: *Kefitu besarbaleihon* — they were bound in their wrapping garments.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their tunics, and their robes
Daniel.english_translation: *Patesheihon vekharbeletehon* — kinds of royal clothing that they had; and although they were going out to be judged before Nebuchadnezzar with the laws of death, they did not change their clothes so as to lower their greatness. From here the Sages learned that even in a time of danger a man should not change from the authority in which he is established.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their robes
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekharbeletehon* — it has an example (I Chronicles 15) “and David was wrapped (*mekhurbal*).”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “I Chronicles 15” is I Chronicles 15:27 (JPS: “And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace
Daniel.english_translation: *Uremiyu legov atun nura* — and they were thrown into the burning furnace.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Therefore because the king’s commandment was peremptory
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — in view of this, for the king's command was harsh.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the furnace exceeding hot
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'atuna azah yatira* — and the furnace was heated greatly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego
Daniel.english_translation: *Gavraya alekh* — these mighty men who bound Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah and cast them into the furnace.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the flame of the fire slew
Daniel.english_translation: *Katil hamon shevivah di nura* — the force of the spark of the fire burned them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: fell down bound
Daniel.english_translation: *Mekhaftin* — bound.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: was alarmed
Daniel.english_translation: *Tevah* — astonished.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: rose up in haste
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekam behitbehalah* — and stood in haste.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: They answered and said unto the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Anayin ve'amrin* — answering and saying to the king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: True, O king
Daniel.english_translation: *Yatziva malka* — the king's word is true.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire
Daniel.english_translation: *Sharayin mehalekhin bego nura* — released from their bonds and walking in the fire.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they have no hurt
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechavol lo iti vehon* — and there is no injury in them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the appearance of the fourth
Daniel.english_translation: *Verevah di* — the fourth, and the appearance of the fourth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: like a son of the gods
Daniel.english_translation: *Damei levar elahin* — like the angel that I saw when I was with Sennacherib, when his hosts were burned, as it is said (Isaiah 37) “and smote in the camp of Assyria”; and Nebuchadnezzar was there and escaped among ten who escaped from them.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Isaiah 37” is Isaiah 37:36 (JPS: “and smote in the camp of the Assyrians”); the printed wording differs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace
Daniel.english_translation: *Kerev* — to the door of the fiery furnace he drew near, to the gate of the courtyard in which the furnace was, to speak with them; and at first he was seeing them from afar.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: come forth, and come hither
Daniel.english_translation: *Fuku ve'etu* — come out and come; and he did not say to them, go up and come; from here we learn that the floor of the furnace rose and became level with the ground, so that they would not trouble to go up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came forth out of the midst of the fire
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'edayin nefaku* — although they were confident of the miracle done for them, their hearts did not allow them to belittle the monarchy by going out without permission.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king’s ministers, being gathered together
Daniel.english_translation: *Umitkanshin achashdarpenaya* — four nations were counted above in the first assembly that were not counted here: *adargazraya, detavraya, gedavraya, tiftaya* — these are the mighty men of the army whom the spark of the fire killed when they cast Hananiah and his friends into the fire.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: saw these men
Daniel.english_translation: *Chazayin legavraya alekh* — they see these men, Hananiah and his friends.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the fire had no power upon their bodies
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo shelet nura big'shamehon* — that the fire had no power over their bodies.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their bodies
Daniel.english_translation: *Gishmehon* — their bodies, in the Aramaic language, and there are many in this book.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: nor was the hair of their head singed
Daniel.english_translation: *Usa'ar rashehon lo hitcharakh* — the hair of their heads was not singed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: neither were their cloaks changed
Daniel.english_translation: *Lo shenu* — they were not changed from their appearance.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: nor had the smell of fire passed on them
Daniel.english_translation: *Lo adat behon* — it did not turn aside into them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said
Daniel.english_translation: *Ane Nevukhadnetzar* — Nebuchadnezzar cried out.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that trusted in Him
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hitrachetzu aloh* — who trusted in Him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have changed the king’s word
Daniel.english_translation: *Umillat malka shanniu* — and they changed the king's word, so as not to fulfil it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have yielded their bodies
Daniel.english_translation: *Vihavu gishmehon* — and they delivered their bodies.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: except their own God
Daniel.english_translation: *Le'elahehon* — except for their God.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I make a decree
Daniel.english_translation: *Sim te'em* — that is, a statute shall be set.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which speak any thing amiss
Daniel.english_translation: *Di yemar shalu* — his, who shall say an error; that is, any matter of disgrace.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall be cut in pieces
Daniel.english_translation: *Hadamin* — limbs; that is, they will cut him into limbs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their houses shall be made a dunghill
Daniel.english_translation: *Nevalu yishtavei* — a refuse heap will be made.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: no other god that is able to deliver after this sort
Daniel.english_translation: *Di yakhil lehatzalah khidnah* — that is able to save thus.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king promoted Shadrach
Daniel.english_translation: *Hatzlach* — he made them prosper and magnified them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: unto all peoples, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth
Daniel.english_translation: *Nevukhadnetzar malka lekhol amemaya* — this is the form of the writing of the letter: Nebuchadnezzar the king, inquiring after the peace of all the peoples.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: It hath seemed good unto me to declare
Daniel.english_translation: *Shefar kadamai lechavayah* — it is good to me to tell.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: was at rest in my house
Daniel.english_translation: *Shelah havit bevaiti* — I was at ease.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: affrighted me
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyidachalunani* — and it threatened me and frightened me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: at the last Daniel came in before me
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad acharan* — and finally, at the last, Daniel was brought before me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: according to the name of my god
Daniel.english_translation: *Keshum elahi* — the idol of Babylon, Bel is its name; טשצר is a name of an expression of wisdom among the nations.
Daniel.translator_note: The word טשצר is left as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: no secret causeth thee trouble
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhol raz lo anes lakh* — and nothing hidden is forced, nor concealed from you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The tree grew, and was strong
Daniel.english_translation: *Revah ilana vetakif* — the tree grew and was strengthened and became mighty.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: reached unto heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Yimta leshemaya* — it reached the heavens.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The leaves thereof were fair
Daniel.english_translation: *Ofyeh shappir* — its branch was fair.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the fruit thereof much
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'inbeh sagi* — its fruit was much.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in it was food for all
Daniel.english_translation: *Mazon lekhola veh* — and enough food for every creature was in it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The beasts of the field had shadow under it
Daniel.english_translation: *Titlal* — an expression of shade.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the fowls of the heaven dwelt
Daniel.english_translation: *Yedurun* — an expression of dwelling and lodging.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: all flesh was fed of it
Daniel.english_translation: *Yitzon* — an expression of food.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed
Daniel.english_translation: *Chazeh havit* — I was seeing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a watcher and a holy one came down from heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'ilu ir vekadish* — and behold, an angel who is awake (*er*) forever, and holy.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: He cried aloud
Daniel.english_translation: *Kera vechayil* — cries out with strength.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Hew down the tree
Daniel.english_translation: *Gudu ilana* — cut down the tree.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Shake off its leaves
Daniel.english_translation: *Atru ofyeh* — shed and fell its branches.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: scatter its fruit
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvaddaru inbeh* — scatter its fruit.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Let the beasts get away from under it
Daniel.english_translation: *Tenud cheyuta min tachohi* — the beasts shall flee from under it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: leave the stump of its roots in the earth
Daniel.english_translation: *Baram ikar shorshohi be'ara shevoku* — but the stump of its roots leave.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Even in a band of iron and brass
Daniel.english_translation: *Uve'esor di farzel unechash* — that is, put his feet in iron fetters, as they do to a horse, which they put in באפר, so his fetters in fetters.
Daniel.translator_note: The word באפר and the comparison with the horse are translated literally; their sense is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in the tender grass of the field
Daniel.english_translation: *Bedeta* — in the herb of the field; that is, in the meadow, so that he not move from there.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: let it be wet with the dew of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Yitzteva* — he shall be steeped always; an expression of immersion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: let his portion be with the beasts
Daniel.english_translation: *Chalakeh* — his portion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: let seven times pass over him
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshiv'ah iddanin* — seven years.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: pass over him
Daniel.english_translation: *Yachlefun alohi* — they will pass over him by this decree.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the sentence by the word of the holy ones
Daniel.english_translation: *She'eilta* — a decree; and because they take counsel with the Holy One, blessed be He, before they decree the decree, it calls it *she'eilta* (“a question”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: To the intent that the living may know
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad divrat* — like “in order that” (*lema'an*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the living may know
Daniel.english_translation: *Di yinde'un chayaya* — that all the living may know.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: giveth it to whomsoever He will
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulemen di yitzbe* — to whom He wills.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: declare the interpretation
Daniel.english_translation: *Fishra* — its interpretation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but thou art able
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ant kahal* — and you are able.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was appalled for a while
Daniel.english_translation: *Adayin Daniel* — he was astonished, was silent.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his thoughts affrighted him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ure'ayonohi* — and his thoughts.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: affright thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Yevahaluneh* — for he was afraid to interpret the dream for him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: My lord, the dream be to them that hate thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Mari* — my lord. Our Rabbis said: *mari chelma lesan'akh* is holy: he raised his eyes to the Holy One, blessed be He, and said: this dream shall be fulfilled upon this one who hates you. And if you say that he said it to Nebuchadnezzar — but are not Israel his enemy? Is it possible that he would curse them?
Daniel.translator_note: The middle sentence (“upon this one who hates you”) is translated literally; its sense is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to thine adversaries
Daniel.english_translation: *Le'arakh* — to your haters, like “and he became thine adversary” (I Samuel 25).
Daniel.translator_note: The printed words are close to I Samuel 28:16 (JPS: “and is become thine adversary”); the printed chapter number “25” does not match, and the quoted form is not exactly that of the verse.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it is the decree of the Most High, which is come upon my lord the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Di metat al: mari malka* — that has reached my lord the king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou shalt be driven from men
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulakh taredin min anasha* — and they will drive you out from among men.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shalt be wet with the dew of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Lakh matz'vi'in* — they will immerse you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: seven times shall pass over thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshiv'ah iddanin yachlefun alakh* — it may be said: a recompense for the Temple that he destroyed, which was built in seven years.
Daniel.translator_note: The abbreviation בה"מ is read as “the Temple.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedi amaru* etc. — that they said to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, and this is the interpretation: “your kingdom is established for you” — the kingdom stands for you; in the end your kingdom will return to you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule
Daniel.english_translation: *Min di tinda di shalitin shemaya* — after you know that the Upper Ones rule in the world.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahen malka* — in truth you are king; hear my counsel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my counsel
Daniel.english_translation: *Melki* — my counsel, like “I will advise you, I will counsel you.”
Daniel.translator_note: The comparison phrase is translated literally as printed; its source is not given.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: be acceptable unto thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Yishpar alakh* — my counsel will be good in your eyes, to hear the words.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: break off thy sins by almsgiving
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechata'akh bitzdakah feruk* — and break off your sin by charity from upon your neck.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thine iniquities by showing mercy to the poor
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'avayatakh bemachan aniyin* — and loosen your iniquities by showing favour to the poor.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: if there may be a lengthening of thy prosperity
Daniel.english_translation: *Hen tehevei arkha leshelevatakh* — perhaps there will be a delay of your peace, so that the evil does not hasten to come. And why did Daniel give good counsel to Nebuchadnezzar? He saw Israel, poor, lowly exiles, going around at the doors, and he gave him counsel to be gracious to them. He said to him: these poor whom you exiled are hungry; sustain them. And so he did: he opened his treasuries and sustained them for all twelve months.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar
Daniel.english_translation: *Kela meta* — the whole interpretation came upon Nebuchadnezzar.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he was walking upon the royal palace of Babylon
Daniel.english_translation: *Mehalekh havah* — he was walking.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Is not this great Babylon
Daniel.english_translation: *Halo da hi* — he heard poor people coming to the door and crying out; he said: what is the sound of this multitude in my ears? His servants said to him: these are the poor for whom you set a time for their sustenance. He said: “Is not this great Babylon,” and so on, and had I not squandered my treasuries for the sustenance of the poor, from where would I have built all these palaces? From now on I will not sustain them. So expounded Rabbi Tanchuma.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for the glory of my majesty
Daniel.english_translation: *Veliyekar hadari* — and for the honour of my splendour.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the kingdom is departed from thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Od millata befum malka: adat minnakh* — it has turned away from you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou shalt be driven from men
Daniel.english_translation: *Tardin* — an expression of expulsion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar
Daniel.english_translation: *Sefat* — the decree was completed upon him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his body was wet with the dew of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Gishmeh* — his body.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his hair was grown like eagles’ feathers
Daniel.english_translation: *Se'areh keneshrin ravah* — his hairs grew over his whole body like the wings of eagles.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his nails like birds
Daniel.english_translation: *Utefrohi kitzefarin* — and his nails like a bird's.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And at the end of the days
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulektzat yomaya* — at the end of the days that were fixed for him, at the end of the seven years.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: lifted up mine eyes unto heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Netalet* — I lifted.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: mine understanding returned unto me
Daniel.english_translation: *Umanda'i alai yitav* — and my mind returned to me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I blessed the Most High
Daniel.english_translation: *Ule'ila berakhet* — and I blessed the Most High.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: are reputed as nothing
Daniel.english_translation: *Kelah chashivin* — our Rabbis said: this *chirga deyoma* is not called “dust seen in the sun.”
Daniel.translator_note: The word *chirga* is left untranslated and the comment is translated literally; its sense is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: He doeth according to His will in the host of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhimtzivei avad bechayil shemaya* — and as He wills He does with the host of heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: none can stay His hand
Daniel.english_translation: *Vela iti di yimcheh bideih* — and there is none who will strike at His hand.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: At the same time
Daniel.english_translation: *Bah zemana* — at that time.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for the glory of my kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Veliyekar malkhuti hadari* — and to the honour of my kingdom I returned.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my splendour
Daniel.english_translation: *Vezivai* — and the appearance of my face.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my ministers and my lords sought unto me
Daniel.english_translation: *Velei hadavrai verav'revanai yivun* — and my counsellors and my officers were seeking me and desiring that I return.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I was established in my kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Hitkenet* — I was established.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: surpassing greatness was added unto me
Daniel.english_translation: *Verabu yatirah hosafet li* — and a greater greatness than the first was added to me. Our Rabbis said that he rode on a lion and bound a serpent on its head.
Daniel.translator_note: The Hebrew “on its head” (*berosho*) could also be read “on his head”; it is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: His ways justice
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'orchatah din* — and His ways are justice.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: those that walk in pride He is able to abase
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedi mehalekhin begevah* — and those who walk in pride He is able to bring low.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Belshazzar the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Belshatzar malka* — he was his son, and reigned after Evil-Merodach, who reigned in the place of Nebuchadnezzar; and also (he) was a son of Nebuchadnezzar.
Daniel.translator_note: “His son” is not specified in the printed sentence, and the identification is left as printed. The word “(he)” in parentheses is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: made a great feast
Daniel.english_translation: *Avad lechem rav* — he made a great feast. We find in Sefer Yosippon that he fought by day with Darius the Mede and Cyrus and won the battle, and in the evening made a feast, as Isaiah prophesied of him: “Prepare the table, set the watch, eat, drink; arise, you princes,” etc.; for in the midst of the feast his enemies returned and fought against the city and captured it.
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are Isaiah 21:5 (JPS: “They prepare the table, they light the lamps, they eat, they drink— ‘Rise up, you princes, anoint the shield’”); no reference is printed, and the printed wording differs from the verse. Sefer Yosippon is named as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: drank wine before the thousand
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulekubal alfa chamra* — opposite a thousand men he was drinking wine.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: while he tasted the wine
Daniel.english_translation: *Amar bete'em chamra* — he said by the counsel of the wine, for he was drunk.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: commanded to bring
Daniel.english_translation: *Lehetaya* — to bring.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hanpek* — that he took out.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his consorts
Daniel.english_translation: *Shegaltah* — an expression for “queen” in the Aramaic language, as in (Nehemiah 2) “and the queen (*hashegal*) sitting by him.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Nehemiah 2” is Nehemiah 2:6 (JPS: “the queen also sitting by him”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then they brought the golden vessels
Daniel.english_translation: *Hetayu* — they were brought.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that were taken out of the temple of the house of God
Daniel.english_translation: *Di hanpeku* — that they took out.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came forth fingers of a man’s hand
Daniel.english_translation: *Nefaku: etzba'an* — the fingers of a man's hand came out from heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: over against the candlestick
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekubal nevreshta* — opposite the lampstand that is in front of the table; and its like in tractate Yoma: “she made a golden *nivreshet*.”
Daniel.translator_note: The Talmudic reference is translated as printed and was not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: upon the plaster of the wall
Daniel.english_translation: *Al gira* — on the lime plaster of the wall of the house, like (Isaiah 27) “like chalkstones beaten in pieces,” and it resembles lime.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Isaiah 27” is Isaiah 27:9 (JPS: “as chalkstones that are beaten in pieces”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king’s countenance was changed in him
Daniel.english_translation: *Zivohi shanohi* — his appearance changed on him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his thoughts affrighted him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ur'ayonohi* — his thoughts.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the joints of his loins were loosed
Daniel.english_translation: *Uktarei chartzeih meshtaran* — the girdle of his loins was loosened: for his loins were emptied from fear, and his belt loosened.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: were loosed
Daniel.english_translation: *Uktarei chartzeih meshtaran* — they were loosened (*netarim*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his knees
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'arkuvateih* — and his knees.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: smote one against another
Daniel.english_translation: *Da leda nakshan* — striking and knocking.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The king cried aloud
Daniel.english_translation: *Bechayil* — with strength.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to bring in the enchanters
Daniel.english_translation: *Lehe'alah* — to bring in.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Whosoever shall read this writing
Daniel.english_translation: *Ketava denah* — this writing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall be clothed with purple
Daniel.english_translation: *Argevana yilbash* — according to the custom of the *partemim*.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a chain of gold about his neck
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehamniyakha* — a necklace, a chain.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall rule as one of three in the kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Utlati bemalkhuta yishlat* — he will rule as a third of the kingdom.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then came in all the king’s wise men
Daniel.english_translation: *Alin* — entering.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: greatly affrighted
Daniel.english_translation: *Sagi mitbahal* — greatly afraid.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his lords were perplexed
Daniel.english_translation: *Mishtabbashin* — hastened.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house
Daniel.english_translation: *Malkheta lekubal mellei malka* — the queen, since she heard the words of the king and his officers, came to the banquet house.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods
Daniel.english_translation: *Iti gevar* — there is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of holy ones.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: like the wisdom of the gods
Daniel.english_translation: *Kechokhmat elahin* — angels.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: made him master of the magicians
Daniel.english_translation: *Hakimeih* — appointed him chief over them all.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: forasmuch as a surpassing spirit
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel* etc. — since a surpassing spirit and knowledge of understanding are in him, and the telling of riddles.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: loosing of knots
Daniel.english_translation: *Umeshare ketrin* — sealed: every secret was found in him, in Daniel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: if thou canst read the writing
Daniel.english_translation: *Tekhal* — if you are able.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Let thy gifts be to thyself
Daniel.english_translation: *Unevizbeitakh* — your gifts.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: give thy rewards to another
Daniel.english_translation: *Le'acharan hav* — give to another.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whom he would he slew
Daniel.english_translation: *Di havah tzave* — to whom he desired.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whom he would he kept alive
Daniel.english_translation: *Havah macheh* — he gives life (*mechayyeh*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when his heart was lifted up
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhedi ram levaveih* — and when his heart was lifted up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that he dealt proudly
Daniel.english_translation: *Lehazadah* — to act wickedly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he was deposed from his kingly throne
Daniel.english_translation: *Hanchat* — he brought down.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his glory was taken from him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ha'adiyu minneh* — they removed from him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he was driven from the sons of men
Daniel.english_translation: *Tarid* — expelled.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: hast not humbled thy heart, though thou knewest all this
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel di kol denah yeda't* — in view of the fact that you knew all this that happened to your father, you should have been afraid before the Holy One, blessed be He.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the palm of the hand sent from before Him
Daniel.english_translation: *Shelich pasa di yeda* — the palm of a hand was sent.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: this writing was inscribed
Daniel.english_translation: *Uchtava denah reshim* — and this writing, which He engraved.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: MENE, God hath numbered thy kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Mene mene* — “God numbered”; that is, *mene* — this is its interpretation: God numbered your kingdom.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: brought it to an end
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehashlamah* — He reckoned the end, that the kingdom of your father and his seed was cut off, and found that it had already been completed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting
Daniel.english_translation: *Tekel tekilta bemozanaya* — *tekel*: this is its interpretation: you were weighed before Him in scales, and found lacking of all righteousness.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians
Daniel.english_translation: *Peres perisat malkhutakh* etc. — that is, *ufarsin* implies two *parsin*: the one, “the division (*perisat*) of your kingdom” — your kingdom is broken; and the second, that it was given to Media and Persia.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Darius the Mede received the kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedaryavesh Madaah kabbel malkhuta kevar shenin shitin utarte'in* — why did he count his years? To tell you: on the day Nebuchadnezzar entered the Sanctuary in the days of Jehoiakim (should read: Jehoiachin), his adversary Darius was born; from the exile of Jeconiah until here, sixty-two years. And the Master said: they were exiled in the days of Jehoiachin, in the seventh [year] of the conquest of Jehoiakim, which is the eighth of Nebuchadnezzar; there remained for Nebuchadnezzar thirty-seven [years], for he reigned forty-five; and the twenty-three of Evil-Merodach, as our Rabbis said in tractate Megillah; two that they served Belshazzar: behold, sixty-two.
Daniel.translator_note: The parenthesis “(should read: Jehoiachin)” is a later printed editorial insertion. The chronology is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: over them three presidents
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ela minhon* — and above them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that these satraps might give account unto them
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lehevon achashdarpenaya* — that these satraps should give counsel to the three governors (*afarkhin*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king should have no damage
Daniel.english_translation: *Umalka lo lehevei nazik* — and the king shall not be damaged in any matter of the kingdom that is imposed on them to do.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: this Daniel distinguished himself
Daniel.english_translation: *Daniel denah* — this Daniel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: distinguished himself
Daniel.english_translation: *Mitnatzeach* — prevailing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king thought to set him over the whole realm
Daniel.english_translation: *Umalka asit* — the king was thinking in his heart to establish him over all.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: sought to find occasion against Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Havo be'ayin alah* — they were seeking a pretext to find against Daniel in a matter of the kingdom, so that they could inform on him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo nashkach* — they said among themselves: we shall not find any pretext against this Daniel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: except we find it against him in the matter of the law of his God
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahen hashkachna alohi* — but we shall find a pretext against him through the Torah of his God: if we can request from the king some decree, that he decree to make him transgress his Torah, and he will not fulfil the king's command, and behold, the pretext.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came tumultuously to the king
Daniel.english_translation: *Hargishu* — they pressed upon the king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have consulted together
Daniel.english_translation: *Itye'atu* — they took counsel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: establish a statute, and make a strong interdict
Daniel.english_translation: *Likayyamah kayyam malka* — to hold fast to the king's law with force, because you have come to reign anew and are from another province, and it needs strengthening.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whosoever shall ask a petition
Daniel.english_translation: *Di yeva be'o* — who will request any request.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: save of thee, O king
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahen minnakh malka* — except from you, the king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: cast into the den of lions
Daniel.english_translation: *Legov aryevata* — into the pit where the king's lions are.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: establish the interdict
Daniel.english_translation: *Tekim esara* — establish this statute.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that it be not changed
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo lehashniyah* — not to change it, like the law of Media and Persia.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which altereth not
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo ta'dei* — that it not pass away.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when Daniel knew that the writing was signed
Daniel.english_translation: *Kedi yeda* — and when he knew.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: now his windows were open in his upper chamber
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhavin petichin leh be'alitah* — in his upper room.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: toward Jerusalem
Daniel.english_translation: *Neged Yerushalem* — toward the Temple; and although it was destroyed, he did as Solomon said, “and they shall pray to Thee by the way of their land” (I Kings 8).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “I Kings 8” is I Kings 8:48 (JPS: “and pray unto Thee toward their land”); the printed wording differs from the verse. The abbreviation בה"מ is read as “the Temple.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: three times a day
Daniel.english_translation: *Uzmanin tlatah* — evening, morning and afternoon [prayers].

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: kneeled upon his knees
Daniel.english_translation: *Barekh al birkohi* — kneeling on his knees.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as he did aforetime
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol kevel di havah avad* etc. — like all that he used to do before this.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then these men came tumultuously
Daniel.english_translation: *Hargishu* — they pressed and seized.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: concerning the king’s interdict
Daniel.english_translation: *Al esar malka* — concerning the nullification of the king's prohibition, for which they came to inform.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The thing is true
Daniel.english_translation: *Yatziva millata* — the matter is true.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: regardeth not thee, O king
Daniel.english_translation: *Lo sam alakh: malka te'em* — he did not pay attention or heed to be concerned about your decrees.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: maketh his petition three times a day
Daniel.english_translation: *Ba'e ba'uteih* — praying his prayer.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when he heard these words
Daniel.english_translation: *Kedi millata shema* — when he heard the matter.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: was sore displeased
Daniel.english_translation: *Sagi be'esh alohi* — it was very evil in his eyes, for he loved Daniel and his death was hard for him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: set his heart on Daniel to deliver him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al Daniel sam bal leshezavutei* — upon Daniel he set a postponement, to put off the matter in order to save him, and he said to them: I do not believe you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: set his heart
Daniel.english_translation: *Bal* — I do not know its like, but its subject indicates its interpretation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: till the going down of the sun
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad ma'alei shemasha* — until the sun came [to set] he was striving to save him; but when the time of his prayer came, he knelt to the Holy One, blessed be He, on his knees and prayed his prayer, and then he no longer had an opening of the mouth to save him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: no interdict nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed
Daniel.english_translation: *Di malka yehakem* — what the king decrees and it stands, no man can change.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a stone was brought
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehetet even chadah* — and one stone was brought. In all the land of Babylon there is no stone, only bricks, as is written “let us make bricks” (Genesis 11); we learn that there is no stone in Babylon, and for the moment angels brought it from the Land of Israel. Although He stipulated in the work of Creation concerning the sea, that it would split for Israel, and concerning the fire, that it would cool for Hananiah and his companions, and concerning the lions, that they not harm Daniel, He did not stipulate concerning the throwing of a stone and a weapon (*zayin*), that it should not harm a person. And the king said: from the lions it is impossible to remove it, for a decree has already been decreed; be careful with it, from harm by man; and the miracle, if it comes, will come, סא"א.
Daniel.translator_note: The final abbreviation סא"א is left as printed and not resolved, and the sentence beginning “from the lions” is translated literally; its construction is not resolved here. Printed “Genesis 11” is Genesis 11:3 (JPS: “Come, let us make brick”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: laid upon the mouth of the den
Daniel.english_translation: *Ushimat al pum geva* — it was placed on the mouth of the pit.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: sealed it with his own signet
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'izkatei* — with his ring, so that they would not move it from its place and throw stones on him to kill him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo tishne tzevu beDaniel* — that his will not be changed; that is, that no harm be done to him against his will (another version: according to their will).
Daniel.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ס"א is read as “another version,” and the parenthesis is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: passed the night fasting
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvat tavat* — he lodged in a fast.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: neither were diversions brought before him
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedachavan* — and a table, in the Mishnah; so Dunash interpreted: they did not bring a table before him to eat.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his sleep fled from him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ushenatah nadat alohi* — his sleep wandered.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: very early in the morning
Daniel.english_translation: *Bishefarpara* — at the rising of dawn; and there are many in Targum Yonatan.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king arose very early
Daniel.english_translation: *Yekum bin'ga* — he rose at the light of the morning, and not at the third hour like other kings.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: went in haste unto the den of lions
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvhitbehalah legova di aryevata azal* — and in haste to the pit of the lions he went.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have I done no hurt
Daniel.english_translation: *Chavulah lo avadet* — I did no ugly or false thing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then was the king exceeding glad
Daniel.english_translation: *Sagi te'av alohi* — it was very good in his eyes.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den
Daniel.english_translation: *UleDaniel* — and he commanded that Daniel be brought up from the pit.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: because he had trusted in his God
Daniel.english_translation: *Di heymin be'elaheh* — who believed in his God.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: those men that had accused Daniel
Daniel.english_translation: *Di akhalu kartzohi* — who informed against him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: had not come to the bottom of the den
Daniel.english_translation: *Vela matu le'ar'it geva* — they did not reach the bottom of the pit before the lions ruled over them, and crushed all their bones.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then king Darius wrote unto all the peoples
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'edayin Daryavesh malka* etc. — who dwell in all the land; he sent to all the land: may your peace increase.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in the reign of Cyrus the Persian
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvmalkhut Koresh* — who reigned after Darius, for Darius the Mede reigned only one year and was killed in battle, as is written in the book of Yosef ben Gurion; and they made Cyrus, his son-in-law, king over them in the midst of the army.
Daniel.translator_note: The book is named as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: then he wrote the dream
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'edayin chelma ketav* — then (he wrote the dream), and said the heads of the matters.
Daniel.translator_note: The words “(he wrote the dream)” are in parentheses in the printed text and are later printed insertions.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: behold, the four winds
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'aru* — and behold.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the four winds of the heaven broke forth upon the great sea
Daniel.english_translation: *Arba ruchei shemaya megichin* etc. — four winds blowing, coming from the four directions of the world, and fighting with the great sea and stirring it up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: four great beasts came up from the sea
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'arba cheivan* — and four beasts.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: diverse one from another
Daniel.english_translation: *Shenayan da min da* — differing from each other.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings
Daniel.english_translation: *Kadmayta ke'aryeh vegafin di nesher leh* — it is like a lion and has eagle's wings; this is the kingdom of Babylon, which was ruling at that hour, and so Jeremiah saw it, as it is said “a lion is gone up from his thicket” (Jeremiah 5), and it says “Behold, as an eagle he shall fly,” etc. (ibid. 48).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Jeremiah 5” (written 5:6) does not match the quoted words, which are Jeremiah 4:7 (JPS: “A lion is gone up from his thicket”); “ibid. 48” is Jeremiah 48:40 (JPS: “Behold, he shall swoop as a vulture”); the printed wording differs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the wings thereof were plucked off
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad di meritu gafeh* — its wings were plucked; this is a hint to its fall.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it was lifted up from the earth
Daniel.english_translation: *Unetilat min ar'a* — an expression: it was removed from the earth, a hint that the kingdom will be nullified from the earth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a man’s heart was given to it
Daniel.english_translation: *Velevav enash* — an expression of weakness, as “let the nations know they are but men” (Psalms 9).
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are Psalms 9:21 (JPS: “Let the nations know they are but men”); no reference is printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: another beast
Daniel.english_translation: *Acharei* — another.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a second
Daniel.english_translation: *Tinyanah* — the second that came up from the sea.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: like to a bear
Daniel.english_translation: *Damyah ledov* — this is a hint to the kingdom of Persia, which will reign after Babylon, who eat and drink like a bear, and are burdened with flesh like a bear.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: like to a bear
Daniel.english_translation: *Damyah ledov* — *ledov* is written [without a *vav*], like *diva*, the Aramaic of “wolf” (*ze'ev*), for the kingdom of Persia is also called a wolf, as is said “therefore a lion from the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the deserts shall spoil them.”
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are Jeremiah 5:6 (JPS: “Wherefore a lion out of the forest doth slay them, A wolf of the deserts doth spoil them”); no reference is printed. The bracketed words are the translator's explanation of the spelling.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it raised up itself on one side
Daniel.english_translation: *Velishtar chad hakimat* — and to one side it stood; a hint that when the kingdom of Babylon ceases, Persia will wait one year for Media to reign.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth
Daniel.english_translation: *Utlat ala'in befumah* — three ribs; our Rabbis explained: three provinces were always rebelling against it and making peace with it; sometimes it swallows them and sometimes it spits them out; this is “in its mouth”: between its teeth at times, outside its teeth at times, into them at times. And I say: three ribs are three kings who will stand for Persia: Cyrus, and Ahasuerus, and Darius who built the House.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: devour much flesh
Daniel.english_translation: *Besar sagi* — much flesh.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads
Daniel.english_translation: *Gafin arba* etc. — and the four heads are four rulers among whom Alexander of Macedon divided his kingdom at his death, as is written in the book of Yosef ben Gurion; for this third beast is the kingdom of Antiochus, and it is called a leopard (*namer*) because it decreed decrees on Israel that were spotted (*menumarot*) and different from one another.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: dominion was given to it
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshaltan yehiv lah* — and rule was given to it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I saw in the night visions
Daniel.english_translation: *Bechezvei leleya* — in another night: the first three he saw in one night, and this one in another night, because it is weighty against all three of them, in Vayikra Rabbah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it had great iron teeth
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshinnayin di farzel leh* — it has teeth of iron.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it devoured and broke in pieces
Daniel.english_translation: *Umedakkah* — it crushes and grinds fine.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: stamped the residue with its feet
Daniel.english_translation: *Ushe'ara* — the remainder of what it ate.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it had ten horns
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekarnin eser* — ten horns: this the angel explained to him, that they are ten kings who will arise for Rome before Vespasian, who destroyed the House.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and, behold, there came up among them another horn
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ilu* — like *va'aru*, an expression of “behold.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a mouth speaking great things
Daniel.english_translation: *Memallel rav'ervan* — words of pride; he is Titus, of whom our Sages of blessed memory said that he blasphemed and reviled, and entered the Sanctuary with impudence.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Till thrones were placed
Daniel.english_translation: *Di korsevan ramiyu* — thrones were cast and set up, to sit in judgment: one for judgment and one for righteousness for Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: one that was ancient of days did sit
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'attik yomin yetiv* — the Holy One, blessed be He, sits in judgment over this kingdom and over the one before it, who angered Him and oppressed His children.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: His raiment was as white snow
Daniel.english_translation: *Kitelag chivar* — to whiten the iniquities of His people.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the hair of his head like pure wool
Daniel.english_translation: *Usa'ar rishei ke'amar nakei* — He clears Himself of the merits that the gentiles have before Him, and pays them all their reward in this world; in Vayikra Rabbah.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed abbreviation עכו"ם is rendered “gentiles.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: A fiery stream issued
Daniel.english_translation: *Di nur* — of fire.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: A fiery stream
Daniel.english_translation: *Nur dalek* — burning fire.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came forth from before him
Daniel.english_translation: *Nagid venafik* — drawing, and goes out.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thousand thousands ministered unto him
Daniel.english_translation: *Yeshamshunneih* — to the Ancient of Days.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: The judgment was set
Daniel.english_translation: *Dina yetiv* — the judgment was seated before Him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the books were opened
Daniel.english_translation: *Visifrin petichu* — the books were opened: the books of the transgressions and the evils that they did.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke
Daniel.english_translation: *Min kal millaya* — from the voice of the lofty words that the horn speaks, the wrath of the Ancient of Days went up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: its body destroyed
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad di ketilat chevta veovad gishmah* — its body was destroyed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it was given to be burned with fire
Daniel.english_translation: *Liyekedat esha* — to a flame of fire: it is the fire of Jacob, “and the house of Jacob shall be a fire” (Obadiah 1).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Obadiah 1” is Obadiah 1:18 (JPS: “And the house of Jacob shall be a fire”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their dominion was taken away
Daniel.english_translation: *Ush'ar cheivata he'diyu shiltanhon* — and from the rest of the kingdoms they removed their dominion from the heavens.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their lives were prolonged for a season and a time
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'arkhah bechayin yehivat lehon* — and a time was given them in life until an appointed day, in the future to come: the wars of Gog and Magog.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: were prolonged
Daniel.english_translation: *Arkhah* — waiting.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: One like unto a son of man
Daniel.english_translation: *Kevar enash atah* — he is the King Messiah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he came even to the Ancient of days
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad attik yomaya* — who was sitting in judgment and judging the nations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he came
Daniel.english_translation: *Metah* — reached.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there was given him dominion
Daniel.english_translation: *Veleh yehiv shaltan* — and to that son of man was given the dominion of the nations. He compared the nations to beasts, and Israel he compared to a son of man, because they are humble and wholehearted.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which shall not pass away
Daniel.english_translation: *Di lo ya'dei* — will not depart.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my spirit was pained in the midst of my body
Daniel.english_translation: *Itkrit ruchi* — an expression of “when he digs” (Exodus 22); the Aramaic and Hebrew languages are the same in it; that is, my spirit was uprooted from the depth of its digging.
