Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Exodus 22” is Exodus 21:33 (JPS: “if a man shall dig a pit”); the printed wording differs from the verse.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in the midst of my body
Daniel.english_translation: *Bego nidneh* — in its case, its sheath; that is, my spirit was alarmed within the body by this dream.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I came near unto one of them that stood by
Daniel.english_translation: *Kerevet al chad min ka'maya* — I approached one of those standing there before the Ancient of Days. The angels are called “standing,” as is said (Zechariah 3) “among these that stand by,” because they have no *kefatzim*.
Daniel.translator_note: The word *kefatzim* is left untranslated; its sense here is not resolved. Printed “Zechariah 3” is Zechariah 3:7 (JPS: “free access among these that stand by”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: asked him the truth concerning all this
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyatziva avea minneh* — and the truth I asked of him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: are four kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Arba'ah malkhin* — four kingdoms.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyikablun malkhuta kaddishei elyonin* — these are Israel, who will take the kingdom from the fourth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then I desired to know the truth
Daniel.english_translation: *Adayin tzevit lei'tzava* — then I desired to stand on the truth concerning the fourth beast.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: which was diverse from all of them
Daniel.english_translation: *Di havat shanyah min* — that was different from all of them in additional terror.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: before which three fell
Daniel.english_translation: *Unefalah min* — before it, three; and three of the first fell before it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that horn that had eyes
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekarna dikhen ve'einin lah* — and the horn that is like this, and has eyes, as written above.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I beheld
Daniel.english_translation: *Chazeh havit* — in my first dream, which I related above.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: made war with the saints
Daniel.english_translation: *Im kaddishin* — with the people of Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: judgment was given for the saints of the Most High
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedina yehiv lekaddishei elyonin* — and He gave them vengeance upon it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Thus he said
Daniel.english_translation: *Ken amar* — thus the angel who interprets the dream for me answered me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as for the ten horns
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekarnaya eser* — and the ten horns that I saw on it: this is its interpretation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: out of this kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Minneh malkhuta* — from that kingdom.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: another shall arise after them
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'achran yekum achareihon* — and the last will arise after them; he is Titus.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall speak words against the Most High
Daniel.english_translation: *Letzad ila'ah* — toward above.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall wear out the saints of the Most High
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulekaddishei elyonin yeva'lei* — and Israel he will trouble and oppress.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall think to change the seasons and the law
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyisbar lehashnayah zimnin vedat* — he will imagine in his heart to make them transgress all their appointed times and their laws.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: until a time and times and half a time
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad iddan ve'iddanin uflag iddan* — this is a sealed end, as it was said to Daniel “seal the words” (Daniel 12), and the early ones expounded it each according to his understanding, and the ends have passed; and we must interpret it further, as I saw written in the name of Rav Saadia: they are one thousand three hundred and thirty-five years, mentioned at the end of the book, “Happy is he that waiteth,” etc.; and the explanation of the appointed time is “until a time, times and half a time.” And he said that the times are four hundred and eighty, from the day of their going out of Egypt until the House was built, and four hundred and ten, the days of the first Sanctuary: behold, eight hundred and ninety (תת"ץ); and further, half of this time, four hundred and forty-five (תמ"ה): behold, one thousand three hundred and thirty-five. Count these from the time the daily offering was removed until the daily offering returns to its place; and it was removed six years before the destruction, and there is some proof in this book. And further, some bring a proof for this reckoning: “I will surely hide (*haster astir*) My face” (Deuteronomy 31) is, in numerical value, one thousand three hundred and thirty-five.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed text uses “we must interpret it further” in the first person plural, translated as printed. The printed reference “Daniel 12” is Daniel 12:4 (JPS: “shut up the words, and seal the book”); “the end of the book” is Daniel 12:12 (JPS: “Happy is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days”); the Deuteronomy verse is 31:18 (JPS: “And I will surely hide My face in that day”). The printed sums (480 + 410 = 890; half of 890 = 445; 890 + 445 = 1335) were checked; the numerical value of the Hebrew words was not recomputed here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the judgment shall sit
Daniel.english_translation: *Vedina yetiv* — and the judgment was seated before the Omnipresent.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his dominions shall be taken away
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshaltaneh ye'dun* — and his rule and the dominion of that kingdom they will remove from heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: all dominions shall serve and obey them
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyishtam'un* — they will heed His commandment to do it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Here is the end of the matter
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad khah* — until here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my thoughts much affrighted me
Daniel.english_translation: *Sagi ra'yonai yevahalunani* — my thoughts were greatly alarming me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my countenance was changed in me
Daniel.english_translation: *Vezivai yishtanun* — the appearance of beauty and my form changed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I kept the matter in my heart
Daniel.english_translation: *Belibbi netart* — in my heart I hid it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar
Daniel.english_translation: *Bishnat shalosh* — after the first vision; after there was shown to me at first the dream mentioned above, which was shown to him in the first year of Belshazzar.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I was by the stream Ulai
Daniel.english_translation: *Al uval Ulai* — on the river whose name is Ulai.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a ram which had two horns
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo keranayim* — a hint to the kingdom of Persia and Media.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: one was higher than the other
Daniel.english_translation: *Veha'achat gevohah min hashenit* — a hint to the kingdom of Persia, which is greater than the kingdom of Media, for the kingdom of Media was only one year, as is said (below, 9) “in the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes”; and we learned in Seder Olam: we do not find a year of Media in Scripture except this one alone.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “below, 9” is Daniel 9:1 (JPS: “In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the higher came up last
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehagevohah olah ba'acharonah* — a hint that the kingdom of Media will precede the kingdom of Persia.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as I was considering
Daniel.english_translation: *Hayiti mevin* — I was looking at it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a he-goat
Daniel.english_translation: *Tzafir* — a he-goat (*sa'ir*).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: touched not the ground
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ein nogea ba'aretz* — it looked as if leaping in the air.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a conspicuous horn between his eyes
Daniel.english_translation: *Keren chazut* — a horn great to the sight of the eye.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he was moved with choler against him
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyitmarmar elav* — and he fought him; it is an expression of bitter anger.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the appearance of four horns
Daniel.english_translation: *Chazut arba* — the appearance of four horns.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: out of one of them came forth a little horn
Daniel.english_translation: *Umin ha'achat mehem* — and from one of these kingdoms.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: came forth a little horn
Daniel.english_translation: *Yatza keren achat* — the kingdom of Titus goes forth from it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a little horn
Daniel.english_translation: *Mitze'irah* — a diminished and despised kingdom, as they called above “one horn from small” (*mitze'irah*); and it is on the matter that is said “thou art greatly despised” (Obadiah 1).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Obadiah 1” is Obadiah 1:2 (JPS: “thou art greatly despised”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: waxed exceeding great
Daniel.english_translation: *Vatigdal yeter* — and it grew exceedingly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: toward the south
Daniel.english_translation: *El haNegev* — that is Egypt, which is to the south of the Land of Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: toward the beauteous land
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'el hatzvi* — the Land of Israel, which is called the “land of beauty,” as in the matter that is said “the inheritance of the beauty of the hosts of nations” (Jeremiah 3).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Jeremiah 3” is Jeremiah 3:19 (JPS: “The goodliest heritage of the nations”); the printed wording differs from the verse.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: even to the host of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad tzeva hashamayim* — they are Israel, who were likened to the stars.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: even to the prince of the host
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad sar hatzava* — that is the Temple, which is the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, the Prince of the host; against the Holy One, blessed be He, he blasphemed. “And from him —”
Daniel.translator_note: The comment ends with the first word of the next comment's lemma; this is left as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the continual burnt-offering was taken away
Daniel.english_translation: *Horam hatamid* — and by his troops and his forces that he sent to Jerusalem the daily offering was nullified, for Nero Caesar sent there the prince of his army, as our Rabbis said in tractate Gittin and in Gurion.
Daniel.translator_note: The reference “Gurion” (the book of Yosef ben Gurion) is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the host was given over to it together with the continual burnt-offering through transgression
Daniel.english_translation: *Vetzava tinnaten al hatamid befasha* — and an appointed time was given for the daily offering to be removed because of transgression; the “desolating” (*shomem*) one is idolatry [ע"ג], that is: idolatry [ע"ג] will be set in Jerusalem in place of the daily offering; and so it is called in this book in several places, as is said “How long the vision, the daily offering and the transgression that desolates,” and it says “from the time that the daily offering shall be taken away, and to set up the abomination that maketh desolate.”
Daniel.translator_note: The abbreviation (ע"ג / לע"ג) is read as “idolatry” (*avodat gilulim*); the printed form is kept in brackets. Reading from Rashi’s usage in this corpus and the context.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the host was given over to it
Daniel.english_translation: *Vetzava* — a time, as in “Is there not a time (*tzava*) appointed to man upon earth?” (Job 7).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Job 7” is Job 7:1 (JPS: “Is there not a time of service to man upon earth?”); the printed wording differs from the verse.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it cast down truth to the ground
Daniel.english_translation: *Vatashlekh emet artzah* — it brought down the Torah of truth.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I heard a holy one speaking
Daniel.english_translation: *Echad kadosh* — one of the angels.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: another holy one said
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayomer* — that angel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that certain one who spoke
Daniel.english_translation: *Lefalmoni* — behold, this word is like two: *lefloni almoni*; and Jonathan ben Uzziel translated it, in the book of Samuel, “hidden and concealed,” like “a matter too hard (*yippale*) for you”: *almoni*, *almon*, without a name; that it was not explained to him what it is, and what his name is.
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are close to Deuteronomy 17:8 (JPS: “If there arise a matter too hard for thee”); no reference is printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that certain one who spoke
Daniel.english_translation: *Lefalmoni hamedabber* — to the angel who was speaking and decreeing decrees: “and the appointed time shall be given over the daily offering through transgression.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: How long shall be the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad matai hechazon* — this one, which is over the daily offering, that it be removed, and the desolating transgression will be placed in its stead; “the desolating transgression” — idolatry [ע"א] of star-worshippers, which is like a silent stone; and so it is called in this book in several places, as is said “How long the vision, the daily offering and the transgression that desolates,” and it says (below, 12) “from the time the daily offering shall be taken away, and to set up the abomination that maketh desolate.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “below, 12” is Daniel 12:11. The abbreviation ע"א is read as “idolatry” from the context; the expansion is not confirmed by a permitted source, so the comment is flagged.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the transgression that causes appalment
Daniel.english_translation: *Shomem* — an expression of muteness and paralysis, like “he was astonished (*eshtomam*) for one hour” (above, 3) and “and I sat there astonished (*meshommim*) seven days among them” (Ezekiel 3), like dumb (*elem*).
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “above, 3” is Daniel 4:16 (JPS: “was appalled for a while”); “Ezekiel 3” is Ezekiel 3:15 (JPS: “and I remained there appalled among them seven days”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled under foot
Daniel.english_translation: *Tet vekodesh vetzava mirmas* — to give the foundation of the Sanctuary and the host of heaven, whom he threw to the earth, to be trampled under his feet, as it is written above, “and it cast down to the ground some of the host and of the stars.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: both the sanctuary and the host
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekodesh vetzava* — an extra *vav*, and there are many like these in Scripture: “cast into a dead sleep, and horse and rider” (Psalms 76), and even in the language of people there are those who speak thus.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Psalms 76” is Psalms 76:7 (JPS: “They are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses”); the printed wording differs. The point of the comment is the Hebrew letter *vav*.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Unto two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad erev boker alpayim ushlosh me'ot* — I saw an interpretation in the name of our teacher Saadia for this matter, and it has already passed; and he interpreted further: “until evening, morning” — until that evening comes of which it is said, “and it shall come to pass that at evening time there shall be light” (Zechariah 14); and we are confident that the word of our God shall stand forever, never to be annulled. And I say that the evening and morning mentioned here is a numerical value, and there is support for the matter from two reasons: one, that this reckoning will be exact with another reckoning at the end of the book; and the second, that Gabriel said to Daniel below on this subject, “and the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true”; and if the reckoning were not hinted, which depends on it, why did he repeat and double it, to say “it is true”? And the seer was commanded to seal and close the matter, and even it was not revealed in language not sealed and closed; and we hope for the promise of our King, end after end; and because of the end that the seeker sought it is known that he erred in his expositions, and the one who comes after him will search and expound another way. There is to interpret “evening and morning” in numerical value as five hundred and seventy-four, and in addition two thousand and three hundred: behold, two thousand eight hundred and seventy-four.
Daniel.translator_note: Two clauses are translated literally and their sense is not resolved here: “which depends on it” and “because of the end that the seeker sought.” The quoted words are Zechariah 14:7 (JPS: “at evening time there shall be light”) and Daniel 8:26 (JPS: “And the vision of the evenings and mornings which hath been told is true”); no references are printed. The sum was checked: 574 + 2300 = 2874; the numerical value of the Hebrew words was not recomputed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: then shall the sanctuary be victorious
Daniel.english_translation: *Venitzdak kodesh* — the iniquity of Israel will be atoned, to nullify the decrees of their trampling and treading, from when they were exiled the first exile to Egypt until they are redeemed and saved with an everlasting salvation by our King Messiah; and this reckoning ends at the end of one thousand two hundred and ninety (אל"ף ור"ץ) from the day the daily offering was removed, and that is what is said at the end of the book, “and from the time that the daily offering shall be taken away, in order to set up the abomination that maketh desolate, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days,” and no more, that our King Messiah will come and remove the abomination of desolation. And the daily offering was removed six years before the destruction of the Second Temple (ב"ש), and he set up an image in the Sanctuary; and on the seventeenth of Tammuz Apostemos burned the Torah and nullified the daily offering and set up an image in the Sanctuary, as we learned in tractate Taanit. And the six years that I wrote, I have no explicit proof, but there is a proof that for a whole week the daily offering was not nullified before the destruction, for so Daniel prophesied about Titus (below, 9) “and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease,” that is: for some part of the week before the destruction they will cancel the offerings; so it is explained below in the matter. We return to the first ones: how the reckoning of “evening and morning, two thousand three hundred” is exact, from the day Israel went down to Egypt, to end at the end of one thousand two hundred and ninety on the day the daily offering was removed. Two hundred and ten they were in Egypt; four hundred and eighty from their going out until “and he built the House”; four hundred and ten the House [stood]; and seventy years of the Babylonian exile; and four hundred and twenty the Second House: add to them the one thousand two hundred and ninety of the end of days: behold, two thousand eight hundred; subtract from them six years, in which the daily offering was removed before the destruction, since Scripture counted the one thousand two hundred and ninety only from the time the daily offering was removed: behold, you have the reckoning of evening and morning, and two thousand three hundred. And further there is added in the reckoning “Happy is he that waiteth,” and he will reach the end of days — forty-five years in excess of the one thousand two hundred and ninety; one may say: by the first reckoning the King Messiah will go out, and he will be hidden again from them for those forty-five years; and Rabbi Eliezer Kalir composed (in the *silluk* of the Yotzer for Parashat HaChodesh) in the foundation of his poem “six weeks”: behold, forty-two; and one may say the three years that did not come to the count of a week he did not count. And I found thus in the Midrash on Ruth, that the King Messiah is destined to be hidden forty-five years after he is revealed, and he brings proof from these verses.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed total “two thousand eight hundred” does not equal the printed figures: 210 + 480 + 410 + 70 + 420 + 1290 = 2880, and 2880 − 6 = 2874, which matches 2300 + 574 in the previous comment; the printed total appears to omit “and eighty” but is translated as printed. The printed abbreviation ב"ש is read as “Second Temple.” “Apostemos,” “Taanit,” “Midrash on Ruth” and the poem reference are translated as printed. The quoted words are Daniel 12:11 (JPS: “And from the time that the continual burnt-offering shall be taken away, and the detestable thing that causes appalment set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days”) and Daniel 9:27 (JPS: “for half of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease”); the printed wording differs, and “Happy is he that waiteth” is Daniel 12:12 (JPS: “Happy is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I sought to understand it
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'avakshah vinah* — I longed that it be explained to me from heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: between the banks of Ulai
Daniel.english_translation: *Bein Ulai* — within the river.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: who called, and said
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayikra* — the man.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Gabriel
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayomer* — to the angel: you, Gabriel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: make this man to understand the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Haven lahallaz et hamar'eh* — explain to this one the vision.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: this man
Daniel.english_translation: *Lahallaz* — an expression of importance, as they called “desirable things” every place where it says *halaz*: he is a man of form; and from here they learned in the Aggadah: Isaac resembled his father in image and likeness, so that he is called “this man” in the portion “And it came to pass when Isaac was old”; “and Joseph was of beautiful form”: this is the beauty counted among the five things that a father merits from his son.
Daniel.translator_note: The sentence about Isaac and Joseph is translated literally; its sense is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the vision belongeth to the time of the end
Daniel.english_translation: *La'et ketz* — for many days this vision will be.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I fell into a deep sleep
Daniel.english_translation: *Nirdamti* — an expression of slumber and desolation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: set me upright
Daniel.english_translation: *Al omdi* — on the place where my feet stood.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it belongeth to the appointed time of the end
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki lemo'ed ketz* — for it is for a time, the end of many days.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they are the kings of Media and Persia
Daniel.english_translation: *Malkhei Madai uFaras* — two horns: two nations ruling, as I explained above.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the first king
Daniel.english_translation: *Hamelekh harishon* — he is Alexander Mokdon, who killed Darius son of Esther, as we find in Sefer Yosippon.
Daniel.translator_note: The names are translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as for that which was broken
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehanishbaret* — that you saw was broken.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation
Daniel.english_translation: *Vete'amodnah arba tachteha* — as written in the account of the dream above: four kingdoms that will arise from that nation; Alexander Mokdon divided his kingdom at his death among four children, and Yosef called them in his book “four heads of a leopard,” and they were not sons of the king.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but not with his power
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo vekhocho* — and the latter ones will not be like the strength of the first king, for they will be weaker than he.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when the transgressors have completed their transgression
Daniel.english_translation: *Uve'acharit malkhutam kehatem haposhe'im* — when the time arrives that the wicked of Israel of the Second Temple will finish.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there shall stand up a king of fierce countenance
Daniel.english_translation: *Ya'amod melekh az panim* — he is Titus.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'atzum kocho* — and not by might, but by smooth talk, as is explained at the end of the book.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall destroy wonderfully
Daniel.english_translation: *Venifla'ot yashchit* — and by wonder upon wonder he will destroy star-worshippers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall prosper and do
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehitzliach ve'asah* — his desire.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall destroy them that are mighty
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehishchit atzumim* — he destroyed many nations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the people of the saints
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'am kedoshim* — Israel, who believe in the Torah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: through his cunning he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al sikhlo vehitzliach mirmah beyado* — and because he is wise in all that he turns to, and succeeds, he will hold fast to the deceit that is in his hand.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall magnify himself in his heart
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvilvavo yagdil* — he will become proud.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in time of security shall he destroy many
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvshalvah yashchit rabbim* — by deceit and smooth talk he will destroy many who dwell with him in covenant and peace.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall also stand up against the prince of princes
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al sar sarim ya'amod* — he will fling words toward above; this is the interpretation of the dream written above (“and unto the prince of the host he magnified”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall be broken without hand
Daniel.english_translation: *Uve'efes yad yishaver* — and without strength he will be broken, by a weak gnat among creatures that entered his nose, as we learned in tractate Gittin.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the vision of the evenings and mornings which hath been told is true
Daniel.english_translation: *Umar'eh ha'erev vehaboker* — what was said to you in the upper dream is true.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shut thou up the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'attah setom hechazon* — do not explain it, and seal it in your heart, for it will come for many days.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days
Daniel.english_translation: *Nehyeti* — an expression of being and of breaking; that is, I was distressed by this calamity and was crushed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: did the king’s business
Daniel.english_translation: *Et melekhet hamelekh* — for I was appointed over the charge of the service of the government of the kingdom of Belshazzar, whom Nebuchadnezzar his father appointed, as is said at the beginning of the book, “and he made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon.”
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are close to Daniel 2:48 (JPS: “and made him to rule over the whole province of Babylon”); the printed wording differs slightly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I was appalled at the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'eshtomem al hamar'eh* — and I was alarmed at the vision.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: understood it not
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ein mevin* — that I am astonished, since I was strong before the officers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus
Daniel.english_translation: *Bishnat achat leDaryavesh ben Achashverosh* — this is not the Ahasuerus of the days of Haman, for he was king of Persia, and this is Darius the Mede, who was made king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans when Belshazzar was killed, as is written above, “and Darius the Mede received the kingdom.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I Daniel meditated in the books
Daniel.english_translation: *Binoti bassefarim* — I looked into the reckonings.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: over the number of the years
Daniel.english_translation: *Mispar hashanim* etc. — I was calculating the reckoning of the years, for I thought regarding what he prophesied (Jeremiah 29:10) “For after seventy years are accomplished for Babylon I will remember you”: I imagined that this remembering is the building of the House, and the seventy years are completed in the first year of Darius the Mede, from when the kingdom of Babylon stretched out its hand upon Israel, when Nebuchadnezzar conquered Jehoiakim to be a servant to him; and that was the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, for the Master said: the first year he conquered Nineveh, the second year he went up and conquered Jehoiakim: go out and count from that year until here, and you will find them. And also in the Mishnah of Seder Olam this reckoning is found, and we learned there: in the year of the death of Belshazzar, behold seventy years from the day Nebuchadnezzar reigned; seventy minus one from the day he conquered Jehoiakim; and one more year Darius arose over Babylon and completed it. And when I saw that the redemption still did not hasten to come, I understood and gave heart to the counting of the reckoning, and I knew that I was not to count according to the conquest of Jehoiakim, but to fill the ruins of Jerusalem, when seventy years are filled from the exile of Zedekiah, in which Jerusalem was destroyed; and there are yet eighteen to come, for this exile was in the eighteenth year from the conquest of Jehoiakim, as we learned in Seder Olam: they were exiled in the seventh, they were exiled in the eighth, they were exiled in the eighteenth, they were exiled in the nineteenth; and our Rabbis explained in tractate Megillah: they were exiled the exile of Jeconiah in the seventh from the conquest of Jehoiakim, which is the eighth of Nebuchadnezzar; they were exiled in the second, in the eighteenth from the conquest of Jehoiakim, which is the nineteenth of Nebuchadnezzar.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Jeremiah 29:10” (written כט י) is Jeremiah 29:10 (JPS: “after seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will remember you”); the printed wording differs slightly. The chronology is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: made confession
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'et'vaddeh* — for the sin of my people.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the great and awful God
Daniel.english_translation: *Ha'el hagadol vehanora* — and he did not say “mighty.” He said: star-worshippers enslave His sons, and where are His mighty acts?

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have turned aside from Thy commandments
Daniel.english_translation: *Vesor* — and we went going and turning away from Your commandments, טילנ"ש in Old French.
Daniel.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Daniel 9:5 (“nous écartant”), in forms such as טולטא and טול אנט; the printed form (טילנ"ש) differs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: belongeth righteousness
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekha Adonai hatzedakah* — that is, Your judgments and the calamity that You brought upon us: the judgment and the justice are with You.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: unto us confusion of face
Daniel.english_translation: *Velanu boshet hapanim* — we are fit to be ashamed at the event that befell us, for we caused it to ourselves.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as at this day
Daniel.english_translation: *Kayom hazeh* — as we see today.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: To the Lord our God belong compassions and forgivenesses
Daniel.english_translation: *La'Adonai Eloheinu harachamim* — that we were not consumed by our iniquities, for we rebelled against Him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there hath been poured out upon us
Daniel.english_translation: *Vatitakh aleinu* — and it reached us, like “was not poured (*lo nitakh*) upon the earth” (Exodus 9); and Onkelos translated *lo matat le'ar'a*.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Exodus 9” is Exodus 9:33; the Aramaic is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the curse and the oath
Daniel.english_translation: *Ha'alah vehashevu'ah* — the curses of the covenant with which You made us swear at Horeb: “and it shall be, if you will not hearken,” and so on; all the curses written there.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: as hath been done upon Jerusalem
Daniel.english_translation: *Ka'asher na'asetah bi-Yerushalayim* — the sword, killing, and burning of the city; and women were afflicted and led captive in *kolarin*.
Daniel.translator_note: The word *kolarin* is left untranslated.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: As it is written in the Law of Moses
Daniel.english_translation: *Ka'asher katuv besorat Mosheh* — a hint that He testified against us that if we transgress the oath, all this evil will come upon us.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the LORD hath watched over the evil
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayishkod* — and He hastened.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the LORD our God is righteous
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki tzaddik* — for the justice is with Him; and my teachers explained: “righteous” is the Holy One, blessed be He, and it is a righteous act toward us that He hastened and advanced two years to the count of *venoshantem* (“and you shall have been long”), so that “you shall utterly perish” (*avod toveidun*) should not be fulfilled upon us. *Venoshantem* is in numerical value eight hundred and fifty-two, and they were exiled at the end of eight hundred and fifty from their coming to the Land.
Daniel.translator_note: The Hebrew words quoted are from Deuteronomy 4:25 (JPS: “you shall have been long in the land”) and 4:26 (JPS: “you shall soon utterly perish”); no references are printed. The arithmetic is translated as printed: the numerical value of *venoshantem* and the dates were not recomputed here. Audit 4 arithmetic check: the numerical value of *venoshantem* (ונושנתם) is 6+50+6+300+50+400+40 = 852, as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And now, O Lord our God
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'attah Adonai Eloheinu* — we confess that we have sinned and acted wickedly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a reproach
Daniel.english_translation: *Lecharpah* — to blasphemy.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to all that are about us
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekhol sevivoteinu* — to all our neighbours; all of them reproach us.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for the Lord’s sake
Daniel.english_translation: *Lema'an Adonai* — for the sake of the holy Name that is called upon the Temple [ב"ה], as it is said “the Sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established” (ibid. 15).
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are Exodus 15:17 (JPS: “The sanctuary, O Lord, which Thy hands have established”); the printed “ibid. 15” is translated as printed. The abbreviation ב"ה is read as “the Temple” from the context (the printed form is kept in brackets); the expansion is not confirmed by a permitted source, so the comment is flagged.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: behold our desolations
Daniel.english_translation: *Ur'eh shomemoteinu* — and the desolation of the city upon which Your Name is called, for not upon the support of our righteousness do we cast down our supplications, that You do good to us, for we have come upon Your mercies.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: O Lord, hear
Daniel.english_translation: *Adonai shema'ah* — to our supplications.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: O Lord, forgive
Daniel.english_translation: *Adonai selachah* — for our sins.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: O Lord, attend
Daniel.english_translation: *Adonai haksivah* — Your ear to our cry.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and do, defer not
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'aseh* — our request, and do not delay.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for the holy mountain of my God
Daniel.english_translation: *Al har kodesh Elohai* — on behalf of the Mount of the House of God, that it be built.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning
Daniel.english_translation: *Battechillah* — in the days of Belshazzar, as is written above.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: being caused to fly swiftly
Daniel.english_translation: *Mu'af bi'af* — he was flung to me in flight and soaring.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he made me to understand
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayaven* — and made me understand.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a word went forth
Daniel.english_translation: *Bitchillat tachanunekha yatza davar* — a truth from the Holy One, blessed be He, to me, to tell you.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou art greatly beloved
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki chamudot attah* — you have words of desire to the Holy One, blessed be He.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: look into the word
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvin badavar* — and give heart to understand the matter.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Seventy weeks are decreed
Daniel.english_translation: *Shavu'im shiv'im nechtak* — upon Jerusalem, from the day of the first destruction in the days of Zedekiah until it will be in the second.
Daniel.translator_note: The last clause is translated literally; its construction is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sin
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekhalle hapesha ulehatem chattat* — that Israel will receive the completion of their punishment in the exile of Titus and servitude, and in order that their transgressions end and their sins be completed and their iniquities be atoned, in order to bring upon them everlasting righteousness, and to anoint (upon them) the Holy of Holies: the ark and the altars and the holy vessels, which will come to them through the King Messiah. And the number of the weeks is four hundred and ninety years: the exile of Babylon, seventy, and the Second House, four hundred and twenty (ת"ך).
Daniel.translator_note: The word “(upon them)” is in parentheses in the printed text and is a later printed insertion. The sum was checked: 70 + 420 = 490.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Know therefore and discern
Daniel.english_translation: *Veteda vetaskel min motza davar* — from the going forth of this word, which went forth at the beginning of your supplications to tell you, you will know to understand to return and to build Jerusalem.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: unto one anointed, a prince
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad mashiach nagid* — a time will be given from the day of the destruction until Cyrus king of Persia comes, of whom the Holy One, blessed be He, said that he will return and build His city, and called him His anointed and His prince, as it is said “Thus says the Lord to His anointed, to Cyrus,” etc. “He shall build My city and let go My exiles,” etc.
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted words are Isaiah 45:1 (JPS: “Thus saith the LORD to His anointed, To Cyrus”) and Isaiah 45:13 (JPS: “He shall build My city, And he shall let Mine exiles go free”); no references are printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall be seven weeks
Daniel.english_translation: *Shavu'im shiv'ah* — seven complete sabbatical cycles will be in exile before Cyrus comes, and three more years were in addition; but since the week was not completed, it is not counted. In the first year of Darius the Mede, in which Daniel was standing when this vision was told to him, the seventy years from the conquest of Jehoiakim were completed; subtract from them eighteen years that the conquest of Jehoiakim preceded the destruction of Jerusalem: there remain fifty-two years; this is what our Rabbis taught, “for fifty-two years no man passed through Judah”; these are the fifty-two years from the day of the destruction until they returned in the days of Cyrus: behold, seven sabbatical cycles and three years.
Daniel.translator_note: The sums were checked: 70 − 18 = 52; 52 = 49 + 3.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: it shall be built again
Daniel.english_translation: *Ushavu'im shishim ushnayim tashuv venivnetah* — the city, with its broad streets and its trenches.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: moat
Daniel.english_translation: *Vecharutz* — these are trenches that they make around the wall to strengthen the city, which are called קאבה in the vernacular.
Daniel.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Daniel 9:25 (“et fossé”; the verse number is unclear in the available text), in the form פרשיד; the printed form (קאבה) differs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but in troublous times
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvtzok ha'ittim* — and those times will be in distress and trouble, for in the servitude of the kings of Persia and the star-worshippers they will make them toil in hard servitude; and although they are sixty-two weeks, and four more years that remained from the eighth week, whose beginning was swallowed — three years — within the fifty-two of the continuation of the exile, these four years were not counted here, because he counted here only weeks; and behold, you find that at the beginning he began to count seventy weeks, and at the end, when he specified their times and their judgments, he counted only sixty-nine; rather, one week was divided, part of it here and part of it there, and he mentioned only the complete weeks.
Daniel.translator_note: The arithmetic in this comment is translated as printed and is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: troublous times
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvtzok ha'ittim* — in distress will those times be.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: after the threescore and two weeks
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'acharei* — those weeks.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall an anointed one be cut off
Daniel.english_translation: *Yikaret mashiach* — Agrippas, king of Judah, who was ruler in the days of the destruction, will be killed.
Daniel.translator_note: The name is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and be no more
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ein lo* — like *ve'enenu*.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: an anointed one
Daniel.english_translation: *Mashiach* — it is only an expression of a prince and a great man.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the city and the sanctuary
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ha'ir vehakodesh* — the city and the Temple.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the people of a prince that shall come shall destroy
Daniel.english_translation: *Yashchit am nagid haba* — upon them [comes] he, Titus, and his hosts.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his end shall be with a flood
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekitzo vashetef* — and his end is to curse and destruction, for the power of his kingdom will be flooded away through the Messiah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: unto the end of the war
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad ketz milchamah* — Gog: the city will be —
Daniel.translator_note: The comment is a fragment (“Gog: the city will be”) and is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: desolations are determined
Daniel.english_translation: *Necheretzet shomemot* — a decree of desolation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall make a firm covenant with many
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehigbir brit larabbim shavua echad* — “many” means officers, like “and all the chiefs (*rabbei*) of the king” in the book of Jeremiah 52.
Daniel.translator_note: The quoted Hebrew words were not found in Jeremiah 52. The phrase “the chief officers of the king” occurs at Jeremiah 41:1 (JPS: “one of the chief officers of the king”), and “the chief officers of the king of Babylon” at Jeremiah 39:13. The words ורבי המלך occur at Jeremiah 41:1 (not Jeremiah 52); the printed וכל רבי המלך differs by the first word. They are not found in Jeremiah 52 in the Hebrew Tanakh.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a firm covenant
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehigbir* — Titus, a covenant with the officers of Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for one week
Daniel.english_translation: *Shavua echad* — he will assure them with a firm covenant and peace up to seven years, and in the midst of the week he will break his covenant.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease
Daniel.english_translation: *Yashbit zevach uminchah* — and this is what he said in the first vision, “and in security he shall destroy many”: from within a covenant of peace he will destroy them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: upon the wing of detestable things
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al kenaf shikkutzim meshomem* — this is a term of disgrace for idolatry (*akum*); that is: on a lofty seat among detestable and abominable things he will place the desolator, the idolatry (*akum*), which is mute like a silent stone.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed abbreviation עכו"ם is rendered “idolatry.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the wing of detestable things
Daniel.english_translation: *Kanaf* — an expression of height, like the wing of a flying bird.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: until the extermination wholly determined be poured out
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ad kalah venecheratzah tittach al shomem* — and the rule of the detestable thing will persist until the day when there will be poured upon it a complete and decreed destruction, which will be decreed upon it in the days of the King Messiah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: poured out upon that which causeth appalment
Daniel.english_translation: *Tittach al shomem* — it will burst forth and descend; destruction will run upon the idolatry and upon its worshippers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: even a great warfare
Daniel.english_translation: *Vetzava gadol* — and it will come after a long time.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he gave heed to the word
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvin et hadavar* — and to understand the matter, the vision was revealed to me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: had understanding of the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvinah lo bamar'eh* — and to make him understand in a vision; and this word is not a noun, like “if you know understanding” (Job 38), but the extra *he*, and it is like “consider my meditation” (Psalms 5); therefore the accent is above on the *bet*, and its explanation is like “understand.”
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Job 38” is Job 38:4 (JPS: “Declare, if thou hast the understanding”); “Psalms 5” is Psalms 5:2 (JPS: “consider my meditation”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I Daniel was mourning
Daniel.english_translation: *Hayiti mit'abbel* — when he saw that Cyrus nullified the work of the House that he had ordered to begin, and retracted, following the letter of “the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin,” Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe, as is written in the book of Ezra.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: three whole weeks
Daniel.english_translation: *Sheloshah shavu'im yamim* — twenty-one years: they are eighteen from the first year of Darius the Mede, who set it to his heart to calculate the seventy years of the exile, as is written, until the second year of Darius the Persian, son of Esther, who built the House; and the three extra years — I do not know whether he began to fast before them, or the duration of the acceptance of the vow of his fasts was three years after the building.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I ate no pleasant bread
Daniel.english_translation: *Lechem chamudot* — clean bread, as Onkelos translated “the garments of Esau the desired ones” (Genesis 24): *dakhyata*.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Genesis 24” is Genesis 27:15 (JPS: “the choicest garments of Esau her elder son”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a man clothed in linen
Daniel.english_translation: *Lavush baddim* — a garment of linen.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: fine gold of Uphaz
Daniel.english_translation: *Bekhetem Ufaz* — with a belt of a collection of pearls; every *ketem* is an expression of a collection of gold and precious stone.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his body also was like the beryl
Daniel.english_translation: *Ugvi'ato kentarshish* — our Rabbis of blessed memory explained in tractate Chullin (chapter “Shechitat Chullin,” 91): his body was two thousand parasangs tall, like the measure of the sea whose name is Tarshish, and it is the sea of Africa.
Daniel.translator_note: The Talmudic reference is translated as printed and was not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: burnished brass
Daniel.english_translation: *Kalal* — refined and purified and yellowing.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the voice of a multitude
Daniel.english_translation: *Kekol hamon* — like the voice of a gathering of a great multitude, whose voice is heard from afar.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the men that were with me
Daniel.english_translation: *Veha'anashim asher hayu immi* — our Rabbis of blessed memory said: they are Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a great trembling fell upon them
Daniel.english_translation: *Aval charadah gedolah nafelah aleihem* — our Rabbis of blessed memory said: although a man does not see the thing that frightens him, his constellation (*mazal*) in the firmament sees it, and therefore he is frightened.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my comeliness was turned in me into corruption
Daniel.english_translation: *Nehepakh alai lemashchit* — to ruin; and it is the way of Scripture to speak thus, like (Jeremiah 5) “horses, equipped, rising early (*mashkim*) were they” (*mashkim*), in the early morning.
Daniel.translator_note: Printed “Jeremiah 5” is Jeremiah 5:8 (JPS: “They are become as well-fed horses, lusty stallions”); the printed wording differs from the verse. The second “(*mashkim*)” is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I retained no strength
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo atzarti ko'ach* — that is, I did not gather all my strength (for my strength went from within me).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: fallen into a deep sleep
Daniel.english_translation: *Nirdam* — from much fear.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a hand touched me
Daniel.english_translation: *Vatteni'eni* — like a man who shakes a sleeper to wake him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thou man greatly beloved
Daniel.english_translation: *Ish chamudot* — a pure man.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: stand upright
Daniel.english_translation: *Al omdekha* — on the place where your feet stand.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: now am I sent unto thee
Daniel.english_translation: *Shulachti elekha* — I was sent to you from the Omnipresent.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I stood trembling
Daniel.english_translation: *Mar'id* — מרתית.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed word מרתית is left as printed. Darmesteter lists this lemma at Daniel 10:11 (“tremblant”) in forms such as טרנבלייר and טרינבלנט; the printed word differs from them and is not resolved here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I am come because of thy words
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'ani bati bidvarekha* — I came on this mission on account of your words; and our Rabbis expounded in tractate Yoma: “and I came into the curtain (*pargod*) through you, for I had been banished from within it.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me
Daniel.english_translation: *Omed lenegdi* — he fought with me in the firmament, when he asks length of rule for Persia to enslave you; behold, twenty-one days that he is standing against me.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: one of the chief princes
Daniel.english_translation: *Hasarim harishonim* — that is, those who are esteemed first among those who enter.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I was left over there beside the kings of Persia
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'ani notarti sham* — to silence the prince of Persia in heaven.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there is yet a vision for the days
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki od chazon* — to tell you what was not told to you; and it will come yet for the many days set for an appointed time.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: my pains are come upon me
Daniel.english_translation: *Nehepkhu tziray alai* — these are the heads of the bones of every limb, which are fixed in the sockets of their dwelling, turning within them like a door on its hinge in the socket of the threshold; my hinges were turned, to be dislocated from their place from much trembling and fear.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: this servant of my lord
Daniel.english_translation: *Eved adoni zeh* — about himself he says “servant,” and about the angel he says “lord”; that is: and how can this your servant speak with you?

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'attah ashuv lehilachem im sar Paras* — and I know that I can; but when the time of the kingdom of Antiochus comes, I know that I will go out and he will enter, after thirty-four years from the building of the House, and that Alexander Mokdon will arise; for although Israel were subjugated to the kings of Persia in those days, they served them an easy service and did not weigh heavily on them, for the Holy One, blessed be He, gave them mercy; but the kingdom of Greece placed upon them a hard yoke.
Daniel.translator_note: The names are translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that which is inscribed in the writing of truth
Daniel.english_translation: *Et harashum bikhtav emet* — the document of the decree, and it is true; and there is none among all the upper princes who strengthens himself to help me against all these, except —

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in the first year of Darius the Mede
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'ani bishnat achat leDaryavesh haMadi* — when the kingdom of Babylon fell and the rule of Media and Persia began, the princes of Media and Persia were requesting of the Omnipresent to make the yoke of their terrifying rule heavy upon you; I, Gabriel, stood as a supporter and a stronghold for Michael, your prince.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia
Daniel.english_translation: *Hineh od shelosha melakhim* etc. — our Rabbis of blessed memory said in Seder Olam: this is Cyrus, and Ahasuerus, and Darius who built the House; and what does “fourth” teach? The fourth is of Media. But in the book of Yosef ben Gurion it is written that Cyrus had a son who reigned in his place before Ahasuerus reigned, and his name was Bambishah.
Daniel.translator_note: The name is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when he is waxed strong through his riches
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekhechezkato* — of Darius.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: through his riches, he shall stir up all
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'oshro ya'ir* — all his kingdom to make war with the kingdom of Greece.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And a mighty king shall stand up
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'amad melekh gibbor* — in Greece; he is Alexander Mokdon.
Daniel.translator_note: The name is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and do according to his will
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah khirtzono* — against Darius king of Persia, and he will kill him and receive his kingdom, and the Persians will be enslaved to the Greeks.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his kingdom shall be broken
Daniel.english_translation: *Vekha'amdo tishaver malkhuto* — and when he becomes very strong and stands on his strength, his kingdom will be broken, for he will die.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: toward the four winds of heaven
Daniel.english_translation: *Vetechatz le'arba ruchot hashamayim* — it is written in the book of Ben Gurion that he divided his kingdom among four heads of his family; they are the four heads of the leopard that Daniel saw, “and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the sides of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads” (above 7); he likened this one to the east, and this one to the west, this one to the north, and this one to the south; and likewise in the first vision, “and there came up four” (above 8), on the horn of the he-goat.
Daniel.translator_note: The Aramaic words printed in the quotation are Daniel 7:6 (JPS: “After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the sides of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads”). The second quotation is from Daniel 8:8 (JPS: “there came up the appearance of four horns toward the four winds of heaven”); the printed wording is shorter and the printed “he-goat” is the *tsafir hasa'ir* of the verse. The book “Ben Gurion” is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but not to his posterity
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo le'acharito* — the rule will not come to his sons but to the sons of his family; *acharit* falls only on the sense of sons, and so it says (Amos 4:2) “And he shall take you away with *tsinnot*, and your *acharit* with fish-hooks”; and the Targum translates: “and your sons and your daughters with the hooks of hunters.”
Daniel.translator_note: The Amos verse (JPS: “That you shall be taken away with hooks, And your residue with fish-hooks”) is quoted with different wording than the printed one; the reference in parentheses is a later printed insertion and was verified. The Aramaic is translated as printed; the abbreviation ות"י is left as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: nor according to his dominion wherewith he ruled
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo khemoshlo asher mashal* — and the kingdom of these will not be as strong as that of Alexander.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for his kingdom shall be plucked up
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki tinnatesh malkhuto* — to be divided to these four heads and to others besides these.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And the king of the south shall be strong
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyechezak melekh haNegev* — the head who will reign in the south will be stronger than the head opposite him who reigns in the north, and than his officers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: to make an agreement
Daniel.english_translation: *La'asot meisharim* — a settlement of peace between him and her father.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: she shall not retain
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo ta'atzor* etc. — and the king of the north will capture her, and those who brought her, and her father who begot her, and the one who held her fast in every time of her distress.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: she shall not retain
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo ta'atzor* — the arm of those who brought her: strength to stand (and her father will not stand) before him; neither he nor his arm; they are the mighty ones of his strength.
Daniel.translator_note: The parenthetical word in the printed text is a later printed insertion. The printed “(and her father will not stand)” is a later insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but she shall be given up
Daniel.english_translation: *Vetinnaten* — into the hand of the king of the north, she and those who brought her and the one who begot her. He is her father.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: But one of the shoots of her roots shall stand up in his place
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'amad mineitzer shorasheha* — a son who sits on his seat on the throne of the kingdom.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and shall come unto the army
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyavo el hachayil* — to the king of the north.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: stronghold of the king of the north
Daniel.english_translation: *Be-ma'oz melekh hatzafon* — that is, in the cities of his stronghold, in his fortresses.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and shall deal with them
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah bahem* — and he will succeed against them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and shall prevail
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehechezik* — and will conquer them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: with their molten images
Daniel.english_translation: *Nesicheihem* — their officers.
Daniel.translator_note: The source lemma *nesicheihem* is rendered by JPS “molten images”; Rashi’s gloss “officers” (printed *sareihem*) is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he shall come into the kingdom of the king of the south
Daniel.english_translation: *Uva vemalkhut melekh haNegev* — by way of the kingdom of the king of the south, who is her father’s father, he will return to his land, and it is Egypt, as was said above, “into captivity he will bring Egypt.”
Daniel.translator_note: The printed quotation is from Daniel 11:8 (JPS: “shall he bring into captivity into Egypt”); the printed wording differs.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And his sons shall stir themselves up
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvanav* — of the king of the north will stir themselves up.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and he shall come on, and overflow, as he passes through
Daniel.english_translation: *Uva vo* — like “and going on going”: the son of the king of the north will come against him, “and overflow and pass through,” to the land of the south.
Daniel.translator_note: No reference is printed for “and going on going”; the other quotation is the verse itself (JPS: “and overflow, as he passes through”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and he shall return and stir himself up
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyashov* — and he will stir himself up against the king of the south.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: even to his stronghold
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad ma'uzzo* — the city of his fortresses.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall be moved with choler
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyitmarmar* — and will fight with the people.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but the multitude shall be given into his hand
Daniel.english_translation: *Venittan hehamon* — of the king of the north into his hand.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and the multitude shall be carried away
Daniel.english_translation: *Venissa hehamon* — of the king of the north, to be very proud, for they will purpose in their heart to prevail in war.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and he shall cast down tens of thousands
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehefil revavot* — many of the army of the king of the south.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but he shall not prevail
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo ya'oz* — and in spite of all this, the victory of the war will not be his.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the children of the violent among thy people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvnei peritzei ameka yinnasu leha'amid chazon* — I saw in the name of Rabbi Saadiah that these are the lawless ones of Israel and their party.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his chosen people
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'am mivchav* — will be in the war.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: there shall be no strength in them to withstand
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'ein ko'ach la'amod* — before the king of the north; and although there is an extra *vav* here, it is the way of Scripture to speak so in this language, like “her nobles, and there is no kingdom, they shall call” (in the book of Isaiah 34).
Daniel.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 34:12 (JPS: “As for her nobles, none shall be there to be called to the kingdom”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall do according to his own will
Daniel.english_translation: *Vaya'as* — the king of the north who comes to the king of the south, according to his will.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the beauteous land
Daniel.english_translation: *Be'eretz hatzevi* — in the Land of Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in his hand shall be extermination
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechalah veyado* — and he will destroy the land with his multitudes.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Vayasem panav* — the king of the north, to come with the strength of the whole kingdom of the king of the south.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but shall make an agreement with him
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyesharim immo* — with the king of the south; against them also the king of the north will fight in those days.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: an agreement with him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah* — and he will succeed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall give him the daughter of women, to destroy it
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvat hanashim yitten lo lehashchitah* — this is the Congregation of Israel, beautiful among women; the king of the north will command the commander of his army to destroy it. And I say that he is Antiochus the wicked, king of Greece, who decreed decrees upon Israel and commanded Polifos, the commander of his army, to kill everyone who is called by the name Jew, as it is written in the book of Yosiphon.
Daniel.translator_note: The names and the book “Yosiphon” are translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but it shall not stand
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo ta'amod* — this plan of his.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: neither be for him
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo lo tihyeh* — the daughter of women, for Mattathias son of Johanan arose and broke his yoke from upon Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehishbit katzin cherpato lo* — and the Holy One, blessed be He, caused his blasphemy and his reproach to cease, with which he blasphemed the Holy One, blessed be He, and Israel, as it is written in the book of Yosiphon, and returned it upon him, for He struck him with an evil boil while he was on the road, which he went to lay siege to Jerusalem; and his flesh stank and his limbs fell away, and he said to his servants to return him to Antioch, and he did not manage to arrive there before he died of evil diseases.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed *latzur al Yerushalayim* is read here as “to lay siege to Jerusalem”; it could also be read as “to Tyre, against Jerusalem.” The abbreviation הקב"ה is expanded as usual.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the strongholds of his own land
Daniel.english_translation: *Lema'uzzei artzo* — to return to the city of his fortresses.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Then shall stand up in his place one that shall cause an exactor to pass through the glory of the kingdom
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'amad al kano ma'avir noges* — and he will be strengthened on his base on Mount Modi'it: Mattathias son of Johanan, who removed the Greek exactor from upon Israel, etc.; and he is the glory of the kingdom in Israel, for he will be a prince and mighty, he and all his seed after him, the sons of the Hasmoneans.
Daniel.translator_note: “Mount Modi’it” is the printed spelling.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but within few days he shall be destroyed
Daniel.english_translation: *Uvyamim achadim yishaver* — in few days their kingdom will be broken.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: neither in anger
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo v'apayim* — of another nation.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: nor in battle
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo vamilchamah* — for from them and among them will be those who will be jealous, Aristobulus and Hyrcanus, over the matter of kingship.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a contemptible person
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'amad al kano nivzeh* — and he will then be strengthened on the standing of the kingdom of Esau, as it is said, “Thou art greatly despised” (Obadiah 1), and the Romans will arise and take the kingdom from the Greeks.
Daniel.translator_note: The quotation is Obadiah 1:2 (JPS: “Thou art greatly despised”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And the arms of the flood shall be swept away from before him
Daniel.english_translation: *Uzra'ot hashetef* — and the mighty ones of the Greek kingdom, who were sweeping and strong before them, will be swept away before the Romans and will be broken.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: yea, also the prince of the covenant
Daniel.english_translation: *Vegam nagid brit* — also the king of Israel who will make a covenant with them; his end too is that he will be swept away before him, for [the Romans] will transgress the covenant and will strip them, as our Rabbis of blessed memory said (Avodah Zarah 8): “Twenty-six years they stood in their faithfulness with Israel, and afterwards they enslaved them.”
Daniel.translator_note: The verb *yifshetu* is rendered “will strip”; its exact sense here is not resolved. The Aramaic is translated as printed. The word “(Romans)” and the reference in parentheses are later printed insertions; the Talmudic reference was not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully
Daniel.english_translation: *Umin hitchabrut elav ya'aseh mirmah* — and from the partnership in which (Rome) will join with Israel he will act deceitfully, so as not to reveal an evil thought.
Daniel.translator_note: The word “(Rome)” is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and he shall come up
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'alah* — from his place.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and become strong
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'atzam* — in all the places around the Land of Judah, in Edom, Ammon and Moab.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: with a little nation
Daniel.english_translation: *Bime'at goy* — he will not need a heavy army, for the king of Judah will help him; and so it is written in the book of Yosiphon.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance
Daniel.english_translation: *Bizah veshalal verechush lahem yivzor* — he will distribute to all those who accept the yoke upon themselves, until they conquer everything with flattery and smoothness.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall scatter
Daniel.english_translation: *Yivzor* — like *yefazzer*, and so “He hath scattered the peoples” (Psalms 68).
Daniel.translator_note: The quotation is Psalms 68:31 (JPS: “He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war!”); the printed Hebrew *bizzar amim* is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: against fortresses
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al mivtzarim* — the idolater will devise his devices to station (in them) the heads of his troops until the time when everything will be conquered beneath them.
Daniel.translator_note: The abbreviation עכו"ם is rendered “idolater.” The parenthetical word in the printed text is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but he shall not stand
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo ya'amod* — the king of the south.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for they shall devise devices against him
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki yachshevu alav machashavot* — and they will plot against him to bring him down by means of a bribe, bribing his officers to betray him, as he concludes and says, “and those who eat his bread shall break him.”
Daniel.translator_note: The printed *ve'ochlei fat bago* differs slightly from the verse (JPS: “they that eat of his food shall destroy him”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they that eat of his food
Daniel.english_translation: *Fat bago* — his food; he takes a portion from his table.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And as for both these kings
Daniel.english_translation: *Ushneihem hamelakhim* — the prince of the Romans and the prince of the covenant mentioned above; he is Hyrcanus, who will join himself for his help so that he too will help against Aristobulus his brother, who reigns in Jerusalem.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: their hearts shall be to do mischief
Daniel.english_translation: *Levavam lemera* — against the sons of your people, to do evil to Judah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they shall speak lies at one table
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al shulchan echad* — against the kingdom of Aristobulus they will whisper lies.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but it shall not prosper
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo titzlach* — that Israel will be handed over to destruction in those days.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for the end remaineth yet for the time appointed
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki od ketz lamo'ed* — the destruction, to fulfil the “weeks, sixty and two” mentioned in this book (above 9), and that appointed time is in the days of Agrippas son of Agrippas, of the seed of Herod.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed form *shavu'im shishim ushnayim* is translated as printed (compare Daniel 9:26, JPS: “after the threescore and two weeks”). The name is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he shall return to his own land with great substance
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyashev* — the Roman king, to his land from the king of the south, with great substance.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: his heart shall be against the holy covenant
Daniel.english_translation: *Ulvavo al* — the holy covenant, to annul his covenant away from Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and he shall do his pleasure
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah* — that is, and he will succeed, and return to his land.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: At the time appointed
Daniel.english_translation: *Lamo'ed* — after a time.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo tihyeh* — this coming will not be successful like the first one mentioned above, “and one of the shoots of her roots shall stand up,” etc., when the king of the north succeeded against the king of the south, and like the last time, this second time, of which we said, “and he returned to his land with great substance.”
Daniel.translator_note: The first quotation is Daniel 11:7 (JPS: “But one of the shoots of her roots shall stand up in his place”). The last is Daniel 11:28 (JPS: “And he shall return to his own land with great substance”); the printed wording differs slightly.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall come against him
Daniel.english_translation: *Uva'u vo* — to fight against him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: ships
Daniel.english_translation: *Tziyim* — troops.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Kittim
Daniel.english_translation: *Kittim* — the Romans, bands from the kingdoms of Rome who will rebel against him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall be cowed
Daniel.english_translation: *Venich'ah* — and he was somewhat broken.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: have indignation against the holy covenant
Daniel.english_translation: *Veshav vaza'am al brit kodesh* — and he returned to his land to annul the covenant that he had made with Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and have regard unto them that forsake the holy covenant
Daniel.english_translation: (*Veshav veyavin al ozvei brit kodesh*) and he will set his heart and consider that Israel forsook the covenant (and law) of holiness, and groundless hatred and dissension multiplied in the Second House, as it is written in the book of Yosiphon, and they shed innocent blood; and on this he will rely, and he knows that he will succeed and annul his covenant with them and provoke them.
Daniel.translator_note: The source gives no lemma for this comment; the first words are printed in parentheses at the start of the comment and are translated as printed (the verse reads “have regard unto them that forsake the holy covenant”). The word “(and law)” is a later printed insertion.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And arms shall stand on his part
Daniel.english_translation: *Uzro'im mimmenu ya'amodu* — he will send his officers and his mighty men to Jerusalem.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and they shall profane the sanctuary, even the stronghold
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechilelu hamikdash hama'oz* — the dwelling of the Temple.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall be corrupt by blandishments
Daniel.english_translation: *Umarshi'ei brit yachanif* — the lawless of Israel who will join him and will do wickedly against their covenant with their fellows and will be rebellious; and he will flatter with smooth words.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the people that know their God
Daniel.english_translation: *Yodei Elohav* — and the upright of Israel who will hold fast to the fear of their God, that is, they will seize it and not forsake it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall show strength, and prevail
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asu* — their Torah.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: that are wise among the people
Daniel.english_translation: *Umaskilei am* — the wise among them, such as those of the house of Rabbi and the sages of the generations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall cause the many to understand
Daniel.english_translation: *Yavinu larabbim* — they will expound the Torah to the common people and strengthen their hands to hold fast to it.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: yet they shall stumble by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil
Daniel.english_translation: *Venichshelu* — in their exile, by the sword and by flame, etc.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: they shall be helped with a little help
Daniel.english_translation: *Ye'azeru* — a little help by means of bribes and money that they will give in serving their enemies; he will assist them with these.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed sentence is translated literally; its subject is not clear.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall stumble, to refine among them
Daniel.english_translation: *Yikashelu letzrof bahem* — they will stumble in the calculation of the ends, on which they will set their heart to refine them and to whiten them in order to know them, and they will err in them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And the king shall do according to his will
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah khirtzono hamelekh* — the kingdom of Rome.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: he shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehitzliach ad kalah za'am* — until the anger of the Holy One, blessed be He, turns back from Israel.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for that which is determined shall be done
Daniel.english_translation: *Ki necheratzah ne'esatah* — when his decree is finished. *Ki* is like *ka'asher* (“when”).

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Neither shall he regard the gods of his fathers
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'al elohei avotav lo yavin* — he will not set his heart to the Holy One, blessed be He, who is the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, his fathers.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the desire of women
Daniel.english_translation: *Chemdat nashim* — the Congregation of Israel, beautiful among women.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the god of strongholds
Daniel.english_translation: *Ule-eloha ma'uzzim* — to the god of the cherubim, who will make a covenant with him.
Daniel.translator_note: The printed *elohei hakruvim* (“god of the cherubim”) and its relation to the verse are not resolved; the comment is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: in his place shall he honour
Daniel.english_translation: *Al kano yechabbed* — for he will flatter the idolaters, because they are subdued to him.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And he shall deal with the strongest fortresses
Daniel.english_translation: *Ve'asah* — buildings.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: with the help of a foreign god
Daniel.english_translation: *Levatzrei ma'uzzim im eloha nekhar* — that is, for the honour of a foreign god; *asher hikkir* — “whom he acknowledged.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall increase glory
Daniel.english_translation: *Yarbeh kavod* — the officers whom he will see in his heart to recognise their faces and to flatter, he will increase honour for them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: shall divide the land
Daniel.english_translation: *Va'adamah yechalek* — to them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: for a price
Daniel.english_translation: *Bamechir* — for light money.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And at the time of the end
Daniel.english_translation: *Uv'et ketz* — when our redemption draws near.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: the king of the north shall come against him
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyishta'er alav melekh hatzafon* — against the king of the south.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And at that time shall Michael stand up
