Daniel.english_translation: *Uve'et hahi ya'amod Mikha'el* — he will be silenced like a mute, for he will see the Holy One, blessed be He, judging by Himself, and saying: How shall I destroy such a great nation for the sake of Israel?
Daniel.translator_note: The Hebrew does not say who speaks the final question; it is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: a time of trouble
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehayetah et tzarah* — in the heavenly company (*pamalya*), and accusation against the Torah scholars, “in plunder and in plunder of plunder,” as our Rabbis said in the Aggadah in the last chapter of Ketubot.
Daniel.translator_note: The Aramaic words are translated as printed. The Talmudic reference was not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: thy people shall be delivered
Daniel.english_translation: *Yimmalet ameka* — the kingdom of Aram will perish and Israel will be delivered.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: every one that shall be found written in the book
Daniel.english_translation: *Kol hanimtza katuv basefer* — this is an abbreviated verse: all that is found written in this book through the dreams written in it, “until the beast was slain,” “and the holy ones of the Most High shall receive the kingdom,” everything will be fulfilled.
Daniel.translator_note: The Aramaic quotations are from Daniel 7:11 (JPS: “even till the beast was slain”) and Daniel 7:18 (JPS: “But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom”); the printed wording is slightly different from the verses.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake
Daniel.english_translation: *Verabbim miyshenei admat afar yakitzu* — the dead will live.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehamaskilim* — who occupied themselves with Torah and commandments will shine like the brightness of the firmament.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: when they have made an end of breaking in pieces the power of the holy people
Daniel.english_translation: *Vechechalot nafetz yad am kodesh* — when the strength of Israel is finished, “for He seeth that their stay is gone, and none remaining, shut up or left at large” (Deuteronomy 32).
Daniel.translator_note: The quotation is Deuteronomy 32:36 (JPS: “When He seeth that their stay is gone, And there is none remaining, shut up or left at large”). The reference in parentheses is a later printed insertion; the printed Hebrew begins “for” where the verse begins “when.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: I understood not
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo avin* — I did not know what is “a time, times, and a half.”

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: what shall be the latter end of these things
Daniel.english_translation: *Mah acharit elleh* — the end of these calculations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: till the time of the end
Daniel.english_translation: *Ad et ketz* — until the redemption draws near.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white
Daniel.english_translation: *Yitbarru veyitlabbenu* — these calculations.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: and be refined
Daniel.english_translation: *Veyitzarefu* — many [will refine themselves] by them, to understand them.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but the wicked shall do wickedly
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehirshi'u resha'im* — the calculations, to reckon them not according to the law; and when the time passes they will say: There is no more redemption.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: none of the wicked shall understand
Daniel.english_translation: *Velo yavinu* — them, all the wicked.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: but they that are wise shall understand
Daniel.english_translation: *Vehamaskilim yavinu* — it, when the time of the end comes.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: And from the time that the continual burnt-offering shall be taken away
Daniel.english_translation: *Ume'et husar hatamid* — to set up the detestable thing that causes appalment in its place, one thousand two hundred and ninety days: they are years, from the day the continual offering was taken away until it returns in the days of our Messiah. And this calculation agrees with the calculation of “evening and morning, two thousand three hundred,” from the day of their exile to Egypt until the last redemption. The exile of Egypt, two hundred and ten; from the day of their going out until the building of the First House, four hundred and eighty; the days of the building, four hundred and ten; the exile of Babylon, seventy years; the days of the Second House, four hundred and twenty: behold, one thousand five hundred and ninety. And the continual offering was taken away six years before the destruction; so from the day of their exile to Egypt until the continual offering was taken away, one thousand five hundred and eighty-four. He added to them one thousand two hundred and ninety: behold, two thousand eight hundred and seventy-four, like the number of “evening and morning” by gematria, two thousand three hundred.
Daniel.translator_note: The sums were checked: 210 + 480 + 410 + 70 + 420 = 1,590; 1,590 − 6 = 1,584; 1,584 + 1,290 = 2,874. The words “evening” (*erev*, 272) and “morning” (*boker*, 302) add to 574 by gematria, and 574 + 2,300 = 2,874; the printed sentence is compressed and is translated as printed.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: Happy is he that waiteth
Daniel.english_translation: *Ashrei hamechakkeh* etc. — forty-five years added to the upper calculation, for our Messiah will be hidden after he has been revealed, and will return and be revealed; and so we find in the Midrash of Ruth, and so R. Eliezer Kalir composed (in the *silluk* of *Yotzer* for Parashat HaChodesh) “and six weeks were hidden from them.”
Daniel.translator_note: The parenthetical reference to Kalir’s liturgical poem is a later printed insertion and is translated as printed; the Midrash and the poem were not checked here.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: But go thou thy way till the end be
Daniel.english_translation: *Lekh laketz* — you will depart to your eternal home.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: stand up to thy lot
Daniel.english_translation: *Legoralekha* — to receive your portion with the righteous.

Daniel.english_lemma_JPS: at the end of the days
Daniel.english_translation: *Leketz hayamin* — like “at the end of the days”; and it is not to be explained that *hayamin* is the right hand, for it is counted in the Great Masorah in the list of words that are unique with a final straight *nun* serving in place of *mem*, and there are no others like them, such as “and upon her others (*acharin*) shall bow down” (Job 31); “he riseth up and he trusteth not in life (*bachayin*)” (there, 24); “take thou unto thee wheat (*chittin*)” (Ezekiel 4); “they shall tremble, the isles (*iyyin*)” (there, 26); “to destroy kings (*melakhin*)” (Proverbs 31); *leketz hayamin* (here). (And see Rashi at Pesachim 56, s.v. “*leketz hayamin*,” and see Rashi at Sanhedrin 92, s.v. “*lekh laketz*,” etc., and some of this requires further study.)
Daniel.translator_note: The final parenthetical sentence is a later printed insertion; its Talmud references were not checked. The Scripture references were checked: Job 31:10 (JPS: “And let others bow down upon her”), Job 24:22 (JPS: “he trusteth not his own life”), Ezekiel 4:9 (JPS: “Take thou also unto thee wheat”), Ezekiel 26:18 (JPS: “Now shall the isles tremble”; the printed *yacharedun iyyin* differs from the verse’s *yecheredu ha'iyyim*) and Proverbs 31:3 (JPS: “Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings”). The Great Masorah list was not checked.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvishnat achat leKhoresh melekh Paras* — the order of this book is arranged and drawn after the book of Daniel, as explained in Bava Batra, and the passage is a continuation from the one to the other. For it is said in Daniel, “In the first year of his reign I Daniel meditated in the books over the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, seventy years,” and so the whole passage continues, counting, on the destruction of the House and the time of the exile of Babylon, and his confession, which he confessed over the sins of Israel. And the beginning of the order of this book is thus: after Belshazzar was killed, Darius the Mede reigned, as it is said, “And Darius the Mede received the kingdom,” etc.; and after the death of Darius, Cyrus reigned, this king of Persia, and in the first year of his reign seventy years were completed since the visitation of the exile of Babylon, from the day that Jehoiakim was exiled, as it is said (Jeremiah 29), “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will remember you,” etc., that Israel returned from the exile of Babylon to the Land of Israel. And in that year, the first of Cyrus, Israel laid the foundation of the Temple [ב"ה], and the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin informed against them to Cyrus king of Persia, and he commanded to stop the work, not to build any more the building of the Temple. And Israel were idle, not building the House, all the reign of Cyrus and of Ahasuerus who reigned after him, until the second year of the reign of Darius son of Ahasuerus king of Persia, who is Darius son of Esther; and in the second year of his reign they began to build the Temple until the building was completed. And from the first year of Cyrus until the second year of Darius son of Ahasuerus king of Persia, in whose days the House was built, there were eighteen years, to fulfil what is said (Daniel 9), “for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, seventy years,” etc. And now, in the second year of Darius, the seventy years were completed for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, the destruction of the House, when Zedekiah was exiled; and from the exile of Jehoiakim until the exile of Zedekiah, when the House was destroyed, were eighteen years. And now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia seventy years were completed from the exile of Jehoiakim, when Israel were exiled to Babylon, and in this the verse was fulfilled that says (Jeremiah 29), “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon I will remember you,” etc.; and this is the visitation, that Israel returned upon their land and built the foundation of the building of the House, although it was not completed now. It turns out that there were fifty-two years from the exile of Zedekiah, when the House was destroyed, until the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, and eighteen after the first year of Cyrus, which is the second year of Darius king of Persia; seventy years were completed for the desolations of Jerusalem, from the exile of Zedekiah, when the House was destroyed, until the second of Darius, when Israel began to build the building and finished it. And so Seder Olam proves, and tractate Megillah, and this book, as I have explained.
Ezra.translator_note: The Scripture quotations were checked: Daniel 9:2 (JPS: “in the first year of his reign I Daniel meditated in the books, over the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that He would accomplish for the desolations of Jerusalem seventy years”), Daniel 6:1 (JPS: “And Darius the Mede received the kingdom”; the printed Aramaic is as in the verse) and Jeremiah 29:10 (JPS: “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will remember you”). The references in parentheses are later printed insertions. The sums were checked: 52 + 18 = 70. The Talmudic references (Bava Batra, Megillah) and Seder Olam were not checked here. The abbreviation ב"ה is read as “the Temple” from the context (the printed form is kept in brackets); the expansion is not confirmed by a permitted source, so the comment is flagged.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished
Ezra.english_translation: *Lekhalot devar Adonai mi-pi Yirmeyahu* — to the time when the word of the Holy One, blessed be He, which Jeremiah the prophet spoke, was fulfilled, as it is said (there, 29), “For when seventy years are accomplished for Babylon,” etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Jeremiah 29:10 (JPS: “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon”); the printed Hebrew begins “for” and is slightly different from the verse.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia
Ezra.english_translation: *He'ir Adonai et ruach* — will.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: made a proclamation
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol* — a herald proclaimed in all his kingdom.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and put it also in writing
Ezra.english_translation: *Vegam bemichtav* — and also he sent his letter in all his kingdom on this matter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: saying
Ezra.english_translation: *Lemor* — and he said to them thus in the herald’s proclamation which he proclaimed, and in the letter of his writing which he sent in all his kingdom.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Koh amar Khoresh melekh Paras* etc.: *Natan li* — that I am king and ruler over all the kingdoms.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and He hath charged me
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehu pakad alai* — He commanded me through Isaiah the prophet to build for Him the Temple in Jerusalem, as is said in the book (Isaiah 44), “That saith of Cyrus: He is My shepherd, and shall perform all My pleasure; even saying of Jerusalem: She shall be built, and to the temple: My foundation shall be laid. Thus saith the LORD to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden,” etc. (there, 45). And this prophecy had already been spoken by Isaiah.
Ezra.translator_note: Isaiah 44:28 (JPS: “That saith of Cyrus: ‘He is My shepherd, And shall perform all My pleasure’; Even saying of Jerusalem: ‘She shall be built’;”) and the beginning of Isaiah 45:1 (JPS: “And to the temple: ‘My foundation shall be laid.’ Thus saith the LORD to His anointed, To Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden”) were checked; the printed wording is slightly shorter and the Hebrew “and to the temple” follows “even saying of Jerusalem” in the order printed. The references in parentheses are later printed insertions.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in Jerusalem, which is in Judah
Ezra.english_translation: *Birushalayim asher bi-Yehudah* — which is in the province of Judah.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Whosoever there is among you of all His people
Ezra.english_translation: *Mi vakhem* — thus he used to proclaim and write to all the kingdoms: Whoever among you of all the people of the Holy One, blessed be He — may the Holy One, blessed be He, be his help — let him go up and build His house which is in Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And whosoever is left
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol hanish'ar* — and every Jew who remains in his place, who cannot go up because he has no money.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let the men of his place help him
Ezra.english_translation: *Yenas'uhu* — I command the men of his place to give him gifts and lift him up with silver and gold and goods and beasts, so that he may go up to Jerusalem with the freewill-offering that the men of his place will offer for the building of the House; for even among the nations there were some who offered a freewill-offering for the building of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for the house of God which is in Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Levet haElohim asher biYerushalayim* — from “Thus saith Cyrus” until here is the herald’s proclamation and the sending of the letter of writing.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of Judah and Benjamin
Ezra.english_translation: *LiYehudah uVinyamin* — those heads of fathers’ houses of these tribes, of Judah and Benjamin.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: even all whose spirit God had stirred
Ezra.english_translation: *Lekhol he'ir* — with all those whose spirit the LORD stirred to go up and build the House, they went up to Jerusalem to build the House.
Ezra.translator_note: The source lemma *lekhol he'ir* is printed this way; it is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And all they that were round about them
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol sevivoteihem* — and all the peoples who were neighbours of Israel helped and strengthened the hands of the Jews with gold and silver and these gifts, so that they could go up to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: beside all that was willingly offered
Ezra.english_translation: *Levad al kol hitnaddev* — all this the neighbours of the Jews did, apart from what they themselves offered for the building of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and had put them in the house of his gods
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayittenem bevet elohav* — which Nebuchadnezzar placed in his idolatrous temple.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer
Ezra.english_translation: *Al yad Mitredat hagizbar* — such was the name of Cyrus’s treasurer, and Cyrus commanded him to bring them out.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayyispherem* — this treasurer counted them and delivered them to Sheshbazzar so that he might carry them and take them to Jerusalem; and our Rabbis said that he, Sheshbazzar, is Daniel, and why was he called Sheshbazzar? Because he stood through six troubles (*shesh tzarot*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the prince of Judah
Ezra.english_translation: *Hanasi liYehudah* — he is the prince of the tribe of Judah.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And this is the number of them
Ezra.english_translation: *Mispham* — of the vessels of the House of the LORD.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: thirty basins of gold
Ezra.english_translation: *Agartelei* — they are kinds of vessels.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: nine and twenty knives
Ezra.english_translation: *Machalafim* — they are knives, and it is an expression of *bet hachalifot*: because they used to put the knives in it, it was called the chamber of *bet hachalifot*.
Ezra.translator_note: The reference to the “chamber of *bet hachalifot*” is not given a source in the printed text and was not checked here.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: silver bowls
Ezra.english_translation: *Kefurei* — *mizrakim* (sprinkling-bowls); and they are called *kefurei* from an expression of wiping, as in *dekhafar yadeih begelima dechavrei* (“who wipes his hands on his fellow’s garment”), because the one who received the blood in the sprinkling-bowl would wipe off the drops of blood that had spattered upon his hand on the rim of the bowl.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of a second sort
Ezra.english_translation: *Mishnim* — second: other vessels of another kind.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol keilim* — now he includes the count of those enumerated and those not enumerated, all in one count; but he enumerates the important ones.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: were brought up
Ezra.english_translation: *Ha'alot* — an expression of the passive (*yuf'al*).
Ezra.translator_note: The word “(*yuf'al*)” is in parentheses in the printed text and is a later printed insertion.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now these are the children of the province
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'elleh benei hamedinah* — these are the children of Israel, from the province of the Land of Israel, who are going up now from the captivity that was in exile to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and that returned unto Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayyashuvu* — and now they returned to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: every one unto his city
Ezra.english_translation: *VihYehudah* — and the children of Judah returned, each and every one to his city.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: who came with Zerubbabel
Ezra.english_translation: *Asher ba'u* — these children of the province at the beginning, when they were exiled from the Land of Israel to Babylon with Zerubbabel, etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The sentence is translated as printed; it speaks of “exiled to Babylon with Zerubbabel,” where the verse says they “came” with Zerubbabel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Mispar
Ezra.english_translation: *Mispar* — the first, with a *pe* with *kamets*, in *bagadol*, is the name of a man; *mispar* the second, with a *pe* with *patach*, is in the construct state.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed phrase *bagadol* (“in the great”) is not resolved here and is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The number of the men of the people of Israel
Ezra.english_translation: *Anshei am Yisra'el* — these were great and important men, and the others were drawn after them, and therefore he counted them after them separately.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The children of Parosh
Ezra.english_translation: *Benei Par'osh* etc. — there are among them in the passage some where he mentions the name of their father, by reason of the members of the family, and some of them he mentions by the name of their place, to say “the children of such-and-such a place.”

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The priests: The children of Jedaiah
Ezra.english_translation: *Hakohanim benei Yeda'yah* — until now he counted the children of Judah and Benjamin, and from now he goes on counting the priests and the Levites, as it is said above, “Then rose up the heads of fathers’ houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites,” etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Ezra 1:5 (JPS: “Then rose up the heads of fathers’ houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites”); the printed wording is slightly shorter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The singers
Ezra.english_translation: *Hamesorerim* — the Levites who were singers; and so the gatekeepers are the Levites who were gatekeepers of the gates of the Temple.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The Nethinim
Ezra.english_translation: *Hanetinim* — now he counts them, the Nethinim, who were hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and from there came their livelihood.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the children of Solomon’s servants
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvenei avdei Shelomoh* — they were slaves of King Solomon, and these were descendants of their descendants.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And these were they that went up from Tel-melah
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'elleh ha'olim miTel Melach* etc. — and what deed had come to them, and they could not tell, etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The phrase “and what deed had come to them” is translated as printed; its sense is not clear.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and their seed
Ezra.english_translation: *Vezar'am* — of their fathers, because they had lost their lineage and did not know whether they were of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the children of Delaiah
Ezra.english_translation: *Benei Delayah* etc. — they too are included among these who went up from Tel-melah.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite
Ezra.english_translation: *Asher lakach* — each one of the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite took a wife.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and was called after their name
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayikare al shemam* — and the name of Barzillai was called after their name, because they took from his daughters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: These sought their register
Ezra.english_translation: *Elleh* — these priests who were reckoned by lineage, who needed to be reckoned in that register, and the register of their lineage was not found.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: therefore were they deemed polluted
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayiga'alu* — for they were defiled and loathed, so that they would no longer serve with the rest of the priests, because the register of their lineage was not found.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Tirshatha
Ezra.english_translation: *HaTirshata* — he is Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and our Rabbis said that his name was called Tirshatha because the Sages permitted him to drink libation wine of idolaters, since he was cupbearer to the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the most holy things
Ezra.english_translation: *Mikodesh hakodashim* — sin-offerings and guilt-offerings, like the other priests.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim
Ezra.english_translation: *Ad amod kohen* etc. — like a man who says to his fellow, “Until the days of the Messiah this thing will not come up,” and I cannot resolve it until a priest stands up with Urim and Thummim in the Second House, since we find in the first chapter of Yoma that the Second House lacked Urim and Thummim.
Ezra.translator_note: The Talmudic reference was not checked here.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The whole congregation together
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol hakahal kechad* — when all of them were together, with the priests and the Levites and the Nethinim, this count was among them; and the children of Israel counted above are of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin, and those who are lacking from this count, whom you do not find above, were of the other tribes; and so it is explained in Seder Olam: “All the congregation together, four myriads,” etc., and in their details they are only thirty thousand; thirteen thousand, where are they? But they went up from the other tribes.
Ezra.translator_note: The verse’s total is 42,360 (JPS: “forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore”); the printed “thirty thousand” and “thirteen thousand” are round figures (42,360 − 30,000 = 12,360). Seder Olam was not checked here.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: beside their men-servants and their maid-servants
Ezra.english_translation: *Milvad avdeihem ve'amhoteihem* — who were not included in the congregation.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: two hundred singing men and singing women
Ezra.english_translation: *Velahem meshorerim umshorerot matayim* — because they were going up with joy from Babylon to the Land of Israel, they needed male and female singers, so that the women might stroll among them in their great joy.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed verb *metaylot* is feminine plural and is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: offered willingly for the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Hitnaddevu* — they were offering willingly for the building of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: after their ability
Ezra.english_translation: *Kechocham* — according to their strength and their money.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: darics of gold
Ezra.english_translation: *Darkemonim* — the name of a coin of gold.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: one hundred priests’ tunics
Ezra.english_translation: *Uchtonot kohanim* — to serve in them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And when the seventh month was come
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayyagga* — like *vehigia*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the children of Israel were in the cities
Ezra.english_translation: *Hachodesh hashevi'i* — it is the month of Tishri; and the children of Israel who were in the cities, what did they do? “And they all gathered together as one to Jerusalem.”
Ezra.translator_note: The last words are the verse’s (JPS: “the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem”); the printed wording differs slightly.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they set the altar upon its bases
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayakhinu hamizbe'ach al mekhonotav* — in order to offer sacrifices upon it, for they were afraid of the peoples of the lands, lest they provoke them and lest they inform on them to the king; and they built the altar to offer burnt-offerings upon it, so that the peoples would hear and understand the matter that he did by the king’s command, and therefore would refrain from provoking them about the building of the House.
Ezra.translator_note: The subject of “he did” is not stated in the Hebrew; it is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: morning and evening
Ezra.english_translation: *Labboker vela'erev* — the morning continual offering and the continual offering of twilight (*bein ha'arbayim*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: offered the daily burnt-offerings by number
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'olat yom beyom bemispar* — the sacrifices of the festival by their number, according to their ordinance.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and afterward the continual burnt-offering
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'acharei khen* — and after Sukkot they used to offer sacrifices every day, morning and evening.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the offerings of the new moons
Ezra.english_translation: *Velachadashim* — and on the new moons they used to offer the sacrifices of the new moons.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of all the appointed seasons of the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Ulchol mo'adei Adonai* — and for the other festivals, their sacrifices.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of every one that willingly offered a freewill-offering unto the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Ulchol mitnaddev* — and for all those who offered willingly, the priests used to receive their freewill-offerings to offer them; and from the first of Tishri they began to offer sacrifices, and the foundation of the House had not yet been built.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre
Ezra.english_translation: *Latzidonim velatzurim* — the people of Tyre and Sidon, who were craftsmen to build the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto Joppa
Ezra.english_translation: *El yam Yafo* — they used to bring them by way of the sea.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the grant
Ezra.english_translation: *Kerishyon* — as the king’s permission was upon them to build the House. *Rishyon* is an expression of permission, from the root *rashah*; for from *avah* one says *evyon*, and from *tzavah* one says *tzivyon*, and from *chazah* *chizayon*, and from *ra'ah* *ra'ayon*, from *chavah* *chivyon*, and from *rashah* one says *reshut*, as from *anah* *anut*, and from *shavah* *shevut*, and from *ra'ah* *re'ut*, and from *zanah* *zenut*. So *reshut* and *rishyon* are found coming from one root according to the measure of grammar, and they are one language; and Menachem connected it to the expression *areshet sefateinu* and was not exact about its root, although these two views are close to each other in meaning.
Ezra.translator_note: The Hebrew grammatical forms are transliterated as printed. “*Areshet sefateinu*” is as printed (compare Psalms 21:3, JPS: “the request of his lips”; the printed ending differs).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the second month
Ezra.english_translation: *Bachodesh hasheni* — it is the month of Iyyar.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: out of the captivity
Ezra.english_translation: *Mehashevi* — all those who came from the captivity to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and appointed the Levites
Ezra.english_translation: *Vaya'amidu* — they appointed the Levites, the singers, to lead (*lenatze'ach*) and to say song before the builders at the time of the building of the foundation of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to have the oversight of the work of the house of the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Lenatze'ach* — these two *nitzuchim* are *nitzuchim* of song, like “For the Leader (with string-music), a Psalm of David” (Psalms 4).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Psalms 4:1 (JPS: “For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.”). The word “(with string-music)” and the reference in parentheses are later printed insertions.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren
Ezra.english_translation: *Vaya'amod Yeshua* — they stood and said song together around the doers of the work of the foundation of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: laid the foundation
Ezra.english_translation: *Veyissedu* — a strong form from *yesod*, like *vayyasdu tiroteihem*; and so *vayyeshvu* from *yashav* and *vayyasdu* from *yasad*, and their meaning is *vayyasdu* and *vayyeshvu*, in a strong form with two yods, one the action and one of the *yesod*; and their explanation is: they were founding, settling.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed grammatical explanation is compressed and its construction is not resolved; it is translated as printed. No reference is printed for “*vayyasdu tiroteihem*.”

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayissedu habonim* — and the builders were founding the foundation of the Temple of the LORD, at the time when they were leading in their song; and they set the priests, dressed in garments of honour, with trumpets in their hands to blow with them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Levites the sons of Asaph
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehaleviyim benei Asaf* — were singing.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: with cymbals
Ezra.english_translation: *Bimtzaltayim* — like (Psalms 150) “*tzaltzelei shama*”; they are musical instruments.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Psalms 150:5 (JPS: “Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the direction of David king of Israel
Ezra.english_translation: *Al yedei David* — for they were leading and singing songs and thanksgivings of David king of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they sang one to another
Ezra.english_translation: *Vaya'anu* — an expression of answering with song, like “And Miriam answered them” (Exodus 15).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Exodus 15:21 (JPS: “And Miriam sang unto them”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvehodot* — and in thanksgivings.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed word is abbreviated (*uvehodiyot*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for He is good
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki tov* — to give thanks to the LORD.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: all the people shouted with a great shout
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol ha'am* — the rest of the people of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid
Ezra.english_translation: *Al hussad* — all these joys they were making over the building of the foundation that was laid in the House of the LORD.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: standing on its foundation
Ezra.english_translation: *Beyosdo* — in its foundation, from the noun of *yussad* (“it was founded”); and from *yasad* one says *beyosdo*, like from *chodesh* *bechodsho*, from *kodesh* *bekodsho*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: when this house was before their eyes
Ezra.english_translation: *Zeh habayit* — when they saw the building of this House, they wept, because they remembered that great building of the First House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: many shouted aloud for joy
Ezra.english_translation: *Verabbim* — those who had not seen the building of the First House were rejoicing and shouting for joy in a loud voice from the abundance of their joy at having come out of their exile.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ein ha'am makkirim* — those who were listening did not recognise the sound of the shout of joy because of the sound of the people’s weeping; for the rejoicing people were raising a great shout, and the sound of the weeping was heard more and more, even to a distance.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard
Ezra.english_translation: *Tzarei Yehudah uVinyamin* — they are the idolaters (*akum*) whom Sennacherib settled in the Land of Israel, as it is said (II Kings 17), “And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Avva, and from Hamath and from Sepharvaim, and settled them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel.”
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is II Kings 17:24 (JPS: “And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Let us build with you
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayomru lahem nivneh immakhem* — they were saying so in order that the work of the House would be stopped by them, so that it would not be built any more.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assyria
Ezra.english_translation: *Mimei Esar Chaddon melekh Ashur* — the son of Sennacherib; for after Sennacherib settled them there, Adrammelech and Sarezer his sons killed him, and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place, as it is said (Isaiah 36), “And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sarezer his sons smote him with the sword,” etc.; “and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.”
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 37:38, not Isaiah 36 as printed (JPS: “And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sarezer his sons smote him with the sword … And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: but we ourselves together will build
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki anachnu* — but we alone will build; for this (*ki*) serves in the place of *ella* (“but”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then the people of the land
Ezra.english_translation: *Am ha'aretz* — they are the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: weakened the hands of the people of Judah
Ezra.english_translation: *Mapim* — to stop them from their work.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: while they were building
Ezra.english_translation: *Livnot* — like *milivnot*, and likewise “until he left off numbering.”
Ezra.translator_note: No reference is printed for the second phrase; it occurs at Genesis 41:49 (JPS: “until they left off numbering”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and hired counsellors against them
Ezra.english_translation: *Vesochrim* — it is written with a *samekh*, and its meaning is as if it were written with a *shin*: they were hiring counsellors in order to stop the work.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: all the days of Cyrus king of Persia
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol yemei* — of the reign of Cyrus and the reign of Ahasuerus who reigned after Cyrus; until the second year of Darius, who reigned after Ahasuerus, the work was stopped.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And in the reign of Ahasuerus
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvmalkhut Achashverosh* — who reigned after Cyrus is Ahasuerus, who took Esther.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wrote they an accusation
Ezra.english_translation: *Katvu sitnah* — not to build the Temple.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Al yoshvei Yehudah viYerushalayim* — to inform on them and provoke them, that they should not build the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And in the days of Artaxerxes
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvimei Artachshasta* — he is Cyrus king of Persia. The number of the letters of Cyrus comes to the number of the letters of Darius, and so we learned in tractate Rosh Hashanah: he is Cyrus, he is Darius, he is Artaxerxes: Cyrus because he was a good king, Artaxerxes by reason of the kingdom; and in Seder Olam I found that Darius is Artaxerxes, and the whole kingdom is called Artaxerxes, etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The claim that “the number of the letters” of Cyrus equals that of Darius is translated as printed; by the usual letter values the words come to 526 (כורש) and 520 (דריוש), so the printed claim is not reconciled here. The Talmud and Seder Olam references were not checked.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wrote Bishlam
Ezra.english_translation: *Katav Bishlam* — he wrote his letter in words of peace (*shalom*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Mithredath, Tabeel
Ezra.english_translation: *Mitredat Tavel* — the name of a man; he is one of the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the rest of his companions
Ezra.english_translation: *Ushe'ar kenavtav* — his associates and his parties.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto Artaxerxes king of Persia
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Artachshasta* — to Artaxerxes.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the writing of the letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Uchtav hanishtevan* — and the writing of the letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: written in the Aramaic character
Ezra.english_translation: *Katuv Aramit* — in Aramaic letters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: set forth in the Aramaic tongue
Ezra.english_translation: *Umetargam Aramit* — the letter was explained in the Aramaic language.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Rehum the commander
Ezra.english_translation: *Rechum ba'al ta'am* — Rehum was the recorder and master of words to arrange the letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Shimshai the scribe
Ezra.english_translation: *Ushimshai safra* — and Shimshai was a scribe; he is Shimshai son of Haman. And so it is the way of Scripture to mention the scribe and the recorder both together, because they need each other: the one arranges and records, and the scribe writes, as it is said (I Kings 4), “Elihoreph and Ahijah the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder”; and in another place it is said, “Then came out Eliakim son of Hilkiah,” etc. (there, II 18), “and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.”
Ezra.translator_note: The quotations are I Kings 4:3 (JPS: “Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder”) and II Kings 18:18 (JPS: “there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder”); the printed “there, II 18” is II Kings 18:18. The identification with Haman’s son is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wrote a letter against Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Katvu igga'ra* — these two, Rehum and Shimshai, wrote the letter as Mithredath and Tabeel had commanded them, and all of them were settled in the cities of Samaria.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: against Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Yerushalem* — about the building of the Temple [ב"ה] which is in Jerusalem.
Ezra.translator_note: The abbreviation ב"ה is read as “the Temple” from the context (the printed form is kept in brackets); the expansion is not confirmed by a permitted source, so the comment is flagged.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in this sort
Ezra.english_translation: *Kenemah* — “as it is said”; and it is like the language of the Gemara, “as we need to say before us” (*kidva'inan lemimar kaman*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: then wrote
Ezra.english_translation: *Adayin* — then.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Rehum the commander
Ezra.english_translation: *Rechum* — the name of a man.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the commander
Ezra.english_translation: *Ba'al ta'am* — recorder and master of words.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the rest of their companions
Ezra.english_translation: *Ush'ar kenavtehon* — and the rest of their parties.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Dinites, and the Apharesattechites
Ezra.english_translation: *Dinaye ve'Afarsatkhaye* etc. — all of these are names of idolaters (*akum*) whom Sennacherib settled in the cities of Samaria.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Apharesites
Ezra.english_translation: *Afarsaye* — they are Persians whom Sennacherib settled in the cities of Samaria.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Archevites
Ezra.english_translation: *Arkevaye* — they are the people of Erech, as it is said, “and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh” (Genesis 10).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Genesis 10:10 (JPS: “and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Babylonians
Ezra.english_translation: *Bavlaye* — they are the people of Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Shushanchites
Ezra.english_translation: *Shushankhaye* — the people of Shushan the capital.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Elamites
Ezra.english_translation: *Elmaye* — the people of Elam; of all these idolaters Sennacherib settled in the Land of Israel, and all of them were replying and agreeing to the sending of this letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and the rest of the nations
Ezra.english_translation: *Ush'ar umayya* — and the rest of the idolaters whom Sennacherib exiled, all of them agreed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Asenappar
Ezra.english_translation: *Osnappar* — Sennacherib.
Ezra.translator_note: The identification is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the great and noble
Ezra.english_translation: *Rabba veyakkira* — for he was a great and honoured king, as it is said, “Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria” (Isaiah 36).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 36:4 (JPS: “Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: brought over, and set
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehotiv hemo* — he settled them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the city of Samaria
Ezra.english_translation: *Bekiryah di Shomrayin* — in the cities around Samaria.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the rest that are in the country beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Ush'ar avar naharah* — and the rest of the idolaters beyond the river; for since the river, the Euphrates, separates between the Land of Israel and Babylon, those idolaters on the side of the Land of Israel are beyond the river relative to those who stand in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And now
Ezra.english_translation: *Uke'enet* — a place name; and the people of Ke'enet, all of them were agreeing to the sending of this letter.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed form *uke'enet* is translated as a place name, as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this is the copy of the letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Denah parshegen igga'rta* — and this is the explanation of the letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this is the copy of the letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Parshegen* — like *patshegen hakketav*.
Ezra.translator_note: No reference is printed; the phrase occurs at Esther 3:14 (JPS: “The copy of the writing”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that they sent unto him
Ezra.english_translation: *Di shalechu alohi* — which they sent to him.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: even unto Artaxerxes the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Artachshasta* — to Artaxerxes.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: thy servants the men beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Avdekha enash avar naharah uke'enet* — your servants are the men of beyond the river and the men of Ke'enet; all the idolaters counted here are included in this, for all of them were on the side of the Land of Israel, which is beyond the river relative to those dwelling in Babylon. And this is the beginning of the letter, “Thy servants, the men beyond the River,” etc., until *la ayt lakh*.
Ezra.translator_note: The ending of the letter is Ezra 4:16 (JPS: “thou shalt have no portion beyond the River”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: be it known unto the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Yedia lehevei lemalka* — a known matter shall it be to the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that the Jews that came up from thee are come to us unto Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Di Yehudaye* — that the Jews who went up from you to us came to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they are building the rebellious and the bad city
Ezra.english_translation: *Kiryeta mardata uvishta binyan* — a rebellious and sinful city they are building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and have finished the walls
Ezra.english_translation: *Veshuraye* — that they have finished, and the walls they have founded.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: are digging out the foundations
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'ushaya* — the walls.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: are digging out the foundations
Ezra.english_translation: *Yachitu* — an expression of thread, like “if from a thread (*michut*)” (Genesis 9) — for they dig and join the walls one with another.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Genesis 14:23, not Genesis 9 as printed (JPS: “that I will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Be it known now unto the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Ke'an yedia* — now let it be known to the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: if this city be builded
Ezra.english_translation: *Di hen kiryeta dekh titbenei* — that if this city is built.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this city
Ezra.english_translation: *Dekh* — this.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and the walls finished
Ezra.english_translation: *Veshuraya yishtakhlelun* — and the walls will be founded.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: tribute, impost, or toll
Ezra.english_translation: *Mindah velo vahalakh* — they are kinds of taxes, and poll-money.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they will not pay
Ezra.english_translation: *Lo yitnun* — they will not give tax any more.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: thou wilt endamage the revenue of the kings
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'afatom melakhim tahanzek* — and the tax of the kings will be damaged, so that they will not give any more tax to the kings.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: we eat the salt of the palace
Ezra.english_translation: *Ke'an kol kevel di melach heikhala melachna* — now, in view of this matter, that we wish to destroy the destruction of the Temple; *di melach* is an expression of destruction and desolation, like “a salt land and not inhabited.”
Ezra.translator_note: No reference is printed; the quotation is Jeremiah 17:6 (JPS: “A salt land and not inhabited”). Rashi reads *melach* as “destruction,” where the JPS text reads “we eat the salt of the palace.”

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: we eat the salt of the palace
Ezra.english_translation: *Melachna* — we wish to pull down and destroy.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the king’s dishonour
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'arvat malka* — and the king’s shame.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: it is not meet for us to see
Ezra.english_translation: *Lo arikh* — it is not fitting for us to see; *arikh* means “fitting,” like “*arikh o lo arikh*” in tractate Sukkah.
Ezra.translator_note: The Talmud reference was not checked here.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: therefore have we sent and announced to the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Al denah* — about this we sent and informed the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers
Ezra.english_translation: *Di yevakar* — that the one who investigates and searches may investigate in the book of the records of your fathers, the earlier kings.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: so shalt thou find in the book of the records
Ezra.english_translation: *Vetehashkach* — and you will find it in the book of the records and you will know that this city is a rebellious city, and one that damages the kings and the provinces.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: moved sedition within the same
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ishtaddur avdin bagvah* — and rebellion its inhabitants were making within it, for Israel were rebelling against the kings of the idolaters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of old time
Ezra.english_translation: *Min yemot alma* — from the days of the world, from ancient days; so was their custom, to rebel against the kings of the idolaters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for which cause was this city laid waste
Ezra.english_translation: *Al denah* — for this reason this city was laid waste.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: We announce to the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Mehodin anachnah lemalka* — we inform the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: if this city be builded, and the walls finished
Ezra.english_translation: *Di hen kiryeta dekh* — that if this city is built and its walls founded.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: by this means
Ezra.english_translation: *Lekabel denah* — accordingly, and for this reason you have no portion in all beyond the river, because Israel will rebel against you and take everything from your hand.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: thou shalt have no portion beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Be'avar naharah* — it is all the land on the side of the Land of Israel, which is beyond the river relative to those in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then sent the king an answer
Ezra.english_translation: *Pitgama shelach malka* — the king sent a word.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto Rehum the commander, and to Shimshai the scribe
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Rechum ba'al ta'am* — to Rehum the recorder and Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their parties dwelling in the cities of Samaria, and to the rest of the idolaters who are beyond the river on the side of the Land of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Peace, and now
Ezra.english_translation: *Shelam uke'et* — they are places; and *uke'et* is like *uke'enet*; sometimes he calls it so, and sometimes so.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the letter which you sent unto us hath been plainly read before me
Ezra.english_translation: *Nishtevana* — the writing of the letter that you sent to us was explained and read before me.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And I decreed
Ezra.english_translation: *Sim ta'am* — and from me was the placing of a matter, a command that I commanded.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and search hath been made, and it is found
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvakaru vehashkachu* — and they examined the book of the records of the kings and found it written that this city from the days of old was exalting and raising itself over all the kings of the idolaters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: rebellion and sedition
Ezra.english_translation: *Umerad* — and rebelliousness they were making in it, to rebel against the kings of the idolaters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Umlakhin takifin* — and strong kings were in Jerusalem, who ruled and had dominion over all beyond the river on the side of the Land of Israel, as it is said of Solomon, “for he had dominion over all beyond the river,” etc. (I Kings 4). And taxes and poll-money were given to them, for the idolaters used to bring up tax to them.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is I Kings 5:4 in the numbering of the site, not 4 as printed (JPS: “For he had dominion over all the region on this side the River”); the printed wording is slightly shorter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Make you now a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Ke'an simu ta'am* — now make a decree, to proclaim in the land to stop these men, the children of Israel, from building, and this city, Jerusalem, shall not be built until the matter is placed by me, to build the city according to my mind and my permission.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: take heed that you be not slack herein
Ezra.english_translation: *Vezehirin hevu shalu* — and be careful lest you do postponement and error; *shalu* is *destorbier* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 4:22 (“une faute”), in forms such as דישטורביר and דישטובייר; the printed form (דשטורביר) is a variant spelling. Darmesteter reads it *destorber* (from Latin *disturbare*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: slack herein
Ezra.english_translation: *Lema'bad al denah* — to do about this.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings
Ezra.english_translation: *Lemah yisge* — why should the deed of destruction grow in this city to harm the kings. Up to here is the answer of Cyrus which he sent back.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ע"כ is read as *ad kan* (“up to here”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then when
Ezra.english_translation: *Adayin* — then.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Di farshegen* — from the explanation of the writing of the letter of Artaxerxes the king, who is Cyrus, was this deed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: was read before Rehum
Ezra.english_translation: *Keri kodam* — the writing of the letter was read before Rehum and Shimshai and their party, and they went in haste and in panic to Jerusalem to the Jews and stopped them by force and power so that they should no longer build the building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto the Jews
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Yehudaye* — to the Jews.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they went in haste to Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Hemo* — they.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Be'adayin* — then the work of the building of the house of God in Jerusalem was idle until the second year of Darius king of Persia: after Cyrus reigned Ahasuerus, who took Esther, and after Ahasuerus reigned Darius, the son of Ahasuerus, who is the son of Esther. And from the first year of Cyrus king of Persia until the second year of Darius were eighteen years, which completed seventy years for the desolations of Jerusalem; for from the destruction of the House, when Zedekiah was exiled, until the first year of Cyrus were fifty-two years, as explained in Seder Olam, and eighteen years from the first year of Cyrus until the second year of Darius: seventy complete years are found. And in the second year of Darius they began to build the building until they finished it.
Ezra.translator_note: The sums were checked: 52 + 18 = 70. Seder Olam was not checked here.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehitnabbi Chaggai nevi'a* — and now, in the second year of Darius, Haggai and Zechariah the prophets prophesied to the Jews who were in the Land of Judah and in Jerusalem, in the name of the God of Israel, to them, to build the building of the House without the permission of King Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Yehudaye* — to the Jews.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: prophesied they unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Aleihon* — to them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then rose up Zerubbabel
Ezra.english_translation: *Be'adayin* — then.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Veshariyu* — they began to build the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is in Jerusalem, and with them the prophets of the Holy One, blessed be He, helping and assisting them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: At the same time came to them Tattenai
Ezra.english_translation: *Bah zimna atah aleihon* — at that time these adversaries of Judah and Benjamin came upon them to provoke and inform on them about the matter of the building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the governor beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Pachat avar naharah* — the rule of beyond the river.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and their companions
Ezra.english_translation: *Uchnavatehon* — and their party.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and said thus unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Vechen amerin lehom* — and so they used to say to them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Who gave you a decree to build this house
Ezra.english_translation: *Man sam* — who commanded you the matter of building the House?

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and to finish this structure
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'ushrana denah leshachlelah* — these walls, to found, like “*ve'ushaya yachitu*” (above 4), and the building of the walls of bricks; so Menachem explained it.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Ezra 4:12 (JPS: “are digging out the foundations”). The verb *tibro* is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then spoke we unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Adayin* — then.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: after this manner
Ezra.english_translation: *Kenemah* — as it is said.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: spoke we unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Amarna lehom* — they said to Israel, those adversaries of Judah and Benjamin.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: What are the names of the men
Ezra.english_translation: *Man inun* — who are the names of the men?

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that build this building
Ezra.english_translation: *Di denah* — who are building this building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ein elahehom* — and the eye of the Holy One, blessed be He, who is their God, was upon the elders of the Jews, to raise them in the work of the building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and they did not make them cease
Ezra.english_translation: *Velo bittelu hemo* — and they did not stop the builders.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: till the matter should come to Darius
Ezra.english_translation: *Ad ta'ama leDaryavesh yehakh* — and the elders of the Jews replied a word to those adversaries, that they should not stop the building until the matter goes to King Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and then answer should be returned by letter concerning it
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'adayin yetivun* — and then the Jews will reply the writing of the letter on this, on the answer of Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The copy of the letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Parshegen* — the explanation of the *patshegen* of the letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and his companions
Ezra.english_translation: *Uchnavatah* — and his parties.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the Apharesachites
Ezra.english_translation: *Afarsekhaye* — they are one nation who were among their parties.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: sent unto Darius the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Daryavesh malka* — to Darius the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they sent a letter unto him
Ezra.english_translation: *Aloh* — to him.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wherein was written thus
Ezra.english_translation: *Ukhdenah katav bigvah* — and thus was written inside the letter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: all peace
Ezra.english_translation: *Shelama kula* — all peace be to him.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Be it known unto the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Yedia lehevei lemalka* — a known matter shall it be to the king.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that we went into the province of Judah
Ezra.english_translation: *Di azalna* — that we went to the Land of Judah, the province, to the house of the great God.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: which is builded with great stones
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehu mitbena* — and it, the House, is built.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: great stones
Ezra.english_translation: *Gelal* — *marbre* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 5:8 (“marbre”), in forms such as מרברא; the printed form (מרמר"א) differs, with מ where Darmesteter’s forms have ב.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: timber is laid in the walls
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'a mitsam bechatalaya* — and wood put and placed in the walls to strengthen the building so that it will stand many days.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this work goeth on
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'avidta dekh* — and this work.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: with diligence
Ezra.english_translation: *Asparna mit'abdah* — quickly it was being done.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: with diligence
Ezra.english_translation: *Asparna* — *apantominesh* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 5:8 (“rapidement”), in forms such as אישפליטומנט and אשפלייטונשא; the printed form (אפנטומינש) differs from them and could not be matched.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: prospereth in their hands
Ezra.english_translation: *Umatzlach bidehom* — and this deed was made to prosper in their hands.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then asked we those elders
Ezra.english_translation: *Adayin* — then, when we saw the building, we asked these elders.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and said unto them thus
Ezra.english_translation: *Kenemah amarna lehom* — as was said nearby, we said to them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Who gave you a decree to build this house
Ezra.english_translation: *Man sam lekhon* — who placed for you the matter of this House, to build it, and these walls, to found them?

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and to finish this wall
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ushrana* — the building of a wall of bricks.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: We asked them their names also
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'af shemahatehom* — and also the names of the builders, the heads of the building, we asked them, in order to inform you.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that we might write the names of the men
Ezra.english_translation: *Di nikhtov* — that we may write the names of the men to you.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that were at the head of them
Ezra.english_translation: *Di verashehom* — who of themselves and by their own authority arose to build the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And thus they returned us answer
Ezra.english_translation: *Ukhenemah pitgama* — as the matter was said.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they returned us answer
Ezra.english_translation: *Hatevuna* — they replied a word to us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth
Ezra.english_translation: *Anachna hemo* — we are the servants of the God of heaven and earth.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: build the house that was builded these many years ago
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvenyan beita* — and we are building the House that was built before this, many years ago.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: which a great king of Israel builded and finished
Ezra.english_translation: *Umelekh leYisra'el rav* — and a great king that Israel had, he is King Solomon, built it and founded it.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: But because that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven
Ezra.english_translation: *Lahen* — and now, because our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of the king of Babylon the Chaldean, and destroyed this House, and exiled the people to Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Baram* — but in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus commanded in this matter to build the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And the gold and silver vessels also of the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'af ma'neya* — the holy vessels of silver and gold which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the Sanctuary which is in Jerusalem and carried to his sanctuary in Babylon, Cyrus took out of the sanctuary of the king of Babylon and delivered into the hand of Sheshbazzar, who is Daniel, whose name was so.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and brought them into the temple of Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehivel hemo* — and carried them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Hanfek hemo* — took them out.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor
Ezra.english_translation: *Di pechah shemeh* — for he was a prince and governor (*pechah*), and his name was called *pechah*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and he said unto him
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'amar leh* — and thus Cyrus said to Sheshbazzar: Take these vessels and go and bring them down into the Sanctuary which is in Jerusalem, and the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, shall be built on its place.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then came the same Sheshbazzar
Ezra.english_translation: *Adayin* — then.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and laid the foundations of the house of God which is in Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Sheshbatzar dekh* — this one came and set the walls of the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is in Jerusalem, and from then until now the House was being built and the building was not finished.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Uke'an* — and now, if it is good to the king, let the matter be known and investigated in the treasure-house of the king which is there in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Hen ityah* — if there is this deed, that a word went out from the mouth of Cyrus to build this house which is in Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let the king send his pleasure to us
Ezra.english_translation: *Ur'ut malka* — the will of the king; therefore let him send to us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: concerning this matter
Ezra.english_translation: *Aleina* — to us. Up to here the writing of the letter that Tattenai and Shethar-bozenai sent.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ע"כ is read as *ad kan* (“up to here”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then Darius the king made a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Be'adayin* — then, when the letter reached the hand of Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: made a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Sam ta'am* — the king commanded the matter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: search was made in the house of the archives
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvakaru* — and they examined the house of the books where the treasures are laid, in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And there was found at Ahmetha
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehishtekach be'Achmeta* — and a writing of a scroll was found there in Ahmetha. So the interpreters explained: it is a vessel made for letters and for sheets and for books, and they derived it from the root of *chemet mayim* (a waterskin); and the *aleph* that is in the word is not a root letter, like the other words in the rest of the Aramaic language.
Ezra.translator_note: The grammatical explanation is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the palace that is in the province of Media
Ezra.english_translation: *Bevirta* — in that capital which is in the province of Media.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and therein was thus written
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhen ketiv* — and so was written in it a record of it.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Bet elaha biYerushelem* — concerning the house of God in Jerusalem, what shall be about it: the House shall be built.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the place where they offer sacrifices
Ezra.english_translation: *Atar di davechin* — which is the place where they sacrifice a sacrifice.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let the foundations thereof be strongly laid
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ushohi mesovelin* — and its walls shall be founded, like *ve'ushaya yachitu* (above).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Ezra 4:12 (JPS: “are digging out the foundations”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the height thereof threescore cubits
Ezra.english_translation: *Rumeh amin shitin* — the height of the House sixty cubits, and sixty cubits its breadth.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: with three rows of great stones
Ezra.english_translation: *Nidbakhin* — an expression of walls; and the rows of the walls were of *gelal* stone; *gelal* is *marbre* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 6:4 (“marbre”), in forms such as מרברא; the printed form (מרמר"א) differs, with מ where Darmesteter’s forms have ב.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: a row of new timber
Ezra.english_translation: *Venidbakh* — and a wall of new wood on the inside, like the structure of the House that Solomon built.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let the expenses be given out of the king’s house
Ezra.english_translation: *Unfakta* — and expense for the need of the House and for the other matters of the House shall be given to them from the king’s house.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the gold and silver vessels of the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'af ma'ney* — and also the holy vessels of the house of God, of gold and silver, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the Sanctuary in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and brought unto Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehivel* — which he carried.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: be restored
Ezra.english_translation: *Yehatevun* — they shall be given.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: every one to its place
Ezra.english_translation: *Veyehakh* — all this thing shall go to the Sanctuary which is in Jerusalem, to its place.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: thou shalt put them in the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Vetachat* — and it shall be placed in the house of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now therefore, Tattenai
Ezra.english_translation: *Ke'an Tatnai* etc. — this is the answer which Darius replied to Tattenai and Shethar-bozenai.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: who are beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Di be'avar naharah* — on the side of the Land of Israel, which is beyond the river relative to those in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: be you far from thence
Ezra.english_translation: *Rachikin hevu min tamah* — you shall be far from there, from the building of the Temple, that you not weaken the hands of the workers.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed abbreviation בהמ"ק is read as *bet hamikdash* (“the Temple”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Dekh* — this.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let the governor of the Jews
Ezra.english_translation: *Pachat Yehudaye* — the rulers of the Jews shall do this thing.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and the elders of the Jews
Ezra.english_translation: *Velisabei Yehudaye* — and to the elders of the Jews I command.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Bet elaha dekh* — this house of God.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Moreover I make a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Umenni sim ta'am* — and from me shall this command be.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: concerning what you shall do to these elders of the Jews
Ezra.english_translation: *Lema di ta'avdun* — to that building work which you shall do with these elders of the Jews, to build the house of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that of the king’s goods
Ezra.english_translation: *Umin nikhsei malka* — from the king’s property shall they make this building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: even of the tribute beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Di middat avar naharah* — from the tax of beyond the river that belongs to the king; *middat* is a measure of tax, like *mindah, balo, vahalakh* (above 4). *Asparna*: quickly shall the building be built; *asparna* is *esploitement* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Ezra 4:13 (JPS: “tribute, impost, or toll”). Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 5:8 (“rapidement”), in forms such as אישפליטומנט and אישפלוייטושמנט; the printed form (אישפלונטמנ"ט) is close to them but differs in some letters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: expenses be given with all diligence unto these men
Ezra.english_translation: *Nifkta tehevei mityahava* — expense shall be given to these men, that they not be idle from their work.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And that which they have need of
Ezra.english_translation: *Umah chashchan* — and whatever they will need.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs
Ezra.english_translation: *Uvnei tevarin* — young bulls and rams and lambs for burnt-offerings to the God of heaven.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wheat, salt, wine, and oil
Ezra.english_translation: *Vachintin* — for fine flour and salt for the sacrifices, and wine for the libations, and oil for the meal-offerings; as the priests who are in Jerusalem shall say, it shall be given to them day by day.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: without fail
Ezra.english_translation: *Di lah shalu* — without delay: *sans destorbier* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 6:9 (“sans commettre de faute”), in forms such as שאנץ דישטורביר; the printed form (שנ"צ דישטורבי"ר) is a variant spelling.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savour unto the God of heaven
Ezra.english_translation: *Di lehon* — in order that they may offer pleasing offerings to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Also I have made a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Umenni sim ta'am* — and from me a command has been placed and a matter set, that every man who changes this word shall be torn out (*yitnasach*): his beams shall be uprooted from his house, so that his house will be destroyed; *yitnasach* is like “and ye shall be plucked (*venissachtem*) from off the land” (Deuteronomy 28).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Deuteronomy 28:63 (JPS: “you shall be plucked from off the land”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let him be lifted up and fastened thereon
Ezra.english_translation: *Vezekif yitmecha alohi* — and a tree to hang him shall be raised over him, so that he is hanged on the tree.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let his house be made a dunghill
Ezra.english_translation: *Uveiteh nevalu yit'avid* — and his house shall be made a refuse-heap for this.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: dunghill
Ezra.english_translation: *Nevalu* — a matter of filth and latrines.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and may the God that hath caused His name to dwell there
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'elaha di shakhen shemeh* — and God, who made His name dwell there.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: overthrow all kings and peoples
Ezra.english_translation: *Yemaggar* — shall overthrow and cast down every king and every people who shall stretch out his hand to destroy and to ruin this house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: I Darius have made a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Sametti ta'am* — I placed the command of this matter, that the building be made quickly. Up to here is the answer of Darius.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ע"כ is read as *ad kan* (“up to here”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: because that Darius the king had thus sent
Ezra.english_translation: *Kenemah* — as was said.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: acted with all diligence
Ezra.english_translation: *Asparna avadu* — quickly they did.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And the elders of the Jews builded and prospered
Ezra.english_translation: *Usevei Yehudaye* — and the elders of the Jews were building and prospering in their work according to the prophecy of Haggai and Zechariah, and they built and founded the building from the command of the God of Israel and from the permission of Cyrus, king of Persia the first, in whose days the foundation of the building was begun, and from the permission of this Darius king of Persia.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and Artaxerxes king of Persia
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'Artachshasta* — he is Darius, and he is called Artaxerxes after the province and the kingdom, for all the kings of Persia were called so, just as all the kings of Egypt are called Pharaoh.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar
Ezra.english_translation: *Veshetziu* — this house; and the end of the completion of this House was on the third day of the month of Adar, which is the sixth year of Darius the king; and it turns out that the building of the House was four years.
Ezra.translator_note: The sum was checked: second year to sixth year is 4 years.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they offered at the dedication of this house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehikrivu lachanukkat* — they offered these sacrifices at the dedication of this House, and it was a temporary ruling (*hora'at sha'ah*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they set the priests in their divisions
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehekimu khahanaya bifluggatehon* — for the priests were divided in their service, and the Levites in watches.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month
Ezra.english_translation: *Et haPesach* — now Israel made the Passover on the fourteenth of Nisan, the one that comes after this Adar in which the building was finished.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and for themselves
Ezra.english_translation: *Velahem* — and for themselves.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the nations of the land
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol hanivdal* — they are the proselytes who separated from the impurity of idol-worship to cleave to Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: had turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehesev lev melekh Ashur aleihem* — and the Holy One, blessed be He, turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward Israel who dwelt under his rule in the land of Assyria, to strengthen them and to help in the work of the building.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now after these things
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'achar hadevarim ha'elleh* — of the building of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Artaxerxes king of Persia
