Ezra.english_translation: *Artachshasta* — he is Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and the king granted him all his request
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayitten lo hamelekh* — Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him
Ezra.english_translation: *Keyad Adonai Elohav alav* — as the Holy One, blessed be He, commanded concerning him; and the verse is transposed: “and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.” And our Rabbis of blessed memory said: Ezra is Malachi.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the seventh year
Ezra.english_translation: *Bishnat sheva* — it is the year after the completion of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of Artaxerxes the king
Ezra.english_translation: *LeArtachshasta* — he is Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the fifth month
Ezra.english_translation: *Bachodesh hachamishi* — it is the month of Av; for on the first of the month of Nisan, that day was the beginning of their going up from Babylon, and on the first of the month of Av they came to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: began he to go up from Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Yesod hama'alah* — the foundation of the beginning of the going up.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the good hand of his God upon him
Ezra.english_translation: *Keyad Elohav* — as the hand of the Holy One, blessed be He, made them succeed, whose hand was good upon him, to make him succeed in his ways.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: For Ezra had set his heart
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki Ezra* etc. — and therefore he went and succeeded in his way, for Ezra set his heart, etc.; he gives a reason for his words.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: this is the copy of the letter
Ezra.english_translation: *Vezeh parshegen hanishtevan* — and this is the *patshegen* of the writing.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and of His statutes to Israel
Ezra.english_translation: *Vechukkav al Yisra'el* — and His statutes which He commanded upon Israel, to keep them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven
Ezra.english_translation: *Sefar data* — a book of Torah.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and so forth. And now
Ezra.english_translation: *Gemir uke'enet* — it is a doubt in his hand.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed phrase *sefeka hi beyado* (“it is a doubt in his hand”) is translated as printed; its sense here is not resolved.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: I make a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Menni sim ta'am* — from me goes forth the permission, that everyone whose spirit moved him, of Israel, of the priests and the Levites, to go to Jerusalem, shall go with you.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol kevel* — because of this, from the king and his seven counsellors, who see the king’s face, you are sent.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and his seven counsellors
Ezra.english_translation: *Veshiv'at ya'atohi* — and his seven counsellors, they are the seven who see the king’s face.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Levakkara al Yehud* — in order to inquire and examine concerning the Jews who are in Jerusalem, whether they are occupied with the Torah of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is in your hand.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and to carry the silver and gold
Ezra.english_translation: *Ulhaval* — and to carry silver and gold of the king and his counsellors, which he offered to the God of Israel to repair His house, whose dwelling and house are in Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and all the silver and gold that thou shalt find in all the province of Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol kesef udehav* — and all the freewill gifts of silver and gold that you will find in the province of Babylon, with the rest of the freewill gifts of the people and the priests who offer for the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is in Jerusalem, you shall carry all to Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: therefore thou shalt with all diligence
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol kevel denah* — and for this, for the services of the Temple, quickly you shall buy with this money oxen and rams and lambs, and sacrifices and meal-offerings and libations, and offer them on the altar of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee and to thy brethren
Ezra.english_translation: *Umah di alekh* — and whatever is good for you and your brothers, with the remainder of the silver and the gold, to do the will of the Holy One, blessed be He, you shall do.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And the vessels that are given thee
Ezra.english_translation: *Uma'neya* — and the vessels that are given to you for the service of the Holy One, blessed be He, deliver in full before the Holy One, blessed be He, in Jerusalem.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God
Ezra.english_translation: *Ush'ar chashchut* — and the rest of the needs that you will need for the house of the Holy One, blessed be He, to buy, for which you will have to give the money, you shall give from the king’s treasury.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree
Ezra.english_translation: *Umenni anah* — and from me, I, Darius the king, goes out a command and permission to all the treasurers who are beyond the river on the side of the Land of Israel, who receive my taxes from the idolaters, that every thing that Ezra the priest, scribe of the Torah of the Holy One, blessed be He, shall ask of you shall be done quickly, and they shall not delay his request, up to a hundred talents of silver to buy sacrifices and a hundred *kor* of wheat for meal-offerings and up to a hundred measures of wine for libations and a hundred (measures) of oil for the mixing of meal-offerings, and salt for the sacrifices, as it is said (Leviticus 2), “And every meal-offering of thine shalt thou season with salt.”
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Leviticus 2:13 (JPS: “And every meal-offering of thine shalt thou season with salt”). The word “(measures)” and the reference in parentheses are later printed insertions.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: without prescribing how much
Ezra.english_translation: *Di lo ketav* — and salt for which no measure is written, they shall give according to all the need.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol di min ta'am* — whatever is from the permission of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His command, shall be done with zeal, with the king’s seal, for the house of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let it be done exactly
Ezra.english_translation: *Adrazda* — a seal, in the Arabic language.
Ezra.translator_note: The statement is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons
Ezra.english_translation: *Di lemah tehevei* — that why should there be wrath upon the kingdom of the king and his sons; and therefore the treasurers shall give all the needs of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Also we announce to you
Ezra.english_translation: *Ulchon mehodin* — and to you we make known that all the priests and the Levites, the singers and the gatekeepers and the Nethinim, who are hewers of wood and drawers of water for the altar, and who serve in this house of the Holy One, blessed be He, no man shall have power over them to throw upon them tax and poll-money, but they shall be free of the king’s service.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God that is in thy hand
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'ant Ezra kechokhmat Elahakh di bidakh* — and you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hands, more than the judges and the magistrates who judge all the people who are beyond the river on the side of the Land of Israel, with those who know the Torah.
Ezra.translator_note: The words “more than the judges” are translated as printed; the construction of the sentence is not resolved.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: teach you him that knoweth them not
Ezra.english_translation: *Vedi lo yeda* — and the judge who does not know how to judge, you shall make known to him the law, to do it.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God
Ezra.english_translation: *Vekhol di lo hevei avad* — and whoever will not do the law of the Holy One, blessed be He, and the law of the king, quickly shall the judgment and the ruling hold back.
Ezra.translator_note: The verb *ye'akkev* (“hold back / delay”) is translated as printed; its sense here is not resolved.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: let judgment be executed upon him
Ezra.english_translation: *Dinah* — the judgment shall be made from him, from the one who holds back, a ruling.
Ezra.translator_note: Translated literally as printed; the sense is not resolved.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: whether it be unto death
Ezra.english_translation: *Hen lemot* — to kill.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: or to banishment
Ezra.english_translation: *Hen lisharoshi* — whether to uproot him from the world, him and his seed and his family; *lisharoshi*, *desraciner* in the vernacular.
Ezra.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Ezra 7:26 (“condamné à être déraciné”), in forms such as דישרצינייר and דישרציניר; the printed form (דישראצינ"ר) is a variant spelling.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: or to confiscation of goods
Ezra.english_translation: *Hen la'anash nikhsin* — whether to punish him with money.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: or to imprisonment
Ezra.english_translation: *Ule'esurin* — or to chastise him with chastisements. Up to here is the writing of the letter that King Darius gave to Ezra the scribe, so that he would carry it to Jerusalem, to show it to the priests and the Levites and the king’s treasurers, so that they would strengthen themselves to fulfil the commandments and to serve the LORD in the Temple and to keep the Torah as ordained.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ע"כ is read as *ad kan* (“up to here”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers
Ezra.english_translation: *Barukh Adonai* — thus Ezra wrote in his book when he gave thanks to the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and his counsellors
Ezra.english_translation: *Veyo'atsav* — they are the seven who see the king’s face, the seven counsellors above.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the hand of the LORD my God upon me
Ezra.english_translation: *Keyad Adonai Elohai alai* — as the help of the Holy One, blessed be He, was upon me; and I gathered from Israel those who remained in Babylon, heads of fathers’ houses and great men, to go up with me from Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ houses
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'elleh roshei avotam* — of those going up.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehityachasham* — their lineage, by which they were reckoned.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the reign of Artaxerxes the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Artachshasta* — he is Darius.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Of the sons of Shecaniah: of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah
Ezra.english_translation: *Mibnei Shechanyah mibnei Par'osh* — it is one family, and Zechariah is the head of the family.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'immo* — and with his lineage the males of his family were reckoned.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Ebed the son of Jonathan
Ezra.english_translation: *Eved ben Yonatan* — such was his name.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that were the last
Ezra.english_translation: *Acharonim* — who were last to go after Ezra.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to the river that runneth to Ahava
Ezra.english_translation: *El hanahar haba* — to the river that gushes.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to the river that runneth to Ahava
Ezra.english_translation: *El Ahava* — to that river.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: there we encamped three days
Ezra.english_translation: *Venachaneh sham* — and we were encamping there.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: I viewed the people
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'avinah ba'am* — I set my heart to understand about the people who were gathered with me.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: chief men
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'eshlachah le-Eli'ezer* etc. — heads, great ones.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: teachers
Ezra.english_translation: *Mevinim* — they were wise men.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And I gave them commandment unto Iddo the chief
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'atzavveh otam* etc. — I sent them and commanded them to speak to Iddo, who is great and important, who is in Casiphia.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia
Ezra.english_translation: *Al Iddo* — to Iddo.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and I told them what they should say
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'asimah befihem* — I put in their mouths words to speak on my mission to Iddo and his brothers, who are placed and settled in Casiphia, to bring us servants to serve in the Temple.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the place Casiphia
Ezra.english_translation: *BeKhasifya* — a place name in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Iddo [and] his brother
Ezra.english_translation: *El Iddo achiv* — a man’s name.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: ministers for the house of our God
Ezra.english_translation: *Hanetinim* — like *hanetinim*, and therefore it is written with a *vav*.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed comment is brief and its sense is not resolved here; it is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And according to the good hand of our God upon us
Ezra.english_translation: *Keyad Eloheinu* — as the success of the Holy One, blessed be He, was upon us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: a man of discretion
Ezra.english_translation: *Ish sekhel* — wise.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel
Ezra.english_translation: *Mibnei Machli* etc. — all of these were Levites.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and of the Nethinim
Ezra.english_translation: *Umin haNetinim* — and of the slaves, the Nethinim, whom King David and the princes of Israel gave, went up with them.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that we might humble ourselves before our God
Ezra.english_translation: *Lehit'anot* — to sit in fasting.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: a straight way
Ezra.english_translation: *Derekh yesharah* — that the Omnipresent lead me in peace.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki voshti* — for I was ashamed before the king, for I did not wish to ask him for chariots and horsemen to escort us.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed verb *letayyerenu* is rendered “to escort us”; the rendering is not confirmed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: because we had spoken unto the king
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki amarnu* — for we had already said to King Darius that the Holy One, blessed be He, does good to those who seek Him and pours out His anger and His wrath upon those who forsake Him.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: He was entreated of us
Ezra.english_translation: *Vaye'ater lanu* — and He received our prayer, that we came to Jerusalem in peace.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Then I separated twelve of the chiefs of the priests
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'avdilah* — and when I was there by the river Ahava, I set apart some of the chiefs of the priests and weighed out to them the silver and the gold, to put in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: even the offering for the house of our God
Ezra.english_translation: *Heherimu* — which those found in Babylon had offered.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: silver vessels a hundred talents
Ezra.english_translation: *Ukhli khesef me'ah lakkikkarim* — a talent in each vessel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: twenty bowels of gold
Ezra.english_translation: *Ukhfurei* — sprinkling-bowls (*mizrakim*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: of a thousand darics
Ezra.english_translation: *La'adarkonim elef* — a kind of coin; a thousand darics were in these two golden bowls.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: fine bright brass
Ezra.english_translation: *Mutzhav* — of brass made yellow (or) a kind of coin of brass.
Ezra.translator_note: The word “(or)” is a later printed insertion.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: fine bright brass
Ezra.english_translation: *Tovah* — an expression of the feminine; he calls the brass by it.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: two vessels
Ezra.english_translation: *Shenayim* — two vessels.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: precious as gold
Ezra.english_translation: *Chamudot kazahav* — he calls the vessels *chamudot* in the feminine.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And I said unto them
Ezra.english_translation: *Aleihem* — to those chiefs of the priests.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: in the chambers of the house of the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Halishkot bet Adonai* — in order to put in the chambers of the House.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: on the twelfth day of the first month
Ezra.english_translation: *Bishnayim asar lachodesh harishon* — on the twelfth of Nisan.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the hand of our God was upon us
Ezra.english_translation: *Veyad Eloheinu hayetah aleinu* — to make us succeed on the road on which we went.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the whole by number and by weight
Ezra.english_translation: *Bemispar bemishkal lakkol* — the number of the vessels and their weight as they received them: so it was all weighed as they paid it out.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: The children of the captivity, that were come out of exile
Ezra.english_translation: *Habba'im mehashevi benei hagolah* — these who came with Ezra.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: offered burnt-offerings unto the God of Israel
Ezra.english_translation: *Hikrivu olot* — all of it a burnt-offering, and it was a temporary ruling (*hora'at sha'ah*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they delivered the king’s commissions
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayittenu et datei hamelekh* — these returnees of the exile told the commandments of King Darius to the great men of the king, who see his face.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the governors
Ezra.english_translation: *Ufachavot* — like *ufachot*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: beyond the River
Ezra.english_translation: *Avar hanahar* — those on the side of the Land of Israel are beyond the river relative to the dwellers of Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: they furthered the people and the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Venissu* — for they were lifting up and helping.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Now when these things were done
Ezra.english_translation: *Elleh* — these words, which the king’s commandments told.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the princes drew near unto me
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehasarim* — of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: saying
Ezra.english_translation: *Lemor* — and so they said to me.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: the hand of the princes and rulers hath been first in this faithlessness
Ezra.english_translation: *Hayetah bema'al hazeh rishonah* — for they were the first to commit a trespass, to intermarry with the nations of the lands.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: sat down appalled
Ezra.english_translation: *Meshomem* — wretched and desolate, like “seven days desolate among them” (Ezekiel 3).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Ezekiel 3:15 (JPS: “I remained there appalled among them seven days”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: I arose up from my fasting
Ezra.english_translation: *Mita'anit* — for I had not eaten that day.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands
Ezra.english_translation: *Nittenu* — like *nittannu*, the *nun* is doubled in place of the lack of another *nun*, like “for upon Thee we have leaned (*nish'annu*)” (II Chronicles 14), like *nish'annu*; “and we will give (*venatnu*) our daughters” (Genesis 34), like *venatannu*.
Ezra.translator_note: The quotations are II Chronicles 14:10 (JPS: “for we rely on Thee”) and Genesis 34:16 (JPS: “then will we give our daughters unto you”). The Hebrew forms are given as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: as it is this day
Ezra.english_translation: *Kehayom hazeh* — as is seen on this day, that the ten tribes had already gone into exile, and still many of the exiles remained in Babylon.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And now for a little moment
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'attah kimat rega* — for the hour.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: grace hath been shown
Ezra.english_translation: *Techinnah* — like *chaninah*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to give us a nail in His holy place
Ezra.english_translation: *Velatet lanu yated* — to fix us in the Land of Israel.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to give us a nail in His holy place
Ezra.english_translation: *Yated* — like (Isaiah 22) “and I will fasten him as a peg (*yated*) in a sure place.”
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 22:23 (JPS: “And I will fasten him as a peg in a sure place”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: a little reviving in our bondage
Ezra.english_translation: *Michyah me'at* — a little life.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: For we are bondmen
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki avadim anachnu* — to Darius king of Persia.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage
Ezra.english_translation: *Lo azavanu* — He did not forsake us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: hath extended mercy unto us
Ezra.english_translation: *Vayet* — an expression of the causative, like *mateh hitteh aleinu chasdo*.
Ezra.translator_note: No reference is printed for the second expression; it is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: a fence in Judah and in Jerusalem
Ezra.english_translation: *Gader* — for they were building a fence to keep His commandments.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: an unclean land
Ezra.english_translation: *Niddah* — unclean and loathsome.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehorashtem* — the land to your children for ever.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds
Ezra.english_translation: *Ve'acharei kol haba aleinu* — after all the evil deed that has reached us in our evil deeds.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve
Ezra.english_translation: *Chasakhta* — below our iniquities; You held back from our iniquities, down to below, so that our iniquity was lessened by the atonement of our exile; and we should explain it in this sense: You held Yourself back from collecting from us all our iniquities, and collected from us less than the iniquities, and did not repay us according to all our sin.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: shall we again break Thy commandments
Ezra.english_translation: *Hanashuv* — if we return.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: wouldest not Thou be angry with us
Ezra.english_translation: *Halo te'enaf banu* — a rhetorical question that is affirmed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for none can stand before Thee because of this
Ezra.english_translation: *Ki ein* — the power of good deeds is in us to stand and endure before You on account of this transgression.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: weeping and casting himself down before the house of God
Ezra.english_translation: *Bokhah* — like *bechi*.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land
Ezra.english_translation: *Venoshev* — and we caused them to dwell.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing
Ezra.english_translation: *Yesh mikveh* — there is hope for Israel concerning this, that they can send out their idolatrous wives and those born of them, and send out all the children born of the idolatrous women.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: according to the counsel of the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Be'atzat Adonai* — by the counsel and will of the Holy One, blessed be He.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God
Ezra.english_translation: *Vacharedim bemitzvat Eloheinu* — and God-fearing people shall send them out.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and let it be done according to the law
Ezra.english_translation: *Vechatorah ya'aseh* — the one who does this deed, who sends out his wife and children who are idolaters.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and we are with thee
Ezra.english_translation: *Va'anachnu immakh* — to agree with you.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they made proclamation
Ezra.english_translation: *Kol* — a herald’s call.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: within three days
Ezra.english_translation: *Lishloshet hayamim* — at the end of the three days.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: it was the ninth month
Ezra.english_translation: *Chodesh hatishi'i* — it is the month of Kislev.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: trembling because of this matter
Ezra.english_translation: *Mar'idim al hadavar* — afraid about the matter, and they were afraid of the stumbling-block of this transgression.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and for the great rain
Ezra.english_translation: *Umehagheshamim* — and from the rains that were falling upon them there they were trembling and wretched.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: make confession unto the LORD
Ezra.english_translation: *Todah* — confession.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: it is a time of much rain
Ezra.english_translation: *Veha'et geshamim* — for the rains were falling upon us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: neither is this a work of one day or two
Ezra.english_translation: *Vehamelakhah* — and the removal of this transgression you cannot remedy so quickly.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: Let now our princes of all the congregation stand
Ezra.english_translation: *Lekhol hakahal* — with all the congregation.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: that have married foreign women
Ezra.english_translation: *Hehoshiv* — who had settled.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: until the fierce wrath of our God be turned from us
Ezra.english_translation: *Ad lehashiv* — until the anger of the Holy One, blessed be He, turns away from us.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: stood up against this matter
Ezra.english_translation: *Amdu al zot* — to provoke concerning this matter.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: helped them
Ezra.english_translation: *Azaruhem* — they strengthened their hands.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: to examine the matter
Ezra.english_translation: *Ledaryush* — like *lidrosh*.
Ezra.translator_note: The printed lemma is spelled *ledaryush* (with a *yod*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they were finished with all the men that had married foreign women
Ezra.english_translation: *Vaykhallu bekhol* — and they completed the repair of the matter concerning the men who had settled wives of idolaters, for he sent them out.
Ezra.translator_note: The Hebrew does not state who “he” is; it is translated as printed.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: by the first day of the first month
Ezra.english_translation: *Lachodesh harishon* — until the first of Nisan.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And they gave their hand
Ezra.english_translation: *Yadam* — their counsel, like “Is the hand of Joab with thee in all this?” (II Samuel 14).
Ezra.translator_note: The quotation is II Samuel 14:19 (JPS: “Is the hand of Joab with thee in all this?”).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: for their guilt
Ezra.english_translation: *Al ashmatam* — it was a temporary ruling (*hora'at sha'ah*).

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: And of the sons of Immer
Ezra.english_translation: *Umibnei Immer* — all these are priests, until “and of the Levites,” etc.
Ezra.translator_note: The words “and of the Levites” are Ezra 10:23.

Ezra.english_lemma_JPS: and some of them had wives by whom they had children
Ezra.english_translation: *Veyesh mehem nashim vayashimu banim* — some of them had wives of idolaters from whom children were born to them, and all of them sent out the wives and the children.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Divrei Nechemyah* etc. — from here on Nehemiah wrote this book.

*Shnat esrim* — it is the twentieth year of King Darius, who is Artaxerxes. And in tractate Rosh Hashanah we found “twentieth year, twentieth year” by verbal analogy (*gezerah shavah*) from the verse, as it is said below, “And it came to pass in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes,” etc. And from the month of Tishri they used to count for the reckoning of the years, and therefore it is said here, “And it came to pass in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year,” etc., and it is the Kislev which comes after Tishri; and below it is said, “And it came to pass in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year,” etc.; it is the Nisan of that year. And I cannot resolve and say that they counted from Nisan for the reckoning of their years, and that deed written below, which says “And it came to pass in the month of Nisan,” etc., was before this deed, which says “And it came to pass in the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year,” etc., and that there is no earlier and later in them; this I cannot resolve and say. And the passages prove that even that deed of the second passage was only on account of this deed of this first passage.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The last sentences are compressed and are translated as printed; the Talmud reference (Rosh Hashanah) was not checked. The verse quoted “below” is Nehemiah 2:1 (JPS: “in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Achad me'achai* — one of my companions.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'esh'alem al haYehudim* etc. — I asked them about the matter of the remnant of the Jews who remained in Jerusalem from the captivity of Babylon.
*Haplitah* — because they were saved from the exile of Babylon.
*Ve'al Yerushalayim* — and about the matter of the city I asked them.
*Vayomru li* — they answered me about the first first and the last last: first about the matter of the Jews, and afterwards about the matter of the walls and the gates.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hanish'arim* etc. — those Jews who remained there in the province of Jerusalem are placed in great evil and in reproach, because the idolaters plunder and despoil them.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vechomat Yerushalayim mefuratzet* — and the wall of the city, behold, it is breached, and the gates are burned with fire as before, for Israel did not build the walls of the city and its gates, but only the building of the Temple [ב"ה] alone.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The abbreviation ב"ה is read as “the Temple” from the context (the printed form is kept in brackets); the expansion is not confirmed by a permitted source, so the comment is flagged.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Nitztu* — like *nutzetu* (ס"א *nitztu* like *nittetzu*).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The abbreviation ס"א in the parenthesis is left as printed (it may mean “another version”; this is not confirmed); the parenthesis is a later printed insertion.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Yamim* — some days.
*Anna* — an expression of request and supplication.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: let Thine ear now be attentive
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Kashevet* — like *kushevet*, etc.; as one says from *ahav* *ohev*, so one says from *kashav* *koshev* and *koshevet*.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: We have dealt very corruptly against Thee
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Chavol* — a noun, an expression of destruction; and the *chet* is vocalized with *chataf patach*, and I cannot explain it as a passive form (*pa'ul*), for then he should have vocalized the *chet* with a great *kamets*.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: We have dealt very corruptly against Thee
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Chavalnu* — an expression of destruction, like (in Daniel 6) “you did no hurt (*chavula*)”; and so Menachem connected it.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Daniel 6:23 (JPS: “and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: though your dispersed were in the uttermost part of the heaven
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Im yihyeh nidachakhem* — like what is said, “If any of thine that are dispersed,” etc. (Deuteronomy 30).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Deuteronomy 30:4 (JPS: “If any of thine that are dispersed be in the uttermost parts of heaven”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: O Lord, I beseech Thee, let now Thine ear be attentive
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Anna Adonai tehi na oznekha kashevet* — in the beginning of his prayer he said this expression of supplication, and likewise after his prayer.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: prosper, I pray Thee, Thy servant this day
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Le'avdekha hayom* etc. — thus he prayed for himself.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: in the sight of this man
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lifnei ha'ish hazeh* — before the king.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Now I was cupbearer to the king
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Mashkeh* — like (Genesis 40) “cupbearer to the king of Egypt”; and this is what I explained above (Ezra 2), according to our Rabbis, that Tirshatha is Nehemiah.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Genesis 40:1 (JPS: “the butler of the king of Egypt”); the printed wording differs slightly.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king
Nehemiah.english_translation: *LeArtachshasta* — he is Darius, and he is called so after the kingdom.
*Yayin lefanav* — they brought wine before the king in the court.

*Va'essa et hayayin* — and I carried the cup of wine and gave it to the king; and such is the custom, that the one who brings wine in the king’s court does not carry and give it to the king, but the chief of the cupbearers receives the cup of wine from the hand of the one who brings it, and he carries it and gives it to the king.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lo hayiti ra lefanav* — and I was not accustomed to be bad before him with an evil face, but rather glad and good-hearted; and now I was sullen with an evil face.
*Ve'attah einkha choleh* — and behold, you are not sick.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: this is nothing else but sorrow of heart
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ein zeh* — this deed is nothing but evil of the heart that is in your heart against me, to kill me with deadly poison by the drinking of this cup.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Then I was very sore afraid
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'ira harbeh me'od* — and I was very afraid of this, lest the king frame a charge against me.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: why should not my countenance be sad
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Madua lo yera'u fanai* — why should my face not be bad?

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lieth waste
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ir beit kivrot avotai* — Jerusalem, which is the burial place of my fathers, is in ruins.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: For what dost thou make request
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Al mah zeh attah mevakkesh* — what thing do you request of me, that I may do it for you?

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: So I prayed to the God of heaven
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'etpallel* — and I said before the king in my prayer: So may it be the will before the God of heaven, that You fulfil my petition and my request.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that thou wouldest send me unto Judah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Asher tishlachheni* — that you give me permission to go up to Jerusalem and build it.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the queen also sitting by him
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayomer li hamelekh* — at the time the king spoke to me, his wife the queen was sitting beside him.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the queen also sitting by him
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehashegal* — his wife the queen, as is said (Daniel 5), “his consorts and his concubines,” for Scripture is accustomed to write the queen beside the concubine, “his wives and his concubines,” like “queens and concubines” (Song /of Songs/ 6).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotations are Daniel 5:2 (JPS: “his consorts and his concubines”) and Song of Songs 6:8 (JPS: “threescore queens, And fourscore concubines”); no source is printed for “his wives and his concubines.” The word “/of Songs/” is a printed insertion.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: For how long shall thy journey be
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ad mati yihyeh mehalakhekha* — when do you wish your going and your journey to be?
*Umatai tashuv* — and when is your mind to return?

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: So it pleased the king to send me
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Yishlacheni* — he gave me permission to go.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and I set him a time
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'ettenah lo zeman* — I gave him a time to return.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Igrot yittenu li* — your scribes, on your authority and knowledge, sealed with your seal, to the governors of beyond the river on the side of the Land of Israel.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that they may let me pass through
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Asher ya'aviruni* — and they shall escort me in peace.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed verb for “escort” (*vayyatiyruni* / *yatiyruni*) is rendered “escort”; the rendering is not confirmed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ad asher avo* — to Jerusalem, which is in the province of Judah.
*Ve'igeret el Asaf* — and you shall send a writing, a letter, to Asaph.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the keeper of the king’s park
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Shomer happardes* — he was appointed over the forests that belonged to the king.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the castle which appertaineth to the house
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Likrot* — a strong form: to make roofing and beams for the gates of the castles of the Temple Mount, for ב"ה they built in its building, but the gates of the walls of the Temple Mount and the wall of the court that surrounds ב"ה they had not yet built.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ב"ה is left as printed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and for the wall of the city
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ulchomat ha'ir* — and to make beams for the wall of the city.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and for the house that I shall enter into
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ulvayit asher avo elav* — and to make a house in which I may dwell for my needs.
*Vayitten li hamelekh* — all that I asked of him.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: according to the good hand of my God upon me
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Keyad* — according to the hand of the Holy One, blessed be He, which was good upon me, to make me succeed.
*Va'ettenah lahem et igrot hamelekh* — so that they would escort me in peace.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed verb for “escort” (*vayyatiyruni* / *yatiyruni*) is rendered “escort”; the rendering is not confirmed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: captains of the army and horsemen
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Sarei chayil ufarashim* — the king sent with me for my honour, that I might go in peace.
*Vayishma Sanvalat* etc. — when they heard that I had come to seek good for Israel and to build the walls of Jerusalem, it was evil in their eyes, for they were adversaries of Judah and Benjamin.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'ehi sham yamim shloshah* — I was in Jerusalem three days, and at the end of three days I arose at night, I and a few men with me, and I told no man what the Holy One, blessed be He, put into my heart.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: neither was there any beast with me
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Uvehemah ein immi* — for all the few men who were with me went on their feet, but I alone was riding on a beast, since they did not wish to ride on their horses, so that they would go out of the city quietly without anyone’s knowledge; and they went to break and to throw down the walls of the city at night and to increase its breaches, so that the people of the city the next day would be eager and would agree in one counsel with Nehemiah to build the walls of the city; and so the account within the passage proves.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And I went out by night by the valley gate
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'etze'ah besha'ar hagay* — I went out by that gate at night with the men who were with me toward that place of the Dragon’s Spring and to that Dung Gate in the walls of the city; and I was breaking into the wall, and the wall was easy to throw down and to breach because it had been burned with fire.
*Asher hem peruzim* — those places that were breached, and they breached them more.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Then I went on to the fountain gate
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'e'evor el sha'ar ha'ayin* — and I wished to pass to those places in the wall of the city and through those breaches, and there was no room in those breaches to pass between them riding on the beasts, for they were small breaches.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Then went I up in the night in the valley
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'ehi oleh* — and I was going up from one side at night, and I was breaking down the wall with the men who were with me.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'ashuv va'avo* — and when I returned I came by way of the Valley Gate.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And the rulers knew not whither I went
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehasegannim* — who were in the city did not know where I went and the deed that I did.
*Ad ken* — until now.
*Va'omar aleihem* — on the next day I said to them.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that we be no more a reproach
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Velo nihyeh od cherpah* — that our adversaries should no longer plunder and despoil us.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the hand of my God which was good upon me
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Et yad Elohai* — who gave me grace and success before the king.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: So they strengthened their hands for the good work
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Latovah* — all were prepared for the good, to build the wall of the city and its towers.
*Vayal'igu* — when the adversaries heard the report of the building of the wall of the city, they were mocking us.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: will you rebel against the king
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ha'al hamelekh* — whether you are rebelling against the king, to build the wall of the city in order to rebel against him.
*Velakhem ein chelek* — what have you to do with the building of this wall of the city, for you have no portion in it.
*Sha'ar hatzon* — such was the name of the gate.
*Hemmah kiddeshuhu* — that gate, with the holiness of the city.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and set up the doors of it
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Daltotav* — of the gate.
*Ve'ad migdal hame'ah* — such was the name of the tower.
*Ve'al yado* — beside him, adjacent to him, of each and every builder who built in the building of the Sheep Gate.

*Banu anshei Yericho* — for such was their custom: these used to build here in the wall of the city until the completion of the building that was imposed upon them, and the others used to build adjacent to the first building; and so was their custom, one after another, until the whole wall was built.

*Ve'al* — like (Numbers 2) “and next unto him (*va'alav*) the tribe of Manasseh,” adjacent; and so its explanation: adjacent to the building of his hand; and Scripture was not exact in its language, for sometimes it says *al yado* and sometimes *alav*; and “after him repaired.”
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Numbers 2:20 (JPS: “and next unto him shall be the tribe of Manasseh”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve'et sha'ar haddagim* — such is the name of the gate.
*Hemmah keruhu* — they placed the beams and the ceiling on the gate.

*Keruhu* — a strong form, as from *karah*, like “who layeth the beams of His upper chambers in the waters” (Psalms 104); and the *kof* of *keruhu* is not customarily vocalized with a *chirik* in this matter because of the *resh* after it, as in *berekh* (there, 10), *cheref osehu* (Proverbs 17), *uverakhtiha vehayetah lagoyim* (Genesis 17), and *vaazeritim ba'aratzot* (Ezekiel 29).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotations are Psalms 104:3 (JPS: “Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters”), Psalms 10:3 (JPS: “the covetous vaunteth himself”), Proverbs 17:5 (JPS: “Whoso mocketh the poor blasphemeth his Maker”), Genesis 17:16 (JPS: “I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations”) and Ezekiel 29:12 (JPS: “I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations”). References in parentheses are later printed insertions; the printed “Genesis 17” and “Ezekiel 29” have no verse numbers. The grammatical claims are translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Man'ulav* — its bolts (*misgarav*), *sesverroz* in the vernacular.
Nehemiah.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Nehemiah 3:3 (“ses serrures”; Darmesteter reads *ses verrous*), in forms such as שישוירונץ and שושבירלוץ; the printed form (ששוירל"ץ) is close to them and is a variant spelling.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hechezik* — to build the building.
*HaTeko'im* — thus they were called after their place, which was Tekoa.
*Addireihem* — the rich men of Tekoa.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: put not their necks to the work of their lord
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lo hevi'u tzavaram* — they did not help in the service of the Holy One, blessed be He, to build the wall of the city.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And the gate of the old city
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve'et sha'ar hayeshanah* — such was its name.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: appertained to the throne of the governor beyond the River
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lekhisse pachat avar hanahar* — he built one seat for that governor of beyond the river to sit in.
*Tzorefim* — that family was called after their craft.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and they restored Jerusalem even unto the broad wall
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vaya'azvu Yerushalayim* — they filled it with earth up to the Broad Wall to strengthen it.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Sar chatzi felekh Yerushalayim* — he was a ruler over half the people in Jerusalem; *pelekh* is an expression of dukedom and kingdom.
*Veneged beito* — his lot fell to build, for his house was adjacent to that place of the wall of the city.

*Middah sheniyah* — like that measure which his fellow above built, he too built like him, a second measure in the building of the wall. It does not fit to say *middah* as an expression for the building of the gates, because they have only the building of a portion of a wall; for we do not find, in the whole passage, *middah* as an expression for the building of the gates.
*Ve'et migdal hatannurim* — he too built that tower, whose name is so; all these towers in the passage were built in the wall of the city all around.
*Hu uvenotav* — Shallum and his daughters strengthened themselves to build the building.
*Ad sha'ar hashefot* — and the Dung Gate was not included.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the ruler of the district of Mizpah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Sar felekh haMitzpah* — ruler and duke of Mizpah.
*Hu yivennenu* — he was building that gate.
*Veyetallelenu* — and he was roofing it; an expression of *metalleta*.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The Aramaic word is left as printed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve'et chomat bereikhat haShelach* — which inclines toward the king’s garden.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: even unto the stairs that go down from the city of David
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve'ad hama'alot* — they knew these places.
*Beit Tzur* — a place name.

*Lefalko* — from that rulership, half the district, he built this building for his district; a *kaf* with *dagesh*: as one says from *melekh* *malko*, from *eved* *avdo*, so one says from *pelekh* *pilko*; for the last letter of a noun among the letters *bet gimel dalet kaf pe tav* is given a *dagesh*.
*Acheihem* — the Levites.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: over against the ascent to the armoury at the Turning
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Minneged alot hanesheq* — opposite that place where the mighty men used to go up to the armoury. According to the plain sense of the verse, it appears that there was a place adjacent to the wall, and the weapons of the mighty men were placed (ס"א *netunim*) there, as is said, “fortified cities and the armour.”
Nehemiah.translator_note: The abbreviation ס"א in the parenthesis is left as printed (it may mean “another version”; this is not confirmed); the parenthesis is a later printed insertion and gives the variant *netunim*, “given”. The quotation has no reference printed; the words occur at II Kings 10:2 (JPS: “fortified cities also, and armour”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hamiktzo'a* — to the corner of the wall.
*Hecheraah* — its explanation is according to its context, and it is a doubling of language for strength.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: from the door of the house of Eliashib
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Mipetach beit Elyashiv ve'ad tachlit* etc. — opposite that house he built his building.
*Neged beitam* — for it was there adjacent to the wall.
*Vehamigdal hayotze* — there was a tower in the wall that goes out and juts out from the inside.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Now the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehanetinim hayu yoshvim ba'Ofel* — and the Nethinim were dwelling in that region and were building that region of theirs, which was adjacent to the wall, up to opposite the Water Gate on the east side.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: every one over against his own house
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ish lenegged beito* — each one was building opposite his house.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vechanun ben Tzalaf hashishi* — Zalaph had many sons, and Hanun was the sixth.
*Middah sheni* — like *sheniyah*.
*Nishkato* — like *lishkato*; he had one chamber there adjacent to the wall.
*Ben hatzorefi* — a man of the goldsmith, and he was called after his craft.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: between the upper chamber of the corner and the sheep gate
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Uvein aliyat hapinnah leSha'ar hatzon* — at the beginning of the building they began to build the Sheep Gate, as is said, “and they built the Sheep Gate,” etc.; thus they were building the wall all around, one after another.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Nehemiah 3:1 (JPS: “and they builded the sheep gate”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: before his brethren and the army of Samaria
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lifnei achiv vechayil Shomron* — before his companions and the army of Samaria, who were adversaries of Judah.
*Mah haYehudim* — why are the Jews doing so?
*Ha'umlalim* — a matter of weakness and slackness.
*Hay'azvu lahem* — do they think that the idolaters will leave them and let them build?
Nehemiah.translator_note: Printed as *ha'ovedei kokhavim*.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hayizbachu* — whether they will sacrifice their sacrifices continually, as they think.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: will they make an end this day
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hayekhallu bayom* — whether they will finish and complete their work which they began in one day; that is to say, the idolaters will not let them complete their building.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed *ha'ovedei kokhavim* is rendered “idolaters.”

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hayechayu* — whether they will revive and repair and restore the stones to their former state, to be hard and strong again out of the dust.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: out of the heaps of rubbish
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Me'aremot* — a matter of heaps and mounds.

*Vehemmah serufot* — and the stones were burned and became dust; thus they were mocking and jeering at the building of the wall, which they were building from burned stones that had fallen to the ground from the fire when Jerusalem was burned.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him
Nehemiah.english_translation: *VeToviyah ha'Amoni etzlo* — Tobiah was with Sanballat.
*Vayomer* — and thus he was saying and mocking.
*Gam asher hem bonim* — even this building which they are building.
*Im ya'aleh shu'al* — on the building, to breach the wall of the city; what can be said about it — that the building has no repair, and whoever wishes may come and breach it.
*Shema Eloheinu* — when I heard their mockery of us, I prayed this prayer.
*Be'eretz shiyah* — that they be exiled from upon their land as we were exiled.
*Ve'al tekhas* — like *ve'al tekhasseh*, like “and reveal not the secret of another” (Proverbs 21), like *al tegalleh*.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Proverbs 25:9, not Proverbs 21 as printed (JPS: “but reveal not the secret of another”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: for they have vexed Thee before the builders
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki hich'isu* — who provoked in front of the builders, to mock them.
*Vattikkasher* — when the wall was joined together and built up to its half, then the heart of the people was eager and drawn to do the building of the wall.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki alatah arukhah* — that the wall was built.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Arukhah* — a matter of bandage and healing.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the breaches began to be stopped
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki hechellu haperutzim lehissatem* — that the people of the city, who had been breached until now for lack of a wall, began to be stopped up by the building of the wall.
*Ula'asot lo to'ah* — to cause the building of the wall spoiling and ruin; *to'ah* is like “and to utter wickedness (*to'ah*) against the LORD” (Isaiah 32).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 32:6 (JPS: “and to utter wickedness against the LORD”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Aleihem* — over the builders.
*Mipneihem* — because of the enemies.
*Vayomer Yehudah* — thus the men of Judah were saying and complaining.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Kashal ko'ach hasabbal* — the bearers and those loading the stones and the wood for the building of the wall had stumbled in their strength; they had no strength to build because of the enemies.

*Ve'afar harbeh* — there is still much mortar and clay to put into the building of the wall; that is to say, the work is still great for us to build, and we cannot build the wall because of fear of the enemies.
*Vayomru tzareinu* — thus Nehemiah was relating on and on.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: They shall not know, neither see
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lo yed'u velo yir'u* — thus our adversaries were saying about us: Israel will not know and will not recognize us until we come suddenly into their midst and kill them, and in this way we shall make the building cease and stop.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: when the Jews that dwelt by them came
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayehi ka'asher ba'u haYehudim* — and now the adversaries gathered, who had combined together to come to fight us, with the Jews who were among them in their lands; and those Jews who joined with them came before the army in the manner of men of war to speak to us; and in this matter the Jews outwitted the enemies; and it came to pass when the Jews who dwelt near them came, etc.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: they said unto us ten times
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayomru lanu eser pe'amim* — those Jews warned us up to ten times to fight our enemies, for they were coming to war, and thus they said to us, “from all the places,” etc.: from all those places where you are scattered there at the building of the wall, here and there, be careful to be gathered together, until you return upon us together to fight us.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The last clause (“until you return upon us together to fight us”) is translated as printed; the Hebrew construction is not resolved here.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Therefore set I in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'a'amid mitachtiyot* — of the wall: when I heard their words I stationed the lowest places of that place around Jerusalem behind the wall of the city.
*Batzechichim* — for families from the people, from the mighty ones among them, with their weapons, to fight our enemies when they come.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: I even set the people after their families
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'a'amid mitachtiyot* etc. — “and I set the people,” etc. This verse is like “and the water which thou takest out of the river … shall become blood upon the dry land” (Exodus 4), “for, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, Thine enemies shall perish” (Psalms 92), “Awake, awake, Deborah; awake, awake, utter a song” (Judges 5), “Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us” (Psalms 115).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotations are Exodus 4:9, Psalms 92:10 (JPS: “For, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, For, lo, Thine enemies shall perish”), Judges 5:12 (JPS: “Awake, awake, Deborah; Awake, awake, utter a song”) and Psalms 115:1 (JPS: “Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And I looked, and rose up
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va'er'eh va'akum* — and when I saw the enemies coming, I arose to speak to the nobles and the rulers, to urge them to fight our enemies.
*Al achekhem* — on account of your brethren.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that it was known unto us
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki noda lanu* — the matter that they had come to fight us.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: we returned all of us to the wall
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va-nashuv kullanu* — we all returned from the place where we had gathered together to meet the enemies, each and every one to his work on the building of the wall.

*Vayehi min hayom hahu* — and from that day onward half of the mighty men did the building of the wall, and the other half of the mighty men were armed with their weapons to guard their brethren who were doing the work.
*Veharmachim* — an extra *vav*, like the *vav* of *ve'Ayah va'Anah* (Genesis 36).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Genesis 36:24 (JPS: “Aiah and Anah”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the rulers were behind all the house of Judah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehasarim* — they were joined behind all the tribe of Judah, to be careful in war.
*Habbonim bachomah* etc. — those who were building and those who were loading and carrying the burdens did their work with one hand, and with one hand carried weapons.
*Hashelach* — a weapon of battle, like “from perishing by the sword (*bashelach*)” (Job 33); and so Menachem connected it.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Job 33:18 (JPS: “And his life from perishing by the sword”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehabbonim* — how were they building? All of them were girded, each man with his sword on his loins, and building.
*Etzli* — he was constantly beside me.
*Harbeh* — it is great.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: our God will fight for us
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Yilachem lanu* — He will fight on our behalf.
*Ish ve-na'aro* — each and every one of the builders, and one young man with him.
*Yalinu betokh Yerushalayim* — and the night was for them a guard, and by day they did work; it turns out that they did not sleep at all.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: none of us put off our clothes
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ein anachnu poshetim bigdenu* — we were always alert at the guard.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: every one that went to the water had his weapon
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ish shilcho hamayim* — it refers back to the “none (*ein*)” above, like (Samuel I 2) “Let arrogancy come out of your mouth” (*yetzei atak mipikhem*): none of us puts off his clothes to lie down or to wash them in water; and it is a doubling of language on “we do not put off.”
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is I Samuel 2:3 (JPS: “Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth”); the printed quotation lacks the negative, and how it bears on the lemma is not clear to me, so the sentence is translated literally.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Shilcho* — put off (*hafshet*), like “and he shall put off (*ufashat*) his garments” (Leviticus 6), which the Targum renders *ve-shalach*.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Leviticus 6:4 (JPS: “And he shall put off his garments”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: a great cry of the people
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vatehi tza'akat ha'am ve-neshehem gedolah* — the poor of the people were crying out greatly.
*El acheihem hayehudim* — because of their brethren the Jews, the rich.

*Veyesh asher omerim* — he gives the reason for his words, why they were crying out: there were some of the poor of the people who said, “We, with our sons and our daughters, are many; let us get corn,” and now we have to sell our sons and our daughters to take corn from them, “that we may eat and live.” So they were crying out against the rich Jews, who did not wish to provide for them.

*Veyesh asher omerim sadotenu vegomer* — and there were some of the poor who complained and said: fields and vineyards and houses we have given to others as a pledge and security, to take corn for our food.
*Bara'av* — “in the famine,” since the rich do not forgo any of their possessions for our sustenance.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The lemma is printed ברעב (“in the famine”); JPS renders the verse’s word as “because of the earth,” which is the lemma shown here.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Veyesh asher omerim lavinu kesef* — and there were some of them who said: we have already borrowed money from others upon our fields and our vineyards to pay the king’s tax, and from now on we have nothing at all for our sustenance.
*Lemiddat hamelekh* — for the king’s tax, like “tribute, impost, and toll” (*mindah, belo vahalakh*) (Ezra 4).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed reference “Ezra 4” is incomplete; the words occur at Ezra 4:13 (JPS: “tribute, impost, or toll”) and Ezra 4:20 (JPS: “tribute, impost, and toll”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-atah kivsar acheinu besareinu* — and now we are esteemed and of good lineage like our brethren, who are rich.
*Kivneihem baneinu* — as their children, who are esteemed and of good lineage, so likewise our children are of good lineage.
*Vehineh anachnu kovshim* — and now we have to be subjugating and giving our sons and our daughters to others for the sake of our sustenance.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: some of our daughters are brought into bondage already
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Veyesh mibbenoteinu nikbashot* — and already some of our daughters are subjugated to others as slaves.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: neither is it in our power to help it
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-ein le'el yadenu* — and we have no power in our hand to redeem them.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: for other men have our fields and our vineyards
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vesadoteinu vekharmeinu la-acherim* — even fields and vineyards we have handed over to others for our sustenance; and what shall we eat from now on, for we have nothing with which to sustain ourselves?
*Vayyimmalekh* — my heart took counsel within myself.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: contended with the nobles and the rulers
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va-arivah* — I rebuked the nobles and the rulers, who are the rich.

*Massa ish be-achiv atem noshim* — you are creditors; why do you act so? It was incumbent upon you to provide for these poor, and you lend them money in order to subjugate their sons and their daughters and their fields and their vineyards and their houses.
*Va-eten aleihem kehillah gedolah* — I gathered and assembled a great congregation against them, to cry out against them in order to shame them.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va-omerah lahem* — and so I said to them: we have already bought our brethren the Jews who were in captivity out of the hand of the idolaters, to whom they were being sold.
*Kedei vanu* — with that sufficiency (*dai*) of money that was in our hand.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: and would you nevertheless sell your brethren
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vegam atem* — and would even you sell to the idolaters your brethren who are subjugated under your hands as slaves?

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: should they sell themselves unto us
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Venimkeru lanu* — and the matter will come to this, that they will be sold to us out of the hand of the idolaters (if so, why would you sell them, since we are compelled to redeem them; so it is in ס"א).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The parenthesis is a later printed insertion, and the abbreviation ס"א is left as printed because I could not confirm its meaning.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayacharishu* — they were silent and were ashamed, and did not know what to answer.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: The thing that you do is not good
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lo tov hadavar* — the thing is evil before the Holy One, blessed be He.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: the reproach of the heathen our enemies
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Mecherpat* — because of the reproaches of the idolaters, who are our enemies.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And I likewise, my brethren and my servants
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vegam ani achai ve-na'arai* — I too and my companions are creditors over them for money, and we will leave off and forgive them all these loans.
*Noshim* — like “and the creditor (*vehannosheh*) is come to take” (Kings II 4:1).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is II Kings 4:1 (JPS: “and the creditor is come to take unto him my two children”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Restore, I pray you, to them
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Hashivu na* — and you, too, do as I do, to forgive them all their debts.
*Umeat hakesef* — and the bulk (*rov*) of the money that they owe you, with the corn and the new wine (*tirosh*), etc.
Nehemiah.translator_note: Rashi’s printed wording is “the bulk of the money”; JPS renders the verse’s phrase “the hundred pieces of silver.”

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayomeru nashiv* — and they said that they would restore and forgive everything.
*La'asot kadavar hazeh* — that they, too, would forgive.
*Gam chotzni naratti* — I, too, shook out my garment, my lap (*chotzni*), as in “and they shall bring your sons in the bosom (*bechotzen*)” (Isaiah 49).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Isaiah 49:22 (JPS: “And they shall bring thy sons in their bosom”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Naratti* — *eskwoler* in the vernacular, like “Shake thyself (*hitna'ari*) from the dust” (ibid.).
Nehemiah.translator_note: Old French. Darmesteter lists this word at Nehemiah 5:13 (“j’ai secoué”), in forms such as אשקרוליי, אשקרולי, אישקרולי and אשקושלייר; the printed form (אישקוליי"ר) is a variant spelling. The quotation is Isaiah 52:2 (JPS: “Shake thyself from the dust”), and “ibid.” points back to Isaiah, which the printed text does not name.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: So God shake out every man from his house
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Kakhah yena'er* — so may the Holy One, blessed be He, shake out from the world and from their possessions all those who will not forgive their debts.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: even thus be he shaken out, and emptied
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Na'ur va-rek* — without possessions.
*Asher tzivvah oti* — the king.
*Pecham* — like *pechah*, a ruler (*shalitan*), like *rokem*, which is like *rakah*.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The lemma is printed פחם, where the verse reads פחתם. The comparison with *rokem* and *rakah* is translated literally and its sense is not clear to me.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Mishnat esrim* — for King Darius, for then he went up from Babylon, as it is said (above, 2) “And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year,” etc.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The reference is Nehemiah 2:1 (JPS: “in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king”). Rashi’s printed text names Darius, where the verse names Artaxerxes; translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Shenim shtem esreh* — that is, twelve years.
*Ani ve-achai* — I and my companions who came with me.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: have not eaten the bread of the governor
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lechem hapechah lo achalti* — bread that is fit for the food of the governor, which the people give to the governor out of the tax.
*Hikhbidu al ha'am* — they laid the burden of tax upon the people.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: took of them for bread and wine
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayikchu* — and they took from them, on account of the tax, bread and wine, after the giving of forty shekels of silver; and so they were accustomed to do every year.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: their servants lorded over the people
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Gam na'areihem* — those of the governors.
*Hachomah* — the wall of the city.
*He'echezakti* — I busied myself to occupy myself in it continually.

*Ushadeh lo kanino* — in the fields of the Jews who were building the wall we did not buy, I and the members of my company, taking advantage of their pressing occupation in the building of the wall; but I would give them money in order to build the building.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The phrase *al esek dochkam* is translated literally and its sense is not certain.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Al hamelachah* — to build continually.
*Me'ah vachamishim ish* — they ate at my table, besides the proselytes who came to us from the idolaters, for they too ate at my table.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: that which was prepared for one day
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va-asher hayah na'aseh* — and every single day there were eaten at my table one ox and six sheep, and many fowls.
*Berurot* — its meaning is according to its context: six sheep prepared, as in the matter of what is said “five sheep ready dressed (*asuyot*)” (I Samuel 25:18).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is I Samuel 25:18 (JPS: “five sheep ready dressed”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Na'asu li* — language of preparing, like “and the calf which he had dressed (*asah*)” (Genesis 18:8).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The quotation is Genesis 18:8 (JPS: “and the calf which he had dressed”).

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Uvein asseret yamim* — and every single day they drank much wine, to the measure of a supply for ten days.
Nehemiah.translator_note: Rashi’s printed wording differs from JPS (“once in ten days store of all sorts of wine”); translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-im zeh* — and on account of all this work, in which I was spending so much expense.
*Lechem* — of the tax that was due to the governor I did not request, nor did I ask it of the people, for the work of building the wall was heavy and hard upon them.
*Velo notar bah* — in the wall of the city.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: I had not set up the doors in the gates
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Delatot lo he'emadti* — for doors had not been made in the gates of the city.
*Bakephirim* — it is the name of a place.
Nehemiah.translator_note: JPS renders the word “villages”; Rashi takes it as a place name, and it is translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Bevik'at Ono* — so is the name of the plain.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: they thought to do me mischief
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vehemmah chosh'vim* — I understood from them that they were planning against me to kill me there.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: I am doing a great work
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Melachah gedolah ani oseh* — from the buildings (the city, ס"א) of the earth.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The parenthesis is a later printed insertion; the abbreviation ס"א is left as printed, and the whole phrase is translated literally because its sense is not clear to me.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lammah tishbot* — why should the work be idle?
*Ka-asher arpeh* — my hand from the building.
*Veyaradti alekhem* — to speak and to meet with you.
*Et na'aro* — through his servant.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed abbreviation ע"י is read as *al yedei* (“through”).

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: an open letter in his hand
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-iggeret ptuchah beyado* — he sent me a letter in writing through him.
*Katuv bah* — in that letter.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: It is reported among the nations
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Baggoyim nishma* — that it was known to all the idolaters that you and all the Jews are planning to rebel.
*Ve-Gashmu omer* — *Gashmu* is Geshem the Arab, and its meaning is like a man who says to his fellow: thus is the matter, and so-and-so says it.
*Kidvarim ha'eleh* — it refers back to “written in it,” and the verse is transposed, and it is as though it said: “written in it, according to these words: it is reported among the nations,” etc.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: And thou hast also appointed prophets
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vegam nevi'im* etc. — up to “and let us take counsel together” was written in the letter.
*Nevi'im* — masters of speech, like “creating the fruit (*niv*) of the lips” (Isaiah 9).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The words occur at Isaiah 57:19 (JPS: “that createth the fruit of the lips”); the printed reference “Isaiah 9” is incorrect.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: There is a king in Judah
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lemor* — who say: “There is a king in Judah.”

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: shall it be reported to the king
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-atah yishama lamelekh* — since you are called king, let it be heard to the king according to these words.
*Ki milibbekha* — behold, *ki* is in place of *ella* (“but”).
*Bodam* — *kuntrebentalsh* in the vernacular, like “which he had devised (*bada*) of his own heart.”
Nehemiah.translator_note: The Old French form is printed in Hebrew letters and could not be confirmed in Darmesteter; left as printed. The quotation is I Kings 12:33 (JPS: “which he had devised of his own heart”); the printed text gives no reference.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: For they all would have us afraid
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki khullam* — for all the idolaters.
*Mayyir'im otanu* — they are afraid of him, and thus they say, “Their hands shall be weakened,” etc.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed words *mityre'im mimmenu* (“they are afraid of him”) are translated literally; the lemma is the verse’s “would have us afraid.”

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ve-atah chazzek et yadai* — to help me in building the wall.
*Vehu atzur* — for they found him in his house.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Let us meet together in the house of God
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayomer nivva'ed* — this Shemaiah was a false prophet, and he received a bribe from Sanballat and his companions to frighten Nehemiah, in order to stop the work.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: for they will come to slay thee
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki va'im laharogekha* — for Sanballat and his companions will come to kill you.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: yea, in the night will they come to slay thee
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Velailah ba'im* — and therefore they warned him to enter the Temple and to shut the doors upon him, for the doors of the city gates had not yet been made, as it says at the beginning of the section, “even unto that time I had not set up the doors in the gates.”
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed abbreviation וע"כ is read as *ve-al ken* (“and therefore”). The quotation is Nehemiah 6:1; Rashi’s wording differs slightly from JPS (“though even unto that time I had not set up the doors in the gates”) and is translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: Should such a man as I flee
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ha'ish kamoni yivrach* — said in astonishment: should a man like me flee, to enter the Temple?
*Lo avo* — I will not enter there out of fear of death, and I will not transgress the commandment of the Holy One, blessed be He, that a stranger shall not come and enter His Temple.
*Va-akkirah* — I recognized from his words that the Holy One, blessed be He, had not sent him with this word, that I should commit a transgression out of fear of death.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: he pronounced this prophecy against me
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Ki hanevu'ah diber alai* — for he spoke these words against me in the name of prophecy.
*Secharo* — each and every one of them hired him and gave him a wage to frighten me and to stop the building of the wall.
*Lema'an sakhur hu* — he told me these words.
*Lema'an ira* — in order that I should be afraid of them, so as to do thus, to enter the Temple, and so be a sinner.
*Vehayah lahem leshem ra* — so that they would have an evil report, to taunt me for this transgression.
*Vegam leNo'adyah hanevi'ah* — she and the rest of the false prophets received a wage from Sanballat and his companions to frighten me with their false prophecy.

*Be-esrim vachamishah* — days of the month Elul, in the twentieth year of King Darius, for in the twentieth year of Darius Nehemiah went up from Babylon, and in that same year he built the ruins of Jerusalem.
Nehemiah.translator_note: The printed text names Darius, where Nehemiah 2:1 names Artaxerxes (JPS: “in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king”); translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Lachamishim ushenayim yom* — at the end of fifty-two days from the day they began to build it, the building of the wall was completed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: when all our enemies heard thereof
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayehi ka-asher shame'u kol oyevenu* — this matter, that the building of the wall was completed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: all the nations that were about us feared
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayyir'u kol hagoyim* — and when all the idolaters saw that the building of the wall of the city was finished.
Nehemiah.translator_note: Rashi’s comment reads the verb as “saw,” where JPS renders it “feared”; translated as printed.

Nehemiah.english_lemma_JPS: were much cast down in their own eyes
Nehemiah.english_translation: *Vayyipelu me'od be-eineihem* — they themselves fell in their own eyes, for they despised themselves, since the dread of the Jews fell upon them.
*Chorei Yehudah* — the princes of Judah.
*Al Tovyah* — to Tobiah. He was a wicked Israelite (see tractate Kiddushin 70, where it is explained that he was an idolater, and it requires study, מיוש"ה).
Nehemiah.translator_note: The parenthesis is a later printed insertion; the abbreviation מיוש"ה is left as printed because I could not resolve it, and the reference to Kiddushin 70 was not checked.

Nehemiah.english_translation: *Va-asher leTovyah* — and the letter that was Tobiah’s.
